spell:fiery-siege.description: A siege weapon you touch deals an extra 1d10 Fire on hits. A Bonus Action moves the effect to another siege engine you touch.

spell:fire-rune.description: A melee weapon you touch bears a fire rune and deals an extra 1d8 Fire on a hit.

spell:fist-of-the-frost-jarl.components: V, S, M (a drop of water melted from an icicle)
spell:fist-of-the-frost-jarl.description: A 5-foot fist of ice flies along a 120-foot Line: Dexterity save, 4d8 Cold or half. One Huge or smaller creature that failed can be Grappled (escape DC your spell save DC), taking 2d8 Cold at the end of each of its turns until it escapes and the fist shatters. +1d8 per slot level above 4; at level 7+ it ignores Cold Resistance.

spell:freezing-fog.description: A 20-foot-radius Sphere of fog is Heavily Obscured Difficult Terrain until a strong wind disperses it. A creature starting its turn there or entering makes a Constitution save or has its Speed halved until the end of its next turn, and takes 2d4 Cold per 5 feet it moves inside. You are immune.

spell:freyja-s-allure.description: A creature makes a Charisma save or has Disadvantage on attacks and can't willingly move farther from you. It repeats the save at the end of each turn (with Disadvantage if it can see you within 30 feet). One extra target per slot level above 1.

spell:freyja-s-grace.castingTime: Reaction, which you take after failing a saving throw
spell:freyja-s-grace.description: Reroll the failed save as a Charisma save, whatever its original type.

spell:ghostly-crew.description: Spirits crew a vessel you touch; while you are within 30 feet it can take a full complement of ship actions, including movement and siege weapons. They can't fight or repair.

spell:giantbane.description: Advantage on attacks against Large or larger creatures, and your attacks deal an extra 2d6 Force to them.

spell:giantdodge.description: +20 feet Speed, +2 AC against Large or larger attackers, and you don't provoke their Opportunity Attacks.

spell:giant-s-teeth.components: V, S, M (a handful of molars)
spell:giant-s-teeth.description: Huge teeth clamp a creature within 90 feet: it is Grappled (escape DC your spell save DC) and takes 2d10 Bludgeoning at the start of each of its turns; escaping ends the spell. 3d10 at level 5, 5d8 at 7, 6d8 at 9.

spell:glimpse-the-wyrd.castingTime: Reaction, which you take when a creature succeeds or fails on a d20 Test
spell:glimpse-the-wyrd.description: Add or subtract 1d6 from the d20 Test.

spell:hearthfire.description: A Large or smaller unattended object sheds Bright Light 20 feet and Dim Light 20 more; you and creatures you choose in its Bright Light are immune to Extreme Cold.

spell:hungry-jaws-of-fenris.description: Your mouth becomes a wolf's maw (you can't speak or cast verbal spells). Bite attacks deal 4d10 + spellcasting modifier Piercing and Grapple (escape DC your spell save DC). Biting a creature you already grapple can swallow it into a pocket dimension: Blinded, Restrained, Total Cover, and 3d12 Force at the start of each of your turns; it saves at the end of its turns to be vomited out, as it is when the spell ends. One creature at a time. +1d12 bite per slot level above 6.

spell:ice-shape.description: Shape a section of ice no more than 5 feet in any dimension into a crude but functional form: a weapon, statue, coffer, a passage through 5 feet of ice, or a seal over a narrow opening.

spell:icewalker.components: V, S, M (a shard of ice)
spell:icewalker.description: In a 30-foot Emanation, you and creatures you choose treat slippery ice as normal terrain and count as one-tenth their weight for breaking thin ice.

spell:inbar-s-giant-friend.castingTime: Reaction, which you take when a Giant sees you
spell:inbar-s-giant-friend.components: V, S, M (a hair or nail clipping from a goblinoid)
spell:inbar-s-giant-friend.description: The Giant makes a Wisdom save or its attitude toward you improves one step. Charm-immune Giants are unaffected, and each Giant can be targeted only once.

spell:infectious-skal.description: A creature that hears your drinking song makes a Wisdom save or is Charmed and Friendly, doing nothing but singing along. Each Bonus Action spreads it to another creature within 30 feet of you or a singer (two per Bonus Action at level 3+), up to your spellcasting modifier in total. If any singer is attacked, the spell ends for all.

spell:jotun-form.components: V, S, M (a shard of a giant animal's bone)
spell:jotun-form.description: Shape-shift into a Giant you have seen with CR up to your level, gaining Temporary Hit Points equal to its Hit Points. You use its stat block but keep your type, alignment, mental scores, Hit Points, Hit Dice, proficiencies, communication, and Spellcasting. A Magic action changes to another eligible form.

spell:loki-s-escape.castingTime: Reaction, which you take after taking damage
spell:loki-s-escape.description: You are Invisible until the end of your next turn and can use a Bonus Action to move your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. Ends after you attack, deal damage, or cast a spell.

spell:luckfingers.description: A Medium or smaller creature has Advantage on ability checks; on a failed check it can end the spell for itself to succeed instead. One extra creature per slot level above 3.

spell:melody-of-sheltered-rest.description: A 30-foot Emanation gives creatures in it Advantage on Perception checks and prevents them from being surprised. A creature in the aura that keeps singing can extend it by 2 hours, repeatedly.

spell:murmurs-of-doom.description: A 30-foot Emanation of dirge. When you create it and at the start of each of your turns, one creature in it makes a Constitution save or takes 3d8 Necrotic.

spell:noble-sacrifice.castingTime: Reaction, which you take when a creature you can see drops to 0 Hit Points or fails its third Death Saving Throw
spell:noble-sacrifice.description: The creature is restored to 1 Hit Point, and you lose half your current Hit Points.

spell:ode-to-wrath.description: In a 30-foot Emanation, you and your allies add your spellcasting ability modifier to melee weapon damage rolls.

spell:pawn-of-the-wyrd.castingTime: Reaction, which you take when another creature takes a Reaction
spell:pawn-of-the-wyrd.description: The creature's Reaction doesn't happen and it can't take another; any slot or resource it would have spent is not spent. You lose your next Reaction.

spell:protection-rune.description: A rune on a creature's skin gives it Resistance to one damage type of your choice.

spell:reaver-s-rune.description: A rune on a melee weapon lets its wielder make one attack per turn with Advantage. Ends if the weapon leaves their possession.

spell:regenerative-hull.description: A vehicle with at least 1 Hit Point regains Hit Points equal to twice your spellcasting modifier at the start of each of your turns.

spell:reinforce-hull.description: A vehicle with a damage threshold has it increased by your spellcasting ability modifier.

spell:repair-hull.description: A vehicle with at least 1 Hit Point regains 4d12 + spellcasting modifier Hit Points. +1d12 per slot level above 3.

spell:sailor-s-shanty.description: A vehicle's crew has Advantage on d20 Tests to control or operate it.

spell:shared-expertise.components: V, S, M (a piece of boot leather)
spell:shared-expertise.description: Choose up to two skills you have Expertise in; allies in a 30-foot Emanation count as proficient in them.

spell:shield-maiden-s-favor.castingTime: Reaction, which you take when you or an ally takes damage
spell:shield-maiden-s-favor.description: A spectral shield-maiden reduces the triggering damage by 1d10 + your spellcasting modifier. +1d10 per slot level above 1.

spell:sif-s-grace.components: V, M (two silver beads of equal weight)
spell:sif-s-grace.description: A creature's Speed doubles, Opportunity Attacks against it have Disadvantage, and it has Advantage on Acrobatics checks on turns it moves. It can end the spell for itself to automatically succeed on a Dexterity save. One extra creature per slot level above 3.

spell:skaldic-scolding.castingTime: Reaction, which you take in response to taking damage from a creature that you can see within 30 feet of yourself
spell:skaldic-scolding.description: The creature makes a Charisma save: 4d10 Psychic and Incapacitated until the start of your next turn (Stunned if it fails by 5 or more), or half and no condition. +1d10 per slot level above 4.

spell:song-of-the-shield-wall.description: Spectral shields give up to your spellcasting modifier creatures within 30 feet +2 AC (+3 with a level 6 slot, +4 with level 8).

spell:speechmaster-s-rune.description: A creature holding the runed stone has Advantage on Charisma checks.

spell:storm-maiden-s-edge.description: A weapon deals an extra 2d8 Lightning on a hit, and the target makes a Strength save or is pushed 10 feet (and knocked Prone if it fails by 5 or more). +1d8 per two slot levels above 3.

spell:summon-leviathan-avatar.components: V, S, M (a drop of seawater)
spell:summon-leviathan-avatar.description: A Huge leviathan spirit appears in enough water to hold it, acting after you on your Initiative and obeying your commands (Dodge otherwise). AC 13 + spell level, 70 Hit Points (+10 per level above 7), Swim 50 feet; Multiattack of Rends equal to half the spell level (1d10 + 5 + spell level Piercing, reach 10 feet) and a 30-foot cone Roar (Constitution save or Frightened).

spell:sun-rune.description: Once, a creature holding the runed stone can throw it 60 feet as an action; it bursts in a 30-foot Sphere: Constitution save, 4d6 Fire plus 4d6 Radiant or half. Unattended flammables ignite, and snow or ice turns to Heavily Obscuring fog for 1 minute. Only one Sun Rune at a time; a creature can activate one per Long Rest.

spell:talons-of-the-eagle.description: Advantage on Dexterity checks and saves. As a Magic action, grow talons, move up to your Speed, and make a melee talon attack: 1d8 + spellcasting modifier Slashing. +1d8 per two slot levels above 1.

spell:thought-rune.description: A creature holding the runed stone has Advantage on Intelligence and Wisdom checks and saves.

spell:trickster-s-bluff.components: V, M (the petrified tongue of a serpent)
spell:trickster-s-bluff.description: Advantage on Charisma (Deception) checks. When you fail one, you can deal 1d4 Psychic to the creature you failed to fool and give it Disadvantage on attacks until the start of your next turn.

spell:trollblood-infusion.components: V, S, M (a drop of troll blood)
spell:trollblood-infusion.description: A creature regains 5 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns (if it has at least 1) and automatically succeeds on Death Saving Throws. Acid or Fire damage stops the regeneration on its next turn.

spell:truth-s-blade.components: V, S, M (a silver pin, which is not consumed)
spell:truth-s-blade.description: A creature makes a Wisdom save or takes 4d8 Psychic whenever it lies for the duration. +1d8 per slot level above 3.

spell:valhalla-s-cohort.description: A Huge cohort of spectral warriors appears; move it 30 feet as a Bonus Action. When it ends its move within 5 feet of a creature or a creature moves within 5 feet of it, make a melee spell attack: 2d10 + spellcasting modifier Force (once per creature per turn). +1d10 per slot level above 4.

spell:valkyrie-s-guidance.components: V, S, M (a polished blue stone)
spell:valkyrie-s-guidance.description: Choose a creature you can see: Advantage on melee attacks against it and Intelligence checks to recall lore about it. Ends if you don't attack it on your turn.

spell:valkyrie-s-vision.description: You know the current Hit Points and Exhaustion of creatures you can see within 30 feet. As a Bonus Action, stabilize a dying creature within 30 feet, ending the spell.

spell:wall-of-snow.components: V, S, M (a freshly packed snowball)
spell:wall-of-snow.description: Create a snow wall up to 50 feet long, 15 feet high, and 1 foot thick, or a 10-foot-radius dome. Each 10-foot section has AC 10 and 10 Hit Points, Immunity to Cold, Poison, and Psychic, and Vulnerability to Fire and Radiant. Creatures in an intact dome are immune to Extreme Cold. In snowy terrain it blends in (Investigation against your DC to spot).

spell:weave-detonation.components: V, S, M (a short piece of thread)
spell:weave-detonation.description: Creatures in a 20-foot-radius Sphere make a Wisdom save or have Disadvantage on all d20 Tests for 1 minute (save at the end of each turn). Per slot level above 3, exclude up to five creatures.

spell:whiteout.description: Outdoors only. A 20-foot-radius Sphere of fog and snow centered on you is Heavily Obscured Difficult Terrain. A creature starting its turn there or entering makes a Constitution save or gains an Exhaustion level (Cold-resistant creatures succeed; up to your spellcasting modifier creatures you designate are exempt). The Exhaustion ends when the spell does.

spell:wotan-s-retribution.castingTime: Reaction, which you take when a creature scores a Critical Hit against you
spell:wotan-s-retribution.description: Teleport behind the attacker and make a melee weapon attack with Advantage; on a hit it also takes damage equal to what its critical dealt you.

spell:wyrd-sight.description: Once per turn, roll 1d12 and add it to or subtract it from a d20 roll by a creature you can see.

spell:airbag.castingTime: Reaction, which you take when you or a creature you can see within 30 feet of you takes Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage
spell:airbag.description: An airbag reduces the triggering damage by 1d6. +1d6 per slot level above 1.

spell:avian-courier.description: A magic bird carries an unattended object of up to 50 pounds within range to a surface within 200 feet along an unobstructed path, arriving at the start of your next turn. +50 pounds and +100 feet per slot level above 1.

spell:bait.description: A spectral flying-fish lure appears and moves 20 feet (again as a Bonus Action on later turns). Creatures that see it within 5 feet as it passes make a Wisdom save or are Baited (one fewer attack if they take the Attack action next turn) or Dragged (follow the lure, provoking Opportunity Attacks, and lose that much Speed next turn), your choice.

spell:borrow-magic.description: A willing creature lends you a level 1 spell slot, which you can use once before the start of your next turn or lose. A creature can lend three slots per Long Rest. Cantrip Upgrade: level 2 slots at level 5, level 3 at 11, level 4 at 17.

spell:charge.description: A working machine you touch is powered as if whelmed by a spirit or permanently enchanted. Duration 1 day with level 3 or 4 slots, 7 days with 5 or 6, 30 days with 7 or 8, and 1 year at 9.

spell:correspondence.components: S, M (a ball of wax worth 10+ GF, which the spell consumes; a blank piece of paper; and an envelope)
spell:correspondence.description: A creature's spoken message of up to 100 words is recorded and sealed. The designated recipient opens it as a Magic action (or Knock opens it) and it reads aloud in the speaker's voice. Anyone else forcing it open makes a Wisdom save: failure leaves the seal intact, success destroys the envelope.

spell:demon-lure.description: A totem becomes enticing to demons (Fiends) in a 150-foot Emanation. A demon starting its turn there without Total Cover makes a Wisdom save or is Charmed and must Dash toward the totem each turn, until it comes within 5 feet, leaves the plane, or saves again after taking damage or being shaken. Larger Emanation with higher slots (300 to 1,000 feet). Outside Obojima, it can target Aberrations, Fey, Fiends, or Undead.

spell:detect-curse.description: Sense curses within 30 feet; as a Magic action see auras on cursed creatures or objects and learn the item or spell that caused a curse and its rarity or level. Blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood, 1 inch of metal, or thin lead.

spell:fire-hydrant.components: V, S, M (a drop of water)
spell:fire-hydrant.description: A Small hydrant (AC your spell save DC, 30 Hit Points) blasts a 20-foot by 5-foot Line of water; creatures in it, or entering or ending a turn there, make a Strength save or are pushed to the end of the Line. A Bonus Action redirects the stream.

spell:gotcha.description: A capsule machine dispenses a random potion from the Combat, Utility, or Whimsy list of Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass (d20; +10 with a level 2+ slot). It vanishes if unused within 1 hour.

spell:graffiti-trap.components: V, S, M (a jar of paint worth 5+ GF, which the spell consumes)
spell:graffiti-trap.description: Paint a mundane-seeming trap up to 5 feet across (Investigation against your DC reveals it). It triggers when a non-designated creature comes within 5 feet, or as your Magic action against a creature within 10 feet; you are alerted. Dexterity save or pulled to the surface and Restrained for 1 minute (Athletics to escape, or a gallon of water); on a success, Speed halved. Lasts 8 hours to 30 days with higher slots.

spell:identify-curse.components: V, S, M (a small Kyojin Candle worth 50+ GF, which the spell consumes)
spell:identify-curse.description: Learn a curse's effects, source, and how to end it on a creature or object you touch, or the effects of a curse on a 30-foot Emanation (or whether a cursed creature or object passed through in the last 24 hours).

spell:one-way-street.components: V, S, M (crushed rocks or sand)
spell:one-way-street.description: An illusory road up to 15 feet wide and 120 feet long; creatures moving along it in any direction but the one you chose spend 3 feet of movement per foot.

spell:soda-pop.description: Throw a summoned can; when the spell ends it bursts in a Sphere starting at 10 feet and growing 5 feet each of your turns: Dexterity save, accumulated Force damage or half. Base 8d4; moving it 20 feet or shaking it (Bonus Action) adds 1d4 once per round, up to 14d4. Ends early if a creature is carrying it at the end of a turn. +1d4 base and maximum per slot level above 3.

spell:stop-sign.description: A spectral stop sign appears within 5 feet of you until your next turn; a creature makes a Wisdom save or can't move toward it. Cantrip Upgrade: two targets at level 5, three at 11, four at 17.

spell:summon-ompo-swarm.components: V, S, M (a scrap of trash)
spell:summon-ompo-swarm.description: Mouselike spirits devour all unattended Small or smaller nonmagical objects in a 10-foot Cube, except those you designate. +5 feet per slot level above 1.

spell:taxi-service.description: A Huge spectral taxi travels a 120-foot Line, picking up willing Medium or smaller creatures within 5 feet of it and passing through objects (stopping at 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of metal, or lead); passengers exit within 5 feet of where it stops.

spell:unearth-demon.components: V, S, M (cursed tuft of hair)
spell:unearth-demon.description: Choose 1,000 feet (number of demons), 500 feet (also direction and distance), or 250 feet (also kind and CR). Outside Obojima it can detect Aberrations, Fey, Fiends, or Undead.

spell:vine-ladder.components: S, M (a stem, leaf, or other piece of a plant)
spell:vine-ladder.description: A stationary vine ladder up to 15 feet tall appears on a solid surface; a new one replaces the last.

spell:warding-barrier.description: Ward a 15-foot-radius Sphere against one creature type of CR 2 or lower: entering requires a Charisma save or it falls Prone and stops; starting its turn inside, it saves or is shunted out, Prone, taking 2d8 Force. Maximum CR +1 per slot level above 2.

spell:brittle-bone-throw.description: Ranged spell attack: 1d8 Piercing. On a miss, redirect a shard at another creature within 15 feet of the target with a second attack for 1d4 Piercing. Both rise by a die at levels 5, 11, and 17. Osteomancy spell.

spell:gravity-spike.description: A creature on the ground makes a Dexterity save: 1d4 Piercing and Prone, or half damage only. 2d4 at level 5, 3d4 at 11, 4d4 at 17.

spell:fractured-shell.description: A willing creature takes 1 Piercing as bone spikes grow; the first creature each turn that hits it with a melee attack takes 2d4 Piercing. +1d4 per slot level above 1; no Concentration at level 5+. Osteomancy spell.

spell:phalangeal-shot.description: Finger bones fire along a 30-foot by 1-foot Line: Dexterity save or 2d8 Piercing. +1d8 per slot level above 1. Osteomancy spell.

spell:spectral-slash.components: V, S, M (a melee weapon worth 1 SP+)
spell:spectral-slash.description: A spectral copy makes a melee spell attack against a creature within 20 feet for 1d8 of your weapon's type. You can then use your action to dash 20 feet straight at it and take the Attack action with that weapon. +1d8 and +10 feet per slot level above 1.

spell:arm-cannon.description: Ranged spell attack: 4d8 Piercing and a Strength save (Large+ with Advantage) or pushed 15 feet; slammed into an obstacle it is Restrained until the end of its next turn. +1d8 and +5 feet per slot level above 2. Osteomancy spell.

spell:blind-ambush.components: S, M (a whistle made of bones)
spell:blind-ambush.description: The first time a creature moves 5 feet within a 10-foot Square you choose, a maw erupts: 2d10 Piercing to each creature there, knocking one Prone. +1d10 per slot level above 2; at level 5+ it can trigger twice.

spell:calcified-memories.description: Touching a non-Undead corpse's bones replays an illusion of its last 6 seconds, showing only outlines of what affected it. Once per corpse per 24 hours. Osteomancy spell.

spell:skeletal-tail.description: Grow a bone tail. When a creature moves within a 15-foot Emanation, take a Reaction for a melee spell attack: 2d4 + spellcasting modifier Piercing and pull it adjacent. +2d4 per slot level above 2. Osteomancy spell.

spell:displacing-maw.description: Your rib cage swallows a creature: Strength save or 4d8 Piercing and regurgitated at a point within 60 feet; half damage only on a success. +1d8 and +10 feet per slot level above 3. Osteomancy spell.

spell:osseous-impalement.components: V, S, M (a calcified bamboo stick)
spell:osseous-impalement.description: Up to four creatures on the ground make a Dexterity save or take 3d10 Piercing and are impaled 5 feet up, Restrained, taking 1d10 each turn; Athletics against your DC as an action breaks free. +1d10 to both per slot level above 3. Osteomancy spell.

spell:spectral-fury.components: V, S, M (a melee weapon worth 1+ SP)
spell:spectral-fury.description: Three spectral duplicates each make a melee spell attack against creatures within 30 feet for 4d8 of your weapon's type. Then a Bonus Action dashes you 30 feet toward one without provoking for a weapon attack. +2d8 per duplicate per slot level above 3.

spell:dread-scarecrow.components: V, S, M (a flute made of a femur worth 50+ GP)
spell:dread-scarecrow.description: Creatures you choose in a 30-foot Sphere make a Wisdom save or are Frightened, Prone, and Speed 0 for the duration; one that takes damage repeats the save at the end of its next turn. Osteomancy spell.

spell:maiden-of-bones.components: V, S, M (a virgin's carpal bone)
spell:maiden-of-bones.description: A creature makes a Strength save or is sealed in a bone iron maiden: Restrained, Incapacitated, Total Cover, and 3d6 Piercing each turn, saving at the end of each turn. The maiden has AC 10 + spellcasting modifier, 80 Hit Points, Immunity to Psychic and Poison, Vulnerability to Bludgeoning. +1d6 and +20 Hit Points per slot level above 4. Osteomancy spell.

spell:marrow-transplant.components: V, S, M (a piece of spinal bone and a diamond worth 300+ GP, which the spell consumes)
spell:marrow-transplant.description: Ranged spell attack: 4d6 Necrotic, and another creature within range regains that many Hit Points, or returns to life with them if dead less than a minute (not old age). Fails if either lacks bones. +1d6 per slot level above 4. Osteomancy spell.

spell:forest-of-dread.description: Bone trees fill a 30-foot-radius, 20-foot-high Cylinder: chosen creatures make a Dexterity save, 4d8 Piercing or half. The area is Difficult Terrain giving Half Cover, and moving in it costs 2d8 Piercing per 5 feet (not you). Osteomancy spell.

spell:body-warping-of-gorgoroth.description: You become an exact physical duplicate of a Humanoid of your size that you can see, undetectable by physical examination; your voice and equipment don't change.

spell:breath-of-the-deep.description: Crushing deep-sea water surrounds a creature you can see: 3d6 Bludgeoning, and it can't speak or use Verbal components for the duration.

spell:call-deity.description: During your Contact Deity, make the contacted deity manifest nearby for 1 hour. It acts as it wishes and treats you as an ally unless you act against it, but not your allies; protecting others counts as acting against it.

spell:cat-s-spring.description: Leap up to 10 feet and make a melee spell attack with a spectral claw: 1d8 Slashing or Force, and your next attack against it before the end of your next turn has Advantage. 2d8 at level 5, 3d8 at 11, 4d8 at 17.

spell:chant-of-thoth.description: The first time you fail an Intelligence check, succeed automatically if its DC is below your spell save DC, otherwise add +2. Once per Short Rest.

spell:confounding-shadows.description: A creature makes a Wisdom save or takes 1d6 Psychic and can't see you until the end of your next turn. 2d6 at level 5, 3d6 at 11, 4d6 at 17.

spell:clutch-of-darkness.description: Roll 2d6 for a creature you can see and add 2d6 at the start of each of your turns. Above its Strength: Disadvantage on Strength attacks. Above its Dexterity: Speed halved and attacks against it have Advantage. Above its current Hit Points: it implodes and dies.

spell:contact-deity.description: Ask a Mythos deity 1d6 yes-or-no questions and receive correct answers (or unclear). On a d20 roll of 1 when you cast it, the deity appears and attacks everyone, including you, for the duration.

spell:create-mist-of-r-lyeh.description: A 20-foot-radius Sphere of lightly obscuring fog with fleeting shapes; creatures ending their turn in it take 1d4 Psychic, and Beasts of Intelligence 3 or less won't enter willingly.

spell:curse-of-the-putrid-husk.description: A creature believes it is rotting. Choose: it Dashes away from allies whenever it starts a turn within 30 feet of one, or it Dashes at its nearest enemy each turn and makes an Unarmed Strike against an enemy within 5 feet.

spell:dismiss-deity.description: A Bloodied Mythos or Deity creature you can see is sent to a random location on a plane tied to its type.

spell:doom.description: A creature makes a Charisma save. On a failure, when it takes damage from an attack you can use your Reaction to make the damage dice deal their maximum. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns.

spell:dust-of-suleiman.description: A 30-foot-radius Sphere of dust: creatures of a chosen type (not Beast or Humanoid) take 20 Force when it appears or moves onto them, or when they enter or end their turn in it (once per turn).

spell:dread-curse-of-azathoth.description: A creature gains a curse point at the end of each of its turns and dies on the third, unless the spell ends first.

spell:evil-eye.description: A creature you can see takes 1d4 + 2 Psychic, and attacks and Unarmed Strikes against it crit on 19 or 20 until your next turn. Scales to 2d4 + 4 at level 5, 3d4 + 6 at 11, 4d4 + 8 at 17.

spell:feline-chaos.description: Targets make a Dexterity save or are swarmed by spectral cats: 4d6 Slashing at the start of each turn, Disadvantage on checks and attacks, and moving requires a Constitution save or they fall Prone and take 2d6 more. They repeat the Dexterity save at the end of each turn. +2d6 per slot level above 5.

spell:feline-grace.description: You can't be knocked Prone while not Incapacitated, can use a Reaction to reduce falling damage by five times your level, have Advantage on Dexterity checks and saves, and jump twice as far.

spell:fist-of-yog-sothoth.description: A creature takes 8d6 Necrotic; on a failed Strength save it is also knocked Prone and moved up to 40 feet within range.

spell:phantom-panther.description: A spectral panther pounces: Strength save or 8d6 Force and Restrained (2d6 Force each turn; Athletics against your DC as an action ends it), or half and the spell ends. +1d6 per slot level above 3.

spell:red-sign.description: At the end of each of your turns, every creature within 30 feet that can see you, including you, takes 5d8 Necrotic (it can't break your Concentration). Creatures it kills collapse into slime, revivable only by True Resurrection or Wish.

spell:shadowy-eruption.description: A 20-foot-radius Sphere of gloom. The Darkness Hides Terrors: chosen creatures make a Dexterity save, 4d8 Psychic and a Reaction move away, or half. Tomb of Shadows: Constitution save, 4d8 Necrotic and -20 feet Speed, or half. +1d8 per slot level above 3.

spell:summon-shadow.description: A Shadow Spirit (Infiltrator or Assassin) acts after you and obeys your commands. AC 11 + spell level, 50 (Assassin) or 40 (Infiltrator) Hit Points +10 per level above 5, Resistance to Necrotic, Immunity to Cold, moves through objects, and Hides as a Bonus Action in dim light. Attacks equal to half the spell level: Chill Touch (1d8 + 3 + level Cold) or Deathly Bolt (150 feet, 2d4 + 3 + level Cold, +2d4 if hidden).

spell:tide-of-darkness.description: A 10-foot Cube of Darkness from you: Wisdom save, 2d8 Psychic and Blinded while in it, or half. It lasts until the end of your next turn. +5 feet per slot level above 1.

spell:umbral-tendril.description: Ranged spell attack: 2d8 Necrotic, and you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to the damage. +1d8 per slot level above 1.

spell:voorish-sign.description: Your spell damage dice against a chosen creature are maximized, and as part of this casting you can also cast a level 5 or lower one-action spell, expending both slots.

spell:wave-of-oblivion.description: Each Bloodied creature in a 30-foot Cone makes a Constitution save or dies and turns to dust with its nonmagical gear, revivable only by True Resurrection or Wish.

spell:aundair-s-silent-sanctum.description: A soundproof 5-foot Emanation: Perception checks to hear across its edge have Disadvantage in both directions, and creatures have Advantage on saves against effects that need them to hear a sound from the other side.

spell:concussive-burst.description: Each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere makes a Constitution save: 2d4 Force and Deafened until the end of your next turn on a failure, half damage only on a success. +2d4 per slot level above 1.

spell:force-blast.description: Ranged spell attack against a creature or object for 1d8 Force. Increases to 2d8, 3d8, and 4d8 at levels 5, 11, and 17.

spell:magecraft.components: V, S, M (Artisan's Tools or a Herbalism Kit)
spell:magecraft.description: Choose an Artisan's Tool or Herbalism Kit; add 1d6 to ability checks when you take the Utilize action with it.

spell:gray-gaze.components: V, S, M (a pebble with a hole in it)
spell:gray-gaze.description: A creature you can see that can see your eyes makes a Constitution save or takes Necrotic damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus and has Disadvantage on its next Dexterity save before the end of its next turn.

spell:orien-step.description: Mark of Passage spell. Teleport up to 5 feet to an unoccupied space you can see, not through solid objects or out of restraints.

spell:evolution-devolution.components: V, S, M (a pinch of dirt)
spell:evolution-devolution.description: A touched creature (Wisdom save if unwilling) gains or loses one ancestral trait: attack damage +/- 1d4, Speed +/- 20, climb or fly gained or reduced, one attack's damage type changed, Darkvision gained or reduced, or HP max +/- 1d4 + 4. One more trait per slot level above 2.

magic-item:arcane-chatelaine.description: Clasp with six spectral keys. Magic action: touch a key to a door, window, gate, container, or hatch to cast Arcane Lock on it; the key vanishes. The clasp vanishes with its last key.

magic-item:arcanist-s-bestiary.description: Charm Monster (DC 15) once per dawn; non-Humanoids save with Disadvantage. On attuning, gain proficiency in Arcana, History, Nature, or Religion (changeable each Long Rest). A successful Study-action Arcana check on an Aberration, Construct, Elemental, Fey, or Monstrosity also reveals its Immunities, Resistances, and Vulnerabilities.

magic-item:bellows-of-strangulation.description: 6 charges, regains 1d6 + 1 at dawn (1 in 20 to be lost on the last). Magic action: 1 charge, one creature within 60 ft makes a DC 15 Con save or is Incapacitated (repeat save each turn); 3 charges, the same in a 30-ft Cone; 5 charges, Cloudkill (DC 17).

magic-item:blood-amulet.description: 3 charges, regains 1d3 at dawn. When you deal damage, spend 1 charge: +2d10 Necrotic and the target makes a DC 15 Con save or gains 1 Exhaustion level.

magic-item:blossom-rod.description: Evolving. Budding (Uncommon): Druidcraft, once-per-dawn Plant Growth (Overgrowth), and refresh plants in a 5-ft Cube. Flowering (Rare): once-per-dawn Insect Plague (bumblebees) at your DC. Somniferous (Very Rare): once per dawn, chosen creatures in 30 ft make a DC 17 Con save or sleep for 1 hour.

magic-item:boon-companions-bands.description: A matched pair. When your area effect forces saves, the wearer of the other band can be spared: it auto-succeeds and takes no damage instead of half. Once per dawn for the pair; destroying one crumbles the other.

magic-item:conjurer-s-canopy.description: Magic action: plant the stick to raise a 20-ft Cube of force for 1 hour that keeps out weather and keeps the inside dry and comfortable. Creatures, objects, and magic pass through freely. Unusable for 1d12 hours after it ends.

magic-item:crystal-ball-of-ominous-porte.description: Cast Hex or Scrying (DC 17). Once per dawn, a Reaction turns a successful D20 Test by a creature within 60 ft into a 1.

magic-item:diamond-staff.attunementNote: by a Sorcerer, Warlock, or Wizard
magic-item:diamond-staff.description: +3 Quarterstaff with 20 charges (regains 1d6 + 4 at dawn; 1 in 20 to be destroyed on the last). Advantage on Arcana checks; 1 charge for 40-ft bright light; casts Detect Magic, Light, Tongues (self) free, plus Identify (1), Knock (2), True Seeing (3), Legend Lore (5), and Maze (8) at your DC. On a melee hit, 2 charges: DC 17 Con save or Stunned until the end of your next turn.

magic-item:dictation-quill.description: Magic action with paper and ink: the quill transcribes your spoken or signed words at 25 words per minute for up to 1 hour, until supplies run out, or until stopped.

magic-item:dispelling-ammunition.description: When it damages a target, any ongoing spell of level 3 or lower on that target ends. Nonmagical afterward.

magic-item:dissuader.description: +1 Quarterstaff. Each property once per dawn: Calm Emotions (DC 15); a 1-minute 30-ft Emanation that can force a DC 15 Wis save or Frightened until its next turn; and a Reaction when a creature comes within 5 ft that pushes chosen creatures in 30 ft up to 30 ft away (DC 15 Str save).

magic-item:dream-weaver.description: A tapestry showing your dreams. Within 30 ft of it: study it during a Long Rest to roll a d20 you can later swap in for one D20 Test; it records the caster of any Dream spell aimed at you; and you have Advantage on Int, Wis, and Cha saves while Unconscious.

magic-item:elocutionist-s-lexicon.description: Magic action: the dictionary opens to the exact word you're trying to recall.

magic-item:ensorcelled-missive.description: A sheet of parchment you seal with a word or phrase. Opened without it, the writing reads as unintelligible script.

magic-item:evergreen-fertilizer.description: Sprinkled around a nonmagical plant, keeps it healthy for 365 days.

magic-item:goading-ammunition.description: On a damaging hit, the target makes a DC 13 Cha save or can't take Reactions until the start of its next turn. Nonmagical afterward.

magic-item:grave-reaper.description: +2 Sickle that deals an extra 2d8 Necrotic on a hit. Once per dawn, cast Spirit Lantern from it (DC 17) with room for five soul fragments.

magic-item:homeward-compass.description: Magic action: fix the needle on your current spot; it points there from then on (spins if unset or on another plane). One location at a time.

magic-item:idol-of-good-fortunes.description: Evolving. Blemished (Uncommon): Augury once per dawn. Tarnished (Rare): +1 AC, and a Magic action turns a trade bar or gemstone into coin of equal value. Golden (Very Rare): Globe of Invulnerability once per dawn.

magic-item:keyholes-dagger.description: Evolving. Three (Uncommon): +1, turns into a Handaxe or Mace until your next turn, using Str or Dex. Ten (Rare): +2, any Simple Melee form. Many (Very Rare): +3, adds Battleaxe, Longsword, Rapier, Scimitar, or Warhammer, and a once-per-dawn reroll of a miss.

magic-item:life-sapping-blade.type: Weapon (Any Melee Weapon with the Finesse Property)
magic-item:life-sapping-blade.description: +1 weapon. Hits deal an extra 2d4 Necrotic and block healing until the end of the target's next turn. A creature it drops to 0 HP dies and can return only through Resurrection or True Resurrection.

magic-item:lucky-foot.description: Reroll a natural 1 on a save or ability check; you must use the new roll, and the foot disintegrates.

magic-item:mage-breaker.description: +1 Dagger. A creature it damages while concentrating makes that Concentration save with Disadvantage.

magic-item:mage-s-manacle.description: Magic action: a Grappled or Incapacitated Large-or-smaller creature within 5 ft makes a DC 15 Dex save or is chained to you, Restrained and moving with you, for up to 8 hours. Only Disintegrate harms the chain. Once per dawn.

magic-item:magewright-s-gloves.description: Crafting nonmagical items with alchemist's, brewer's, calligrapher's, cartographer's, glassblower's, or jeweler's tools, you work as fast as two characters.

magic-item:martialist-s-quarterstaff.description: 4 charges, regains 1d4 at dawn. 2 charges: Searing Smite (DC 13). 1 charge on the Attack action: Thrown (20/60) and returns until your next turn ends. 1 charge on a melee attack: Advantage, and a hit forces a DC 13 Str save or Prone.

magic-item:masquerader-s-brooch.description: Bonus Action: a 1-hour illusion restyles everything you wear and carry (DC 13 Investigation on a Study action sees through it). Magic action: Alter Self, Change Appearance only, no Concentration.

magic-item:namer-s-needle.description: +1 Dagger. On a hit, the target makes a DC 15 Wis save or says its name (a success grants 24-hour immunity). Once per dawn, say the target's name on a hit to make it a Critical Hit.

magic-item:necklace-of-the-beastly-famil.description: Casts Find Familiar once per dawn. Magic action (familiar within 60 ft): the familiar becomes a Beast for 10 minutes, keeping its HP and gaining Temporary Hit Points equal to the Beast's HP. Gem sets the form: Azurite Giant Octopus (Uncommon), Chrysoprase Giant Scorpion or Zircon Hippopotamus (Rare), Topaz Mammoth (Very Rare), Fire Opal Tyrannosaurus Rex (Legendary).

magic-item:orb-of-divination-detection.description: Glows green while you are the target of a Divination spell. Works as an Arcane Focus.

magic-item:orb-of-sorcery.description: Magic action once per dawn: regain up to 2 Sorcery Points. Works as a Sorcerer Spellcasting Focus.

magic-item:potion-of-dragon-s-breath.description: Gain Dragon's Breath for 1 minute (DC 13, no Concentration). Color sets the damage: black Acid, blue Lightning, green Poison, red Fire, white Cold.

magic-item:potion-of-tirelessness.description: For 24 hours you need no sleep, magic can't put you to sleep, and a Long Rest takes 4 hours of quiet, conscious focus.

magic-item:prismatic-rune.description: Pick Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder each Long Rest. 6 charges (regains 1d6 at dawn): spend 1 to change a damaging spell's damage to that type.

magic-item:queen-ehlissa-s-marvelous-nig.description: Magic action: the clockwork bird sings for 10 minutes (then rests 1 hour). While it sings within 60 ft: Bonus Action casts from 6 charges (regains 1d6 + 1, DC 18): Detect Evil and Good or Speak with Animals (0), Calm Emotions (1), Slow (2), Compulsion (3), Greater Restoration (4), Delayed Blast Fireball or Prismatic Spray (6); a 15-ft Zone of Truth around it; and a once-per-dawn Reaction Counterspell. Has artifact random properties.

magic-item:ring-of-candor.description: +5 to Wisdom (Insight) checks; Zone of Truth (DC 13) once per dawn.

magic-item:ring-of-dedicated-focus.description: When you fail a Concentration save, spend up to two Hit Point Dice and add the roll to the save.

magic-item:robe-of-thayan-arcana.attunementNote: by a Sorcerer, Warlock, or Wizard
magic-item:robe-of-thayan-arcana.description: +1 spell save DC and spell attack bonus; treat 1s on spell damage dice as 2s; works as a Spellcasting Focus.

magic-item:scarlet-spellbook.description: Works as a spellbook and Arcane Focus. Arcane Recovery also heals 2d6 + half your Wizard level, and Memorize Spell can swap one extra prepared spell for one in this book.

magic-item:scholar-s-anchoring-bangle.description: On Study-action Intelligence checks with a proficient skill, a d20 roll of 9 or lower counts as 10. Once per dawn, a Reaction turns a failed Concentration save into a success.

magic-item:secret-keeper-s-circlet.description: Magic action once per dawn: set a trigger. If it happens within 24 hours, your memory from setting it until the trigger is erased; only Wish restores it.

magic-item:sniper-s-bracelet.type: Weapon (Heavy Crossbow, Light Crossbow, Longbow, Musket, Pistol, or Shortbow)
magic-item:sniper-s-bracelet.description: Magic action: switch between weapon and bracelet. In weapon form with no ammunition, it makes a vanishing magic shot for each ranged attack.

magic-item:spell-component-ring.description: Magic action: store the non-costed, non-consumed Material component of one prepared spell. While worn, casting that spell needs no free hand for it.

magic-item:spell-duelist-s-trophy.description: Slot-cast spells need no Somatic components; cast Mage Hand from it; once per dawn, a melee spell attack hit also casts Dispel Magic on the target.

magic-item:spell-fueling-armor.description: Treat 1s on spell damage dice as 2s. Once per dawn, on a Short Rest, recover expended spell slots totalling up to level 3.

magic-item:spell-slinger-s-puppet.description: Bonus Action: the doll hovers within 30 ft for 1 minute and moves 30 ft per Bonus Action. You can speak through it, including Verbal components when you can't speak.

magic-item:spirit-binding-censer.description: 10 charges, regains 1d6 at dawn. Cast at DC 18: Bless (1), Dispel Magic or Remove Curse (3), Banishment (4), Circle of Power (5).

magic-item:staff-of-skulls.description: Evolving. Ominous (Uncommon): Chill Touch, Advantage on Intimidation, dim green glow. Chattering (Rare): Reaction to impose Disadvantage on an attack roll within 30 ft. Pulverizing (Very Rare): once per dawn, a Humanoid you point at makes a DC 17 Con save for 10d8 Necrotic and Prone (half only on a success).

magic-item:staff-of-the-lost.description: +1 Quarterstaff with 3 charges (nonmagical when spent): cast Maze (DC 18) or Teleport. Cursed: you won't part with it, never know north, have Disadvantage on Survival checks to navigate, and each charge spent has a 1 in 20 chance to summon 1d4 hostile Minotaurs of Baphomet.

magic-item:staff-of-the-spirit-aegis.description: +3 Quarterstaff; Resistance to Necrotic while held. Once per dawn, a 1-hour 30-ft Emanation gives chosen creatures Resistance to Cold, Necrotic, and Psychic, Advantage against Frightened, and imposes Disadvantage on Undead attacking them. Bonus Action: the skull glows 15 ft bright and reveals Invisible things in its light.

magic-item:sweeping-broom.description: Magic action: the broom sweeps a 20-ft square within 60 ft until you stop it.

magic-item:thayan-sword.description: +1 weapon with 4 charges (regains 1d4 at dawn): 1 charge for Searing, Thunderous, or Wrathful Smite (DC 15). Once per dawn, drop to 1 HP instead of 0 while holding it.

magic-item:thespian-s-playbill.description: Add your Charisma modifier (min +1) to Study-action Intelligence checks.

magic-item:thief-s-thimble.description: Absorbs damage from traps you trigger, with 30 HP; breaks at 0 and you take the rest.

magic-item:tramontane-armor.description: +1 AC; looks like a robe. Ignore extra movement from snow, ice, rubble, or undergrowth. Once per dawn, a Magic action activates tendrils for 1 minute: each Bonus Action, chosen creatures within 20 ft make a DC 15 Str save or are Grappled (escape DC 15) and pulled 20 ft toward you.

magic-item:trick-weapon.type: Weapon (Any Simple or Martial Melee Weapon)
magic-item:trick-weapon.description: Magic action: disguise it as a mundane object (bracelet, comb, crutch, coin, hairpin, bell, pendant, card, quill, or spoon) or change it back. Can't attack while disguised.

magic-item:universal-pantograph.description: Duplicates any nonmagical item placed inside. Magic action: grow it to hold a Medium creature; with 100 GP of diamond dust, cast Clone on the occupant. The lid then stays shut for 120 days while the clone grows, and that clone needs no vessel.

magic-item:wand-of-enthralling.description: 4 charges, regains 1d4 at dawn. 1 charge: Enthrall (DC 15).

magic-item:wand-of-freshness.description: 4 charges, regains 1d4 + 1 at dawn. 1 charge: Purify Food and Drink.

magic-item:wand-of-slumber.description: 7 charges, regains 1d6 + 1 at dawn (1 in 20 to be destroyed on the last). Sleep (DC 15) for 1 charge or Catnap for 3.

magic-item:wand-of-teeth.description: 10 charges, regains 1d10 at dawn (1 in 20 to be destroyed on the last). Magic action, 1 to 3 charges: 30-ft Cone, DC 15 Dex save, that many d8 Piercing and Poisoned until your next turn; half damage only on a success.

magic-item:wave-swept-weapon.type: Weapon (Greatsword, Longsword, Rapier, Scimitar, or Shortsword)
magic-item:wave-swept-weapon.description: Evolving. Barnacled (Uncommon): +1 and turn a gallon of liquid briny. Aquatic (Rare): +2, glows, water breathing and Swim 30 ft. Ascendant (Very Rare): +3 and Fly 30 ft while held.

magic-item:workshop-wrecker.description: Magic action once per dawn: a ricocheting ball for 1 minute. On activation and each of your turns, creatures in the enclosed space make a Dex save for Bludgeoning damage scaled to room size: 15-ft Cube DC 18, 6d6 + 5; 30-ft DC 17, 4d6 + 4; 50-ft DC 15, 2d6 + 2; 100-ft DC 14, 1d6 + 1. Outdoors it just flies away.

magic-item:adamantine-weapon.description: Every hit this weapon or piece of ammunition makes against an object is a Critical Hit.

magic-item:alchemy-jug.description: Magic action: name a liquid from its table (acid, basic poison, beer, honey, mayonnaise, oil, vinegar, fresh or salt water, wine) and pour it as a Utilize action, up to 2 gallons a minute. Each liquid has a daily maximum; once it starts a liquid it cannot switch until the next dawn.

magic-item:apparatus-of-kwalish.description: A 500-pound iron barrel (DC 20 Investigation to find the hatch) that two Medium creatures can crew; ten levers turn it into a Large lobster-like vehicle (AC 20, 200 HP, Speed and Swim 30 feet, airtight, dives to 900 feet) with claws, lights and other lever functions.

magic-item:axe-of-the-dwarvish-lords.description: A +3 battleaxe; a natural 20 adds 20 Slashing, it is Thrown (20/60) and returns to your hand, and ranged hits add 1d8 Force (2d8 against Giants). Attuned: Darkvision 60 feet (or +60), Constitution +2 (max 20), proficiency with Brewer's, Mason's and Smith's tools, Immunity to Poison and Resistance to Fire, and maximum damage to objects. Magic action once per dawn: summon an obedient Earth Elemental for 24 hours. Every 3 days, touch dwarven stonework to cast Teleport without mishap underground. Random properties: 2 minor and 1 major beneficial, 2 minor detrimental.

magic-item:baba-yaga-s-dancing-broom.description: Magic action: the broom becomes an Animated Broom under your control, acting after you; command it mentally within 30 feet and turn it back with a Bonus Action. It regains its Hit Points if reverted before being destroyed.

magic-item:blackrazor.description: A sentient +3 greatsword (Chaotic Neutral) that hungers for souls. Hitting Undead costs you 1d10 Necrotic and heals them. While held: Immunity to Charmed and Frightened, Blindsight 30 feet. Dropping a creature to 0 slays it and devours its soul (only Wish restores it), granting Temporary Hit Points equal to its Hit Point maximum. It can cast Haste on you once per dawn, at its own discretion. Three days without a soul brings a conflict with its wielder.

magic-item:book-of-exalted-deeds.description: Only the attuned can open it; Fiends and Undead who read it take 24d6 Radiant. Attuned: Immunity to Charmed and Frightened and Resistance to Psychic. After 80 hours of study: those become permanent, Wisdom +2 (max 24), spell slots count one level higher, and a halo (Bonus Action) gives Advantage on Persuasion and Disadvantage to attacks from Fiends and Undead in its light. Benefits need a kind act every 10 days and no willing evil. Random properties: 2 minor and 2 major beneficial.

magic-item:book-of-vile-darkness.description: Non-Fiend, non-Undead attuners make a DC 17 Charisma save or become a Larva. After 80 hours of study: raise one ability by 2 (max 24) and lower another by 2, Immunity to Exhaustion, cast Animate Dead, Circle of Death, Dominate Monster and Finger of Death once each per dawn (DC 18), Advantage on lore checks about evil, and Vile Speech (Magic action: 1d12 Psychic to you, 3d6 to non-Fiend, non-Undead creatures within 15 feet). Requires an evil act every 10 days. Random properties: 3 minor and 1 major beneficial, 3 minor and 2 major detrimental.

magic-item:cap-of-water-breathing.description: Underwater, a Magic action creates an air bubble around your head that lets you breathe until you take off the cap or leave the water.

magic-item:cube-of-summoning.description: Magic action once per dawn: wind the crank and a creature appears, from a random Summon spell (Aberration, Beast, Construct, Dragon, Elemental or Fey) cast at level 5 (save DC 17, +9 to hit) without Concentration, with you as caster.

magic-item:driftglobe.description: Within 60 feet, command it to shine as Light or Daylight (Daylight once per dawn). Magic action: it floats up to 5 feet off the ground and follows you within 60 feet until grasped.

magic-item:efreeti-chain.description: +3 AC, Immunity to Fire damage, you know Primordial, and you can walk on molten rock.

magic-item:enspelled-armor.description: Holds an Abjuration or Illusion spell of level 8 or lower; 6 charges (1d6 back at dawn), 1 charge to cast it. Spell level sets rarity and DC: cantrip or 1 Uncommon (DC 13, +5), 2 Rare (13, +5), 3 Rare (15, +7), 4 Very Rare (15, +7), 5 Very Rare (17, +9), 6 Legendary (17, +9), 7 or 8 Legendary (18, +10).

magic-item:enspelled-staff.description: Holds a spell of any school, level 8 or lower; 6 charges (1d6 back at dawn), 1 charge to cast it; spending the last charge risks a 1 in 20 chance it becomes a plain Quarterstaff. Rarity and DC follow the spell level as for Enspelled Armor.

magic-item:enspelled-weapon.description: Holds a Conjuration, Divination, Evocation, Necromancy or Transmutation spell of level 8 or lower; 6 charges (1d6 back at dawn), 1 charge to cast it. Rarity and DC follow the spell level as for Enspelled Armor.

magic-item:executioner-s-axe.description: +1 weapon; a hit on a Humanoid deals an extra 2d6 Slashing and gives you that much in Temporary Hit Points.

magic-item:eye-and-hand-of-vecna.description: Two artifacts; attuning grafts the eye or hand on permanently (removal kills you) and makes you Neutral Evil. Eye: Truesight 240 feet, 8 charges (1d4 + 4 at dawn) for Clairvoyance, Crown of Madness, Disintegrate, Dominate Monster and Eyebite (DC 18) with a 5 percent chance per casting that Vecna takes your body, and 1 minute of 30-foot X-ray vision as a Magic action. Hand: Strength 20, an extra 2d8 Cold on melee hits, and 8 charges for Finger of Death, Sleep, Slow and Teleport (DC 18), each casting answered by a Suggestion to do evil. Both: Advantage on Initiative, a 7d6 Necrotic touch (DC 18 Constitution) that turns victims to green slime, Immunity to Poison, regenerate 1d10 a turn, and Wish once per 30 days. Each has 1 minor and 1 major beneficial, 1 minor detrimental random property.

magic-item:hag-eye.description: 3 charges (all back at dawn): spend 1 to cast Darkvision on yourself or See Invisibility. A hag of the coven that made it can see through it while concentrating.

magic-item:instrument-of-the-bards.description: Attuned Bards cast its spells once each per dawn with their own ability and DC; others who play it make a DC 15 Wisdom save or take 2d4 Psychic. All cast Fly, Invisibility, Levitate and Protection from Evil and Good, plus: Doss lute and Fochlucan bandore and Mac-Fuirmidh cittern (Uncommon), Canaith mandolin and Cli lyre (Rare), Anstruth harp (Very Rare), Ollamh harp (Legendary), each with its own spell set.

magic-item:keoghtom-s-ointment.description: A jar of 1d4 + 1 doses. Utilize action: swallow one or apply it to a creature within 5 feet, which regains 2d8 + 2 Hit Points and stops being Poisoned.

magic-item:lute-of-thunderous-thumping.description: A magic Club that deals an extra 2d8 Thunder on a hit. A Bard who sings or hums while attacking can use Charisma instead of Strength for the attack.

magic-item:mariner-s-armor.description: Swim Speed equal to your Speed, and once per dawn, starting your turn underwater at 0 Hit Points restores 1d4 Hit Points.

magic-item:moonblade.type: Weapon (Greatsword, Longsword, Rapier, Scimitar, or Shortsword)
magic-item:moonblade.attunementNote: by a Creature of the Weapon's Choice
magic-item:moonblade.description: A sentient elven blade that chooses its bearer; a rejected attuner is cursed with Disadvantage on D20 Tests for 24 hours. For anyone else it is a plain weapon. Its first rune gives +1, and each further rune (typically 1d6 + 1 in all) adds a property: up to +3, up to 3d6 extra Force, Thrown and returning, crits on 19 to 20, a blinding flash (DC 15 Constitution, once per Short Rest), Ring of Spell Storing, or a Shadow servant. It also has a minor property.

magic-item:potion-of-comprehension.description: Grants the effect of Comprehend Languages for 1 hour.

magic-item:potion-of-fire-breath.description: For up to 1 hour, three times: Bonus Action to breathe fire at a target within 30 feet, DC 13 Dexterity save for 4d6 Fire, half on a success.

magic-item:potion-of-pugilism.description: For 10 minutes, your Unarmed Strikes deal an extra 1d6 Force on a hit.

magic-item:quaal-s-feather-token.description: A single-use token of one type: Anchor (Uncommon, a ship cannot move for 24 hours), Bird (Rare, a non-attacking Roc that carries 500 pounds at 16 mph), Fan (Uncommon, fills one ship's sails for 8 hours), Swan Boat (Rare, a 50-foot self-propelled boat for 24 hours), Tree (Uncommon, a 60-foot oak), or Whip (Rare, a floating whip for 1 hour making +9 Bonus Action attacks for 1d6 + 5 Force).

magic-item:quiver-of-ehlonna.description: Never weighs more than 2 pounds; holds 60 arrows or bolts, 18 javelins, and 6 long items such as bows, staffs or spears, drawn like a normal quiver.

magic-item:rival-coin.description: 1 charge per dawn: toss it as a Magic action. Heads, a creature within 60 feet makes a DC 13 Wisdom save or takes 2d4 Psychic and has Disadvantage on its next attack (half damage only on a success); tails, you take 1d4 Psychic.

magic-item:rod-of-the-pact-keeper.description: +1, +2 or +3 (Uncommon, Rare, Very Rare) to Warlock spell attacks and save DCs, and once per Long Rest regain one spell slot as a Magic action.

magic-item:saddle-of-the-cavalier.description: While you ride in it: attacks against your mount have Disadvantage, and you cannot be dismounted against your will unless Incapacitated.

magic-item:scroll-of-protection.description: Protects against one creature type. Magic action to read: for 5 minutes, creatures of that type cannot enter or affect a 5-foot Emanation around you; one can try to break in with a DC 15 Charisma save. Moving onto them ends it.

magic-item:scroll-of-titan-summoning.description: Magic action to read: a titan (Animal Lord, Blob of Annihilation, Colossus, Elemental Cataclysm, Empyrean, Kraken or Tarrasque) appears within 1 mile, Hostile to everyone, until it drops to 0 Hit Points. Fails if there is no room.

magic-item:silvered-weapon.description: Critical Hits against shape-shifted creatures deal one extra damage die.

magic-item:spirit-board.description: 3 charges (1 back at dawn): spend 1 minute touching the planchette to cast Augury (1 charge) or Commune (3 charges).

magic-item:staff-of-the-adder.description: Bonus Action: the head becomes a live snake for 1 minute; one Attack-action attack uses it (Proficiency Bonus + WIS, reach 5 feet) for 1d6 Piercing plus 3d6 Poison. The head has AC 15 and 20 Hit Points; if it drops to 0 the staff is destroyed.

magic-item:sword-of-answering.description: +3 longsword; a Reaction lets you attack with Advantage a creature in reach that damages you, ignoring its Resistance and Immunity.

magic-item:sword-of-kas.description: A sentient +3 longsword (Chaotic Evil) that crits on 19 to 20, deals an extra 2d10 Slashing to Undead, and wants Vecna's ruin. Unblooded within a minute of drawing, it forces a DC 15 Charisma save: 3d6 Psychic, or be dominated until it tastes blood. Casts Call Lightning, Divine Word and Finger of Death once each per dawn (DC 18). Add 1d10 to Initiative, shift its attack bonus to AC, and Resistance to Necrotic. Random properties: 1 minor and 1 major beneficial, 1 minor and 1 major detrimental.

magic-item:sword-of-vengeance.type: Weapon (Glaive, Greatsword, Longsword, Rapier, Scimitar, or Shortsword)
magic-item:sword-of-vengeance.description: +1 weapon carrying a curse: you will not part with it, other weapons attack with Disadvantage, and when damaged in combat you make a DC 15 Wisdom save or must fight that attacker. Banishment on the sword frees the spirit, leaving a plain +1 weapon.

magic-item:sylvan-talon.type: Weapon (Dagger, Rapier, Scimitar, Shortsword, Sickle, or Spear)
magic-item:sylvan-talon.description: You understand the nonwritten communication of Fey and they understand yours; once per dawn, cast Message through it.

magic-item:tentacle-rod.description: Magic action: three tentacles attack creatures within 15 feet at +9, 1d6 Psychic each. All three on one target forces a DC 15 Dexterity save or Restrained, taking 3d6 Psychic each turn (repeats the save each turn).

magic-item:tome-of-the-stilled-tongue.description: A spellbook and arcane focus; once per dawn, cast a spell written in it as a Bonus Action with no slot, Verbal or Somatic components. Removing the tongue erases it. Vecna watches its users.

magic-item:wand-of-orcus.description: Non-Orcus attuners make a DC 17 Constitution save: 10d6 Necrotic on a success, death (and a Zombie, if Humanoid) on a failure. A sentient +3 Mace dealing an extra 2d12 Necrotic, +3 AC while held, destroys Holy Water within 10 feet, 7 charges (1d4 + 3 at dawn) for Animate Dead, Blight, Circle of Death, Finger of Death, Power Word Kill and Speak with Dead (DC 18), and once per dawn calls 15 Skeletons and 15 Zombies until dawn. Random properties: 2 minor and 1 major beneficial, 2 minor and 1 major detrimental.

magic-item:wave.description: A sentient +3 trident (Neutral) devoted to sea gods; a natural 20 deals an extra 21 Necrotic. While held: Advantage on Initiative and an air bubble underwater. 3 charges (1d3 at dawn) for Dominate Beast (DC 20) on swimming Beasts, and level 9 Globe of Invulnerability once per dawn.

magic-item:whelm.attunementNote: by a Dwarf or a Creature Attuned to a Belt of Dwarvenkind
magic-item:whelm.description: A sentient +3 warhammer (Lawful Neutral) for dwarves; Thrown (60/180) and returning, ranged hits add 1d8 Force (4d8 against Constructs, Elementals and Giants). Once per dawn, a Magic action shock wave Stuns chosen creatures on the ground within 60 feet (DC 20 Constitution, repeats each turn). Senses secret doors within 30 feet and casts Detect Evil and Good or Locate Object once per dawn.

magic-item:wraps-of-unarmed-power.description: +1, +2 or +3 (Uncommon, Rare, Very Rare) to Unarmed Strike attack and damage, which can deal Force instead of their normal type.

magic-item:boots-of-the-winding-path.description: Bonus Action: teleport up to 15 feet to an unoccupied space you can see that you occupied earlier this turn.

magic-item:dazzling-weapon.description: +1 to attack and damage. Bonus Action to shed Bright Light 30 feet and Dim Light 30 more, or to douse it. 4 charges (regains 1d4 at dawn): Reaction right after you're hit by an attack roll, spend 1 so the attacker makes a DC 15 Con save or is Blinded until the end of its next turn.

magic-item:helm-of-awareness.description: Advantage on Initiative rolls while worn.

magic-item:manifold-tool.description: Magic action: becomes any type of Artisan's Tools, and you are proficient with it in any form.

magic-item:mind-sharpener.description: 4 charges (regains 1d4 at dawn). When you fail a Concentration save, Reaction and 1 charge to succeed instead.

magic-item:repeating-shot.type: Weapon (Any Simple or Martial with Ammunition)
magic-item:repeating-shot.description: +1 to ranged attack and damage rolls, ignores Loading, and creates a piece of magic ammunition when fired empty that vanishes after the shot.

magic-item:repulsion-shield.description: +1 AC beyond the shield. 4 charges (regains 1d4 at dawn): Reaction when a Large or smaller creature within 5 feet hits you with a melee attack, spend 1 to push it 15 feet away.

magic-item:returning-weapon.type: Weapon (Any Simple or Martial with Thrown)
magic-item:returning-weapon.description: +1 to attack and damage; returns to your hand right after a ranged attack.

magic-item:spell-refueling-ring.description: Bonus Action: recover one expended spell slot of level 3 or lower. Once per dawn.

magic-item:reliquary-of-dawn.description: A talisman holding a claw, scale or fang shed by Eirdu, the sun incarnation of Lorwyn. While you wear it, you are immune to the effects of Eventide.

magic-item:reliquary-of-twilight.description: A talisman holding a claw, scale or fang shed by Isilu, the moon incarnation of Shadowmoor. While you wear it, you are immune to the effects of Morningtide.

magic-item:alarm-pylon.description: A 5-foot rune-etched stone post. Touch it as a Magic action to arm it with one trigger: a spell of a named school is cast, a creature takes 5 or more damage, or an object takes 10 or more damage. While armed, the trigger occurring within 300 feet sets off a 10-second alarm audible 300 feet away. Disarm it with a Magic action.

magic-item:silencing-satchel.description: 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn. As a Magic action, spend 1 charge and pull the drawstring: one creature you can see within 60 feet makes a DC 15 Charisma save or is cursed for 1 minute, its mouth sealed. It can't cast Verbal-component spells, drink potions, eat, or drink, and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns.

magic-item:sync-ring.description: On attuning, pick a blank book you are touching. Anything you then write with the ringed hand is copied into that book; magical writing copies as nonmagical text. Attunement ends if the book runs out of pages or spends more than 24 hours on another plane from you.

magic-item:unraveling-cloak.description: Take a Magic action to unbutton the hood: the cloak unravels behind you, leaving a continuous thread that others notice only with a Search action and a DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check. It stops after 100 miles or when you rebutton it (Magic action). Teleporting destroys the thread laid so far.

magic-item:wand-of-misdirection.description: 4 charges, regaining 1d4 at dawn. While holding it, spend 1 charge to cast Mislead.

magic-item:climber-s-ammunition.description: When this ammunition hits a solid surface it sticks there and trails a magic rope that lasts 1 hour or until dismissed and holds up to 500 pounds. Afterward the ammunition is nonmagical. If it hits a creature it breaks and deals no damage.

magic-item:goggles-of-foe-finding.description: While you wear these goggles, your ranged weapon attacks ignore Half Cover and Three-Quarters Cover.

magic-item:stormwalker-s-cloak.description: You have Resistance to Lightning and Thunder damage. The cloak has 3 charges, regaining all at dawn; spend 1 to cast Hellish Rebuke (save DC 13) dealing Lightning or Thunder damage instead of Fire.

magic-item:amulet-of-retributive-healing.description: 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn. When you restore Hit Points to another creature, you can spend 1 charge to regain the same number of Hit Points yourself.

magic-item:eternal-chalk.description: This chalk never breaks or wears down. You choose the color of its marks and whether they glow faintly, and no one but you can erase them for 7 days.

magic-item:salubrious-armor.description: You gain +1 to AC while wearing it. Whenever you regain Hit Points, it tints red and the bonus becomes +2 until the end of your next turn.

magic-item:frog-prince-statuette.description: Kiss it and speak the command word to cast Mandy's Feral Follower, turning it into a Commoner who remembers every previous transformation. Once per dawn.

magic-item:leonora-s-throne-of-indolence.description: A 100-pound flying armchair: sit and speak a command word (Magic action) to fly 50 feet with hover, carrying up to 400 pounds. A second command word casts Unseen Servant (it can also trumpet your arrival). Once per dawn, a third conjures up to 10 pounds of food and four bottles of wine that only you can enjoy.

magic-item:memento-mori.description: A sealed letter describing how its reader will die, never when. After reading it you have Advantage on Death Saves and die only after five failures, but if you drop to 0 HP in the described moment you die outright. It becomes an ordinary letter once read, and its effect ends only if you die and are revived.

magic-item:portable-cannonballs.description: Twenty inch-wide iron balls that pour out as Ball Bearings. As a Bonus Action command any of them to grow into 10-pound cannonballs; rolling ones force a DC 13 Dex save for 2d10 Bludgeoning and Prone (Large or smaller). Fired as a sling or firearm bullet and expanded mid-flight (Bonus Action), a hit deals 2d12 + the attack's ability modifier Bludgeoning.

magic-item:ring-of-barrels.description: 6 charges, regaining 1d6 at dawn. As a Magic action spend 1-3 to summon that many empty Barrels within 5 feet (AC 15, 20 HP, Half Cover, can be rolled). A Medium or smaller creature in a Barrel's space makes a DC 13 Dex save (with Advantage unless its Speed is 0) or is trapped: Restrained if Medium, Total Cover if smaller; escaping takes an action and a DC 20 Athletics check.

magic-item:bag-of-cheer.description: A 30-pound velvet sack of presents. As a Magic action pull out a gift (worth up to 100 GP) tailored to the recipient, chosen by the GM or rolled (weapon or Shield, gold, art, fine clothes, tool or instrument, Potion of Healing, gems, exotic food, book, toy or gaming set). Three per dawn; more are empty boxes.

magic-item:gambler-s-coin.description: 3 charges, regaining all at dawn. Spend 1 to replace a D20 Test roll with a coin flip: heads counts as 20 (no crit or other natural-20 effects), tails as 1.

magic-item:leaden-manacles.description: A bound creature that casts a spell or takes a Magic action makes a DC 20 check with its spellcasting ability; on a failure the attempt fails, the resources and action are wasted, and it takes 4d6 Fire.

magic-item:nolzur-s-painted-world.description: A Medium or Large painting that is a portal to a demiplane its painter designed; creatures that fit can step through, returning by a misty arch that vanishes if the painting's face is covered. Things taken out dissolve into smoke, and time inside runs at half speed.

magic-item:reaper-s-ammunition.description: A creature that takes damage from this ammunition dies. The ammunition then becomes nonmagical.

magic-item:soul-figurine.description: When you drop to 0 HP, your HP becomes 2d10 + 10 instead and the figurine turns sorrowful and nonmagical.

magic-item:weapon-charm-arrowhead.description: Attach or remove as a Magic action (one charm per weapon; the weapon becomes magic and needs attunement). Ranged attacks with the weapon ignore Half and Three-Quarters Cover.

magic-item:weapon-charm-blade.description: Attach or remove as a Magic action. The weapon gets +1 (Uncommon), +2 (Rare), or +3 (Very Rare) to attack and damage; it doesn't stack with an existing bonus.

magic-item:weapon-charm-die.description: Attach or remove as a Magic action. On a crit with the weapon, damage dice that roll their maximum add another die, up to 5 extra.

magic-item:weapon-charm-flame.description: Attach or remove as a Magic action. The weapon deals Fire and sets what it hits Burning for 1 minute; each further hit steps the burn die up (to 1d12).

magic-item:weapon-charm-hook.description: Attach or remove as a Magic action. As a Bonus Action teleport the weapon to your hand from anywhere on your plane.

magic-item:weapon-charm-lance.description: Attach or remove as a Magic action. Once per turn before a melee attack with it against a creature you can see, lunge up to 15 feet toward it without provoking (even through the air, falling after).

magic-item:weapon-charm-lightning-bolt.description: Attach or remove as a Magic action. The weapon deals Lightning and +1d6 Lightning on a hit.

magic-item:weapon-charm-quiver.description: Attach or remove as a Magic action. The weapon ignores Loading, and carried ammunition teleports into it as needed.

magic-item:airbag-shield.description: Cast Airbag from the shield on yourself once per dawn; touching it and expending a level 1+ slot as a Magic action restores the use.

magic-item:brewer-s-torch.description: A First Age torch fueled by potions: pour one in as a Magic action, then activate as a Magic action to consume it. Bubble Blowtorch: lift a loose object of 100 pounds or less 10 feet for 1 minute, movable as if 5 pounds. Butterfly Blowtorch: end one Charmed, Frightened, or Pacified effect on a creature within 5 feet, or Mend an object. Water Jet Blowtorch: a creature within 15 feet makes a DC 12 Dexterity save, 2d4 Slashing or half, or cut a 5-foot line through up to 1 foot of metal, stone, or wood.

magic-item:demon-rattle.description: +1 to saves against Demon effects. As a Magic action shake it; Demons in a 15-foot Emanation that hear it make a DC 15 Wisdom save or are Pacified while you keep shaking it each turn (ends if damaged or out of earshot). Once per dawn.

magic-item:healing-patches.description: Attach up to three over an hour; rip one off as a Bonus Action (or an ally does as a Magic action if you are Unconscious) to regain Hit Points: Healing Patch (Common) 1d8 + 3, 2nd Class (Uncommon) 2d8 + 6, 1st Class (Rare) 4d8 + 12.

magic-item:press-pass.description: As a Magic action press it to wood, plaster, or stone up to 5 feet thick to open a 3-by-7-foot doorway for 10 minutes (close it early as a Magic action). Once per dawn.

magic-item:soda-cursed.description: Drinking it curses you until a level 5+ Remove Curse or eating a pound of Black Cinnamon and bathing in still water. Each day one random spell slot or attuned item spell is expended; with none, take 2d10 Necrotic.

magic-item:welders-shawl.description: +3 to Intelligence (Mechanics) checks, and vehicles you repair regain Hit Points equal to your check -5 (minimum 3) instead of -10.

magic-item:whiskered-nakurina.description: As a Magic action, play to a Demon that can hear it and make a Charisma (Performance) check; it makes a Wisdom save against the result (maximum 20) or drops an item, moves its Speed in your chosen direction, or attacks a creature within 5 feet of your choice. If it succeeds, you take 2d4 Psychic.

magic-item:sacrificial-brand.description: A carving applied over an hour; removed only by burning (Scarified can't be removed). During the Blood Moon, Evil creatures in Luyarnha have Advantage to track you. Drawn (Common): that only. Tattooed (Uncommon): within 120 feet they know your location and get +1 to attack and damage against you. Scarified (Rare): +3 against you and -3 against others, but you bleed when hostile monsters within 300 feet know where you are and can't be surprised during the Blood Moon.

magic-item:meat-hookshot.description: Bonus Action to transform. Untransformed: a Finesse Sickle and one-handed Blunderbuss; after attacking with the Sickle, fire the Blunderbuss as a Bonus Action. Transformed: a two-handed Blunderbuss with a Battleaxe blade and Hookshot (Utilize action, ranged attack within 30 feet for 1d4 + Dex Slashing, pulling a creature your size or smaller to you on a failed DC 13 Strength save, or you to a larger one).

magic-item:dream-executioner.description: +1 weapon. Untransformed: Scythe and lantern that harvests the soul of a CR or level 1+ creature dying within 15 feet (one at a time; it can't be raised while held). Transformed: Maul whose hit can destroy the held soul for a 15-foot ghostflame burst, DC 14 Dexterity save, 2d8 Radiant plus 2d8 Necrotic or half (Undead fail).

magic-item:ravenous-gazer.description: +1 glaive you are proficient with. Transformed (costing 1d4 unpreventable Necrotic on transforming and each turn), it is a Spellcasting Focus granting +2 to spell attacks, +1 spell save DC, and Truesight 30 feet.

magic-item:unstable-crumbler.description: Double damage to structures and reduce Fire damage by your Constitution modifier. Transforming to Maul can blast you 30 feet; transforming to Cannon can reload it and push you back 30 feet on your next ranged hit. Cannon: on a 15+ the ball explodes as an Explosive Cannonball. Maul: on an 18+ the head detonates as Fireball (DC 15) on the target, which you can avoid with a successful save.

magic-item:galvanized-claw.description: Resistance to Lightning and Thunder. Untransformed gauntlet: Advantage on Initiative, +1d6 Lightning on melee hits while you have Temporary Hit Points, and 3 charges to turn Lightning or Thunder damage into Temporary Hit Points. Transformed claw: Unarmed Strikes deal 1d8 Slashing (+1, Str or Dex), a Bonus Action claw attack after the Attack action, and +1d8 Lightning while you have Temporary Hit Points; too clumsy for triggers or lockpicks.

magic-item:orphan-s-cradle.description: +1 Reach morningstar. Untransformed: Humanoids within 10 feet have Advantage against Charmed and Frightened; Cleansing Miasma (Magic action, 1d12 Temporary Hit Points and end Charmed, Frightened, or Poisoned, once per hour per creature); hits poison Beasts and Undead (DC 16 Constitution). Transformed: +2d6 Fire, Fanned Flames (20-foot Cone, DC 16 Dexterity, 3d6 Fire plus 3d6 Poison), and Withering Flames (Beast or Undead gains a Vulnerability on a failed DC 16 Constitution save).

magic-item:revelations.attunementNote: by a Creature with a Strength of 15 or Higher
magic-item:revelations.description: +1 weapon studded with eyes: you can't be surprised, unseen attackers gain no Advantage, and you are immune to Blinded. Cleaver: a hit curses the target for an hour (+1 damage, crits on 19 to 20, Advantage to track it). Whip: 1d6 Slashing, Versatile (1d8), once per turn Strength save or 1d6 Slashing and Prone. Curse: your sight secretly worsens until you go blind.

magic-item:shard-of-moonlight.description: Sentient +3 blade dealing +1d6 Radiant, with proficiency, Advantage on Wisdom saves (except against Madness), and use as a Spellcasting Focus. Longsword: once per turn make a second attack, and absorb spells targeting you as a Reaction for up to 10 charges. Greatsword (under moonlight, 1 minute): +2d6 Radiant and spend charges for Revealing Glow (+1d12 Radiant and the target glows), Transient Moonlight (60-foot Line, DC 18 Constitution, 2d12 Radiant), or Lunar Explosion (30-foot burst, DC 18 Dexterity, 3d12 Radiant and Prone).

magic-item:battle-rod.description: Held in two hands, cast cantrips at up to twice their range; beyond normal range, attack rolls have Disadvantage and targets have Advantage on saves.

magic-item:charlatan-s-gloves.description: As a Magic action, create a silent palm-sized illusory image for 1 minute (Concentration). A Study action and Investigation check against your Deception reveals it.

magic-item:drybrooch.description: As a Magic action, raise or dismiss a small overhead dome that sheds rain, snow, and similar nuisances (not hazards or attacks).

magic-item:duster.description: As a Magic action, instantly clean dirt and grime from up to 1 cubic foot within 10 feet.

magic-item:integrated-tool.description: A tool (Artisan's Tool, Forgery, Herbalism, or Poisoner's Kit, Thieves' Tools, or Musical Instrument) built into a warforged's body over 1 hour; it can't be removed against your will and still needs a free hand. One at a time; warforged only.

magic-item:lamplighter.description: As a Magic action, light or snuff a candle, torch, small campfire, or similar flame within 10 feet.

magic-item:spark.description: As a Bonus Action, touch a candle, torch, small campfire, or similar object to ignite it.

magic-item:talking-wand.description: While held, your voice and other sounds you make are three times as loud.

magic-item:thurimbar-rod.description: A Musical Instrument: as a Magic action, perfectly mimic the sound of any instrument you're proficient with (Charisma check sets quality); if proficient with the rod itself, play unearthly music.

magic-item:war-staff.description: Held in both hands, it's an Arcane Focus and your cantrips reach up to four times their range; beyond twice normal range, attack rolls have Disadvantage and targets have Advantage on saves.

magic-item:breastplate-of-kamvuul-norek.description: +2 AC, Critical Hits against you become normal hits, and Advantage on saves against spells and magical effects. When you succeed on a save against an Aberration's Mind Blast, you're unaffected and the blast reflects back at the Aberration.

magic-item:ghaal-duur-the-mighty-dirge.description: +4 Charisma (max 24); 2 minor beneficial and 1 minor detrimental property (goblinoids ignore it). As a two-handed focus, Bard spells get doubled duration (max 24 hours) and range, and cast one slot level higher. Once per Short or Long Rest as a Magic action, sound it: for 10 minutes allies within 600 feet add 1d4 (2d4 goblinoids) to attacks and saves, and enemies failing a Charisma save subtract 1d4 (2d4 goblinoids).

magic-item:keeper-s-fang.description: +1 to attack and damage. A creature it reduces to 0 HP is slain and its soul taken; only Wish can restore it.

magic-item:shaarat-doovol-the-blade-of-t.description: Sentient. +3 to attack and damage, and +2d10 Radiant against Aberrations. If it favors you, it grants Truesight 90 feet, immunity to Charmed and Frightened, and Resistance to Psychic damage.

magic-item:uul-kur-dream-key.description: Sleeping with it, you dream lucidly and remember your dreams. If you know its workings, as a Magic action bind it to your dreams until dawn; anyone sleeping with it shares your dream.
