A garishly painted fool's scepter whose grinning face resembles Chuckles, the Lord of Fools, while unattuned. While holding it you can use it as a Spellcasting Focus and gain its rarity's bonus to spell attack rolls and spell save DC.
Coulrophobia (Rare+). When you succeed on a save against being Frightened, you can use your Reaction to make the effect's creator make the same save or be Frightened until the end of your next turn.
Fortune's Fool (Rare+). You can cast Hideous Laughter (save DC 16 + the bonus). Once per dusk, or again after you roll a 1 on a D20 Test.
Fool's Motley (Very Rare+). You can cast False Life from it, your clothing or armor looking like motley while it lasts.
Slapstick (Very Rare+). When your Hideous Laughter affects a creature, choose another creature; when it damages the target, the target's save to end the spell has Disadvantage instead of Advantage.
Lord of Fools (Legendary). You can cast Mass Suggestion (save DC 19), ending on a creature behind Total Cover or more than 120 feet away; creatures under your Hideous Laughter fail automatically. Once per dusk.

magic-item:mask-of-lethica-nightborne.description:
A porcelain mask with violet filigree, once worn by a priestess of the Nightmother, goddess of night and healing. While worn it grants its rarity's bonus to Wisdom and Charisma saves.
Gift of the Night Goddess (Rare+). You see normally in magical and nonmagical Dim Light and Darkness.
Soothing Darkness (Rare+). Creatures of your choice in your Darkness spells have Resistance to Psychic damage.
Whispers of Night (Rare+). You can cast Darkness from it twice (four times at Very Rare+), regaining uses at dusk.
Balm of Midnight (Very Rare+). At the start of your turn, a Frightened creature of your choice within 60 feet makes a DC 15 Wisdom save; on a success the fear ends, and it gains 2d10 Temporary Hit Points if it is in Darkness.
Offering of Burdens (Legendary). As a Magic action, you take any number of Exhaustion levels from a willing creature you touch, then remove up to two from yourself and regain a spell slot of level 5 or lower. Once per dusk.
Surcease of Sorrows (Legendary). You can cast Modify Memory (save DC 19); a target that fails willingly can have any memory from its life altered. Once per dusk.

magic-item:midwife-shears.description:
Stork-shaped scissors that cut more than physical threads.
Cut the Unseen Thread. You can cast Dispel Magic (+4 bonus) or Remove Curse from them, each once per dusk.
Curse of the Severed Thread. You take a -1 penalty to saves against being pushed or knocked Prone, growing by 1 each time you use Cut the Unseen Thread; failing such a save by 5 or more pushes you an extra 1d6 x 5 feet away from the source.

magic-item:nectar-of-the-green-man.description:
Deep green liquid in a wooden bottle carved with a leafy face. Drinking it gives the effect of Commune with Nature, steeped in dread: make a DC 15 Wisdom save (automatic success if immune to Frightened) or for 8 hours you have Disadvantage on attacks and ability checks while you can see a forest.
Heightened Potency. You learn all five facts from Commune with Nature.

magic-item:nightwatcher-potion.description:
Midnight-blue liquid in an owl-painted clay bottle. For 24 hours you have Darkvision 120 feet and need no sleep, remaining conscious through a Long Rest.
Heightened Potency. The duration becomes 72 hours.

magic-item:planchette-of-adela-druskenva.description:
A heart-shaped silver pointer on a necklace, cold and heavy when laid on letters. While worn you can use it as a Spellcasting Focus and gain its rarity's bonus to Intelligence and Wisdom checks.
Sense the Unseen (Rare+). It has 5 charges (regaining 1d4 + 1 at dusk) to cast Detect Magic (1), Locate Object (2), or See Invisibility (2).
Starlight Ward (Rare+). You have Resistance to Radiant damage; taking Radiant damage makes its star sigils shed Bright Light 10 feet and Dim Light 10 more for 1 minute.
Vision Beyond (Very Rare+). It has 9 charges (regaining 1d8 + 1) and can also cast Find Traps (2) and Sending (3).
Spirit Ward (Very Rare+). When you fail a save against Magic Jar or possession, you can spend 3 charges to succeed.
Third Eye Opened (Legendary). It has 13 charges (regaining 1d12 + 1) and can also cast Divination (4) and Contact Other Plane (5).
Touch the Spirit World (Legendary). Spend 7 charges to cast Etherealness.

magic-item:reaper-s-revenge.description:
A skull-based bottle with scythes up its neck. Drinking it grants 3d8 Temporary Hit Points, and for 1 minute, when an enemy dies within 30 feet you can use your Reaction to regain 1d8 Hit Points.
Heightened Potency. For 1 minute, your damaging attack hits against Bloodied creatures deal an extra 1d8 Necrotic.

magic-item:revelry-suit.description:
A bulky suit of fur, canvas, and straw with an oversized, unsettlingly smiling sun mask. You gain +2 to AC while wearing it.
Dancing Dodge. When you fail a Dexterity save while your Speed isn't 0, you can succeed instead. Once per dusk.
Wild Steps. As a Bonus Action you move up to your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
Dancing Curse. When you roll Initiative, you make a Wisdom save (starting at DC 0) or are Incapacitated with Speed 0 until your next turn, folk dancing. Using Dancing Dodge or Wild Steps raises the DC by 2, at most once per Long Rest.

magic-item:runestone-of-the-wild-titan.description:
A 50-pound granite runestone thrumming with the wild titan's power. While held it grants its rarity's bonus to Strength and Constitution saves.
Crushing Weight (Rare+). As a Bonus Action within 5 feet of a Prone creature, you set the stone on it, Restraining it until it uses an action to succeed on a Strength save (DC 16 + the bonus).
Boulder Throw (Very Rare+). You can throw it as a Simple Ranged weapon (Heavy, Thrown; range twice your Strength score / five times it) using Strength; on a hit it deals 2d10 Bludgeoning and the target makes a Strength save (DC 16 + the bonus) or is knocked Prone.
Recall (Very Rare+). As a Bonus Action, it returns to your hand or feet from within 1 mile.
Primal Vitality (Legendary). While standing on fertile soil or unworked stone, you have Advantage on Strength and Constitution saves and gain 2d6 + your Strength modifier Temporary Hit Points at the start of each turn.
Pummeling Boulder (Legendary). Boulder Throw deals 3d10 and double damage to objects and structures.

magic-item:scythe-of-the-harvest-terror.description:
A rusted scythe tallying its kills in hatch marks, its haft wrapped in ancient cloth. It grants its rarity's bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Feed on Fear (Rare+). Once on your turn, a hit against a Frightened creature deals an extra 1d10 Psychic (2d10 at Legendary).
Sweep of Dread (Rare+). You can cast Fear (save DC 16 + the bonus, no Concentration). Once per dusk.
Harvest of the Hidden Word (Very Rare+). As a Bonus Action, a Frightened creature you can see makes a Charisma save (DC 16 + the bonus) or you learn one secret it deliberately keeps; it is then immune for 24 hours.
Seed of Terror (Very Rare+). Right after a hit, you can use a Bonus Action to force a creature within 30 feet of the target to make a Wisdom save (DC 16 + the bonus) or be Frightened until the end of your next turn.
Lurking Terror (Legendary). When a Frightened creature you can see ends its turn within 60 feet, you can use your Reaction to teleport up to 60 feet to a space it can see.

magic-item:shield-of-marius-renathyr.description:
A gold and white enamel shield bearing a thorn-wreathed rose, once carried by a doomed knight-errant. It grants its rarity's bonus to AC on top of the normal Shield bonus.
Valorous Guard (Rare+). When a creature within 5 feet is hit by an attack, or fails a Dexterity save, you can use your Reaction to add 2 + the shield's bonus to its AC or save total, possibly changing the result.
Honor of the Vanguard (Very Rare+). When you roll Initiative and an ally you can see is within 30 feet of an enemy, you can teleport next to that ally and gain Temporary Hit Points equal to 5 times the shield's bonus.
Righteous Wrath (Very Rare+). After Valorous Guard turns an attack into a miss, your next weapon or Unarmed Strike hit on that attacker before the end of your next turn deals an extra 1d8 Radiant (3d8 at Legendary).
As Terrible as the Dawn (Legendary). You can cast Flame Strike (save DC 19); if you are in the area, you regain 5d6 Hit Points instead of taking damage. Once per dusk.

magic-item:shovel-of-yorgrim.description:
A well-worn steel-bladed shovel on a makeshift walking stick that sometimes whispers, once used by Yorgrim of the Shadestone Clan to speak with the dead. It grants its rarity's bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Death-Kenning (Rare+). After hitting an Undead with it, you can use a Bonus Action to learn its Resistances, Immunities, and Vulnerabilities.
Deathspeaker (Rare+). You can cast Gentle Repose and Speak with Dead from it.
Deny Death's Touch (Very Rare+). You and allies in a 10-foot Emanation have Resistance to Necrotic damage.
Bind Deathly Servant (Legendary). When a Humanoid dies within 30 feet, you can use your Reaction to make its soul an obedient Specter (or a Wraith if it was Friendly to you), one at a time, lasting 8 hours, until you make another, or until it dies.
Psychopomp (Legendary). As a Magic action, you and a willing non-Undead creature you touch become wraithlike until the end of your next turn, moving through creatures and objects as Difficult Terrain (ending inside an object shunts you out with 1d10 Force). An Undead you touch instead makes a DC 19 Charisma save or is Vulnerable to all damage until your next turn. Three uses, regained at dusk.

magic-item:sight-of-sin.description:
A round flask bound in iron with a goat-skull ornament. For 10 minutes you gain the effect of Detect Magic (no Concentration) and Advantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks to discern hidden motives or deception.
Heightened Potency. You also gain the effect of See Invisibility.

magic-item:silence-of-the-drowned.description:
Coppery blue-green liquid in a tentacle-painted jar that hushes the air like deep water. For 10 minutes squid tentacles sprout from your mouth and you emanate Silence (no Concentration) in a 20-foot Emanation.
Heightened Potency. As a Bonus Action you can spit ink at a creature within 30 feet, which makes a DC 13 Dexterity save or is Blinded until the start of your next turn; on a success it is immune to this for 24 hours.

magic-item:staff-of-farryn-of-the-greenw.description:
A twisted, moss-grown staff crowned with a trinket-hung deer skull. While holding it you can use it as a Spellcasting Focus and gain its rarity's bonus to spell attack rolls and spell save DC.
Living Ward (Rare+). You have Resistance to Necrotic damage.
Servant of the Cycle (Rare+). You can cast Cure Wounds (level 3) from it, and your next hit before the end of your next turn deals an extra 1d10 Necrotic. Three uses, regained at dusk.
Cycle's Balance (Very Rare+). You can cast Revivify from it; the next creature to fail a save against one of your spells within the hour, and creatures of your choice within 20 feet of it, take 4d10 Necrotic. Once per dusk.
Sacrifice of Flesh (Very Rare+). When a spell you cast heals, you can take Necrotic damage up to twice its level (unpreventable), and the target regains three times that much extra.
Death Blossom (Legendary). When a creature you can see within 60 feet dies, you can use your Reaction to make flowers bloom; creatures of your choice within 30 feet of it regain 4d8 Hit Points and gain 2d8 Temporary Hit Points. Once per dusk.

magic-item:sword-of-the-crimson-abbot.description:
A sleek, light-drinking blade with a blood-red ruby set in thorns and roses, a fiendish gift to the fallen Crimson Abbot. It grants its rarity's bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Blood Drain (Rare+). Hits deal an extra 1d6 Necrotic.
Irresistible Hunger (Very Rare+). Your Necrotic damage ignores Resistance.
Vampiric Charm (Very Rare+). You can cast Charm Person (save DC 16 + the bonus, no Concentration). Once per dusk.
Embrace of the Duchess (Legendary). As a Magic action, you touch the sword to a Humanoid dead 1 minute or less; it makes a DC 19 Charisma save or rises as a Vampire Spawn that dies again at dawn. Once per dusk.
Stolen Life (Legendary). When Blood Drain deals damage, you can spend and roll a Hit Point Die, regaining the roll plus the Necrotic damage.

magic-item:the-bag.description:
A weathered, blood-stained satchel with three silver buckles that sometimes ripples from within. It works as a Bag of Holding.
Inhabitant. A Lurker in the Dark lives inside. At 0 Hit Points it vanishes and reappears in the bag at the next midnight, truly dying only if dropped by a creature holding a toy or stuffed animal once owned by a child; then the bag loses its magic and spills its contents.
The Bag's Claw. As a Bonus Action, the lurker claws a creature within 5 feet (+7 to hit, 1d10 + 4 Piercing), and a Medium or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 14) and Restrained while grappled. Three uses, regained at dusk.
Lurker's Curse. After each Long Rest, roll 1d6; on a 1 the lurker slipped out and caused mayhem nearby, such as attacking people, sickening livestock, or spoiling supplies.

magic-item:tincture-of-mourning.description:
Raincloud-colored, tear-like fluid in a bottle topped with a carved crypt angel. For 1 hour you weep inconsolably, can't be silent, and are immune to the Charmed condition (suppressing it if already Charmed).
Heightened Potency. Friendly creatures within 10 feet of you are also immune to Charmed.

magic-item:tooth-of-the-jinxed-leviathan.description:
A razor tooth usable as a Dagger, its grip wrapped in alligator hide and its flat aglow with magenta hex glyphs. It grants its rarity's bonus to attack and damage rolls and can serve as a Spellcasting Focus.
Jinx of Dire Fortune (Rare+). As a Bonus Action, a creature you can see within 60 feet makes a Charisma save (DC 16 + the bonus) or is jinxed for 1 minute, rerolling any even d20 on D20 Tests; if it succeeds, you make the same save or are jinxed yourself. Only one creature can be jinxed by it at a time.
Exposed Weak Spot (Very Rare+). Your attacks with it score a Critical Hit on a 19 or 20.
Steal Unluck (Very Rare+). When an enemy within 60 feet makes a D20 Test with Advantage, you can use your Reaction to negate it, then can't again until a creature you can see rolls a 1 on a D20 Test.
Strange Fortunes (Legendary). Each Critical Hit with it against an enemy adds a cumulative +3 to its damage rolls until you finish a Long Rest; rolling a 1 to attack with it deals you Force damage equal to the accumulated bonus.

magic-item:toy-riverboat.description:
A finely detailed toy paddle-steamer with a tiny, unearthly passenger in its cabin.
Passengers. As a Magic action, you and up to twelve willing Medium or smaller creatures within 30 feet shrink to Tiny and board it with up to 300 pounds of gear each. It travels on water at 3 miles per hour without wind for up to 12 hours a day; anyone leaving returns to normal size.
Unearthly Passenger. Released onto water, it lets you cast Arcane Eye with the boat as the sensor, moving only on water.
Haunting Curse. Each creature leaving the boat makes a Charisma save (starting at DC 0) or is cursed, with Disadvantage on Wisdom and Charisma checks and on saves against Frightened; after you make this save, the DC rises by 2, at most once per Long Rest.

magic-item:veil-of-the-weeping-widow.description:
A mourning veil said to hide otherworldly corruption in the widow's eyes. While worn it grants its rarity's bonus to Wisdom checks and saves.
Psychic Fortitude (Rare+). You have Resistance to Psychic damage.
Sense Grief (Rare+). You can cast Detect Thoughts (save DC 16 + the bonus).
Psychic Shock (Very Rare+). When a creature forces you to save against Psychic damage or to avoid or end Charmed or Frightened, you can use your Reaction to deal it 2d8 Psychic.
Thought Worm (Very Rare+). You can cast Modify Memory (save DC 16 + the bonus); on a failed save you can implant a White Worm parasite, letting you know the target's direction and distance on the same plane and cast Divination and Enchantment spells on it as if it were in range and sight, until Greater Restoration or Heal kills the parasite. Once per dusk.
Psychic Storm (Legendary). You get one extra Reaction each round, usable only for Psychic Shock.
Veiled Countenance (Legendary). A caster targeting you with a Divination spell makes a DC 19 Wisdom save or takes 6d8 Psychic and is Incapacitated for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns.

magic-item:visage-of-the-old-ways.description:
A haunted wooden mask with rabbit ears that hollows your eyes into shadow; an ancient forest archfey whispers in your mind. While worn it adds its rarity's bonus to your Fire damage rolls.
Cultic Mask (Rare+). Divination spells can't target you, scrying sensors can't perceive you, and checks to discern your identity have a minimum DC of 25.
Fire Within (Rare+). While you are burning, your weapon attacks deal an extra 2d4 Fire; you can start or stop burning as a Bonus Action.
Strange Sight (Rare+). You have Darkvision 60 feet and see normally through smoke.
Mastery of Flame (Very Rare+). Your Fire damage ignores Resistance.
Sacrificial Flame (Very Rare+). As a Bonus Action, a creature at 0 Hit Points you can see within 30 feet bursts into flame, burning to ash over a minute; hostile creatures starting their turn within 10 feet of it take 2d8 Fire. Healing it douses the flame.
Harvest Offering (Legendary). As a Magic action, spend up to 5 Hit Point Dice (or have a willing or Unconscious creature you touch spend theirs) to regain a spell slot of that level. Two uses, regained at dusk.

magic-item:whistle-of-the-vagrant.description:
The cold brass whistle of the Ghostlight Express's conductor, shrieking unnervingly. While held or worn it grants its rarity's bonus to all saves.
Call the Dead (Rare+). As a Magic action, you cast Gentle Repose on all corpses within 30 feet. Once per dusk.
Sense the Undead (Rare+). As a Bonus Action, you detect Undead within 60 feet, even through Total Cover other than iron or lead.
Undaunted (Rare+). Advantage on saves against Frightened.
Call the Undead (Very Rare+). As a Magic action, you cast Banishment on an Undead (save DC 16 + the bonus; creatures with Legendary Actions succeed automatically), sending it to a harmless train-carriage demiplane and, if held for the full duration, to its proper afterlife. Once per dusk.
Steam Cloud (Very Rare+). You can cast Fog Cloud (no Concentration). Once per dusk.
Touched by Death (Very Rare+). You have Resistance to Necrotic damage.
Afterlife Express (Legendary). You can cast Ghastly Charge (shaped as a ghost train) twice, regaining uses at dusk.

magic-item:withered-hand.description:
A desiccated, hex-tattooed hand on a leather cord whose fingers twitch at the edge of sight. While held or worn you gain +1 to spell attack rolls and spell save DC.
Withering Grasp. Your Unarmed Strikes can reach 30 feet on magenta threads, dealing Necrotic instead of Bludgeoning, and can Grapple a creature up to one size larger (escape DC using your spellcasting ability or Charisma); the grapple ends if you use this on another target.
Withering Curse. Using Withering Grasp lowers your Hit Point maximum by 1, at most once per Long Rest; the lost maximum doesn't return on a Long Rest.

magic-item:wytchwood-sap.description:
Oozing amber tar in a leaky bark vessel. As a Bonus Action, coat one weapon or up to three pieces of ammunition and choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Thunder; a creature damaged by it takes an extra 3d8 of that type. It lasts 1 minute or until its damage is dealt.
Heightened Potency. If two or more of those d8s match, another creature of your choice within 30 feet of the target takes 2d8 of the same type.

magic-item:boomerang-1.description: +1 to attack and damage rolls with this magic weapon. It is a ranged weapon; proficiency with the javelin covers it. On a miss it returns to the thrower's hand.

magic-item:boomerang-2.description: +2 to attack and damage rolls with this magic weapon. It is a ranged weapon; proficiency with the javelin covers it. On a miss it returns to the thrower's hand.

magic-item:boomerang-3.description: +3 to attack and damage rolls with this magic weapon. It is a ranged weapon; proficiency with the javelin covers it. On a miss it returns to the thrower's hand.

magic-item:master-s-amulet.description: Linked to one shield guardian, which protects the wearer and can absorb blows meant for them at a distance; the wearer can command it to attack or guard. If the amulet is destroyed, the guardian is incapacitated until a replacement is made (1 week, 1,000 gp). Unattended, the amulet has AC 10, 10 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage.

magic-item:niko-s-mace.description: 6 charges, regaining 1d6 at dawn. While holding it, expend 1 charge to cast Summon Celestial (+9 to hit with spell attacks).

magic-item:cap-of-vanishing.description: 3 charges, regained at dawn. As a Magic action, expend 1 to become Invisible for 10 minutes, ending if the cap is removed or you attack, deal damage or cast a spell.

magic-item:cloak-of-billowing-stranger-t.description: As a Bonus Action, make it billow dramatically for 1 minute, granting advantage on Performance checks to amuse Humanoid onlookers.

magic-item:dread-helm-stranger-things.description: Your eyes glow red and your face is shadowed while worn, granting Advantage on Intimidation checks against Humanoids who see you.

magic-item:holly-s-handy-haversack.description: Always weighs 5 pounds. Two side pouches each hold 200 pounds (25 cubic feet) and the central pouch 500 pounds (64 cubic feet); retrieving an item is a Utilize action or Bonus Action and it is always on top. Overloading, piercing or tearing destroys it and its contents; each pouch holds 10 minutes of air shared among occupants. Placing it in another extradimensional space destroys both and opens a one-way gate to the Astral Plane, pulling in creatures within 10 feet.

magic-item:pipes-of-pestilence.description: As a Magic action, summon a Friendly Swarm of Corrupted Rats within 60 feet that obeys you while you keep playing as a Magic action each round; when control ends it vanishes and the pipes can't be used until dawn.

magic-item:poison-soaked-kukri.description: Finesse, light, thrown (20/60). Once per day, as a Bonus Action, coat the blade for 1 minute or until it hits: the creature hit makes a DC 13 Constitution save or takes 2d8 Poison and is Poisoned for 1 minute.

magic-item:speaking-stones.description: A matched pair. Touching one, a Magic action sends a message of 25 words or fewer to the other's bearer at any distance, who can reply immediately and understands it; once per day for the pair. If one is destroyed, the other becomes nonmagical.

magic-item:spiked-shield.description: When you take the Attack action, one attack can be a shield bash (proficiency + Strength to hit) against a target within 5 feet for 2d6 + Strength Piercing. Once per day, as a Magic action, spikes erupt in a 30-foot Cone: DC 13 Dexterity save, 3d6 Piercing, half on success.

magic-item:adventurer-s-ring.description: With its cover open it produces a heatless, fuelless flame shedding Bright Light 20 feet and Dim Light 20 feet more; open or close it as a Bonus Action.

magic-item:mechanical-wonder.description: A dormant construct activated by winding its unique key for 1 minute (Utilize action each turn), running for the duration listed for its type. The uncommon domestic wonder is an allied household helper using the Domestic Wonder stat block that acts after you, obeys your commands and otherwise Dodges; other forms exist.

magic-item:thayan-spell-tattoo.description: Holds a chosen level 1 to 3 spell that you always have prepared and can cast with your slots (your spellcasting ability, or DC 13 and +5 without one). You can also cast it once without a slot or components, after which the tattoo vanishes, as it does if attunement ends. Inking one requires Red Wizard renown 50+, Arcana and calligrapher's supplies proficiency, and the cost and time of an equivalent spell scroll.

magic-item:mask-of-changed-appearance.description: 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn. As a Magic action, expend 1 to make minor cosmetic changes to your face for 1 hour, during which the mask is Invisible. Expending the last charge, on a d20 roll of 1 it bursts into harmless sweet powder.

magic-item:advanced-sensory-stone.description: As an action, activate it to record everything you sense for 1 hour, replacing prior contents; as an action, touch it to relive the recording as a harmless illusion lasting up to 1 hour.

magic-item:amulet-of-arcane-blade.description: Weapons you wield shed Dim Light in a 5-foot radius and count as magical.

magic-item:ballista-goblin.description: A Large mounted crossbow (AC 15, 30 HP, immune to Poison and Psychic) that takes an action each to load, aim and fire. Hexer bolt: ranged attack, +6, range 80/320 ft.; 11 (2d10) Piercing plus 7 (1d8 + 3) Psychic.

magic-item:barbarian-in-a-box.description: Twice per day, as an action, press its button to release Bob, a barbarian who attacks whatever you command and fights to the death, otherwise reciting poetry until you return him with another press. If activated twice in 24 hours, after his second task Bob is freed and wanders off.

magic-item:beret-of-boundaries.description: +1 bonus to Armor Class and saving throws.

magic-item:cloak-of-misty-step.description: Holds up to 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn. As a Bonus Action, expend 1 to cast Misty Step.

magic-item:flower-of-foresight.description: Worn, it grants Advantage on Initiative rolls and on rolls to find traps.

magic-item:glyph-of-wayward-travels.description: Standing in its linked teleportation circle, break it as a Bonus Action to teleport to the circle's predetermined destination. A circle's creator within 10 feet can link glyphs up to their proficiency bonus to it as an action.

magic-item:mirror-of-insight.description: A small silver mirror (AC 10, 3 HP, immune to Poison and Psychic, vulnerable to Bludgeoning). Viewed within 5 feet, it shows a scene, not always literal, of the viewer's greatest fear or desire, never repeating a scene for the same viewer.

magic-item:quickstep-clogs.description: Weigh and sound like slippers when worn. Once per Long Rest, cast Haste on yourself.

magic-item:weapon-of-blasting.description: While you laugh maniacally, a creature you hit makes a DC 15 Strength save or is pushed 15 feet away.

magic-item:weapon-of-cruelty.description: It shouts an insult at each creature it hits, which makes a DC 15 Wisdom save or has Disadvantage on its next attack, save or check.

magic-item:weapon-of-destruction.description: Once per Long Rest, speaking its chosen command phrase makes a hit deal triple damage.

magic-item:weapon-of-floating.description: Once per Long Rest, when you hit a creature you are affected by Levitate, rising up to 20 feet for 10 minutes or until you end it.

magic-item:weapon-of-living-through-it.description: While held, +5 AC and 5 temporary hit points lasting until depleted or a Long Rest, but you sound wildly overconfident no matter what you say.

magic-item:weapon-of-unrealized-ambition.description: Takes the form of a weapon you are proficient with. Once per Long Rest, a command word makes it sentient for 1 hour (Neutral Good; Int 8, Wis 7, Cha 8; hearing and darkvision 120 feet; speaks your languages and telepathy), adding 1 fire, cold, radiant or lightning damage to each hit; afterward it becomes a normal weapon.

magic-item:ebonbane.description: A sentient Chaotic Evil sword (Int 17, Wis 14, Cha 19; truesight 120 feet; speaks Common and telepathy) and darklord of the Shadowlands; attunement ends if you leave that domain. +3 to attack and damage, an extra 3d6 Necrotic against Celestials and Humanoids, and Advantage on saves against spells and magical effects. If it hasn't slain a Celestial or Humanoid in 3 days, at dawn you make a DC 17 Charisma save: success deals 8d8 Force to you, failure leaves you dominated until it is fed. It can be destroyed only by a weapon forged from the Four Keys.

magic-item:blade-of-the-guardian.description: A weapon of warning: within your reach while attuned, you and allies within 30 feet wake from natural sleep when combat starts and have Advantage on Initiative. It evolves: Rare, three times per day add 1d6 to a failed Study check; Very Rare, resistance to one damage type of the DM's choice; Legendary, truesight 30 feet.

magic-item:breastplate-of-the-tyrant.description: Resistance to Psychic damage. It evolves: Very Rare, cast Yolande's Regal Presence (DC 17) once per day; Legendary, cast Dominate Monster (DC 18) once per day.

magic-item:rod-of-the-honed-mind.description: It evolves: Rare, Advantage on Initiative and Perception checks; Very Rare, telepathy 30 feet and Synaptic Static (DC 17) once per day; Legendary, Mind Blank on yourself once per day.

magic-item:wand-of-celestial-prowess.description: +1 to spell attack rolls, ignoring half cover. It evolves: Rare, Crusader's Mantle once per day; Very Rare, Fount of Moonlight and Moonbeam (DC 17) once per day each; Legendary, Sunburst (DC 18) once per day.

magic-item:nelumbites-pure-lotus-broach.description: A perfect pink-and-white lotus hardened to porcelain, worn on clothing or hair. While attuned, you have resistance to Cold damage and advantage on Wisdom saving throws.

magic-item:cooperative-blade.description: An ancient, untarnished +1 Longsword from pre-Earthfall Nidal. If you're proficient with Longswords, when you take the Help action to assist an attack roll or ability check, your ally gains an extra +1 to the roll.

magic-item:crimson-fulcrum-lens.description: A lens holding a drifting crimson cloud. While attuned you seethe with barely contained fury, and you gain +1 to attack rolls and Advantage on saves to avoid or end Frightened. Malevolent Strike: as a Bonus Action while holding it aloft, your next attack this turn ignores Resistance or Immunity to Bludgeoning, Piercing or Slashing and deals an extra 2d6 of the weapon's type (2d8 for an Unarmed Strike). Infuse Nhimbaloth's Rage: as a Magic action, make a +5 melee attack against a creature within 5 feet; on a hit the essence possesses it, you lose Attunement and it becomes attuned (without these two properties). The target can't end Attunement, but any effect that ends possession (such as Dispel Evil and Good) ends it, and Protection from Evil and Good blocks it. The lens has no properties while the possession lasts.

magic-item:ebon-fulcrum-lens.description: An obsidian chip holding three glimmers of Nhimbaloth's essence; incorporeal and ethereal creatures can hold it. While attuned you gain Incorporeal Movement (1d10 Force if you end your turn inside an object); if not normally incorporeal, your Constitution drops by 4 (minimum 1). It has 3 charges, regained only by a secret ritual or steeping in Nhimbaloth's power. Deathless Rejuvenation (once per dusk): an Undead that can revive itself, reduced to 0, expends 1 charge to return after 1 hour at full Hit Points, sensing its killers within 90 feet of the lens and gaining +1 to saves and spell attacks for 24 hours. Gain Nhimbaloth's Power: as a Magic action, expend 1 charge to double your Speed and gain an extra action each turn for 1 minute (one attack, Dash, Disengage, Hide, Utilize, or Corrupting Gaze, Etherealness, Horrifying Visage or Possession).

magic-item:edge-of-dissolution.description: A sword with a green gleam. As a Bonus Action, speak its command word to make glowing acid seep from the blade (Dim Light 5 feet): hits deal an extra 2d6 Acid, and acid lingers on the target until your next turn starts, revealing it even if Invisible or Heavily Obscured (wiped off as an action). It stops when you repeat the word, drop or sheathe it.

magic-item:emerald-fulcrum-lens.description: A pitted, jagged green lens. While attuned your flesh is waxen and magical healing doesn't work on you, but you have Resistance to Necrotic damage, regain an extra 4 Hit Points per Hit Die rolled, and when reduced to 0 by non-Radiant, non-critical damage you can make a Constitution save (DC 5 + damage) to drop to 1 instead. Grim Resistance (once per dusk): as a Magic action, regain 8d4 + 8 Hit Points and gain Advantage on saves against magic until the end of your next turn. Infuse Nhimbaloth's Tenacity: as a Magic action, make a +7 melee attack against a creature within 5 feet; on a hit the essence possesses it, you lose Attunement and it becomes attuned (without these two properties). The target can't end Attunement, but any effect that ends possession (such as Dispel Evil and Good) ends it, and Protection from Evil and Good blocks it. The lens has no properties while the possession lasts.

magic-item:folding-drums.description: A drum with three forms: hand drum (3 lb.), marching set (24 lb.) or standing set with stool (90 lb.), changed as a Utilize action given space. Pounding it while casting an Enchantment spell with range 30 feet or more adds 30 feet of range, and it adds 30 feet to Bardic Inspiration and Countercharm.

magic-item:fulcrum-lattice.description: A silver and copper frame that holds the four Fulcrum Lenses (Ebon, Crimson, Ochre, Emerald), humming within 10 feet of any; socketed lenses are weightless and inserted or removed as a Utilize action. While you hold it, socketed lenses count as in your hand, and melee attacks with a lens use the highest lens attack modifier or your spell attack modifier.

magic-item:gauntlight.attunementNote: requires attunement by a creature in the Empty Vault within Gauntlight's foundation
magic-item:gauntlight.description: A 115-foot lighthouse in Fogfen whose walls descend through ten dungeon levels to a wellspring Nhimbaloth once touched. Extradimensional Interference: its walls block teleportation, planar travel and summoning in or out unless a DC 19 Charisma save succeeds. The remaining powers need Attunement in the Empty Vault (ranges shown for its diminished state; fully restored, ranges reach 100 miles and recharge after 1 minute). Far Sight: as a Bonus Action, see any area within 1 mile. Disturb the Dead (once per full moon): a 30-foot-radius beam within 1 mile animates humanoid corpses (even buried up to 10 feet) as uncontrolled Undead of CR 1/4 or less. Bridge of Light (once per full moon): teleport one creature of level or CR 2 or less inside Gauntlight to a space in a 30-foot beam within 1 mile. It can't be damaged; if Belcorra's ghost is put to rest or destroyed, it loses its magic and collapses into a deep pit.

magic-item:hunter-s-brooch.description: A silver Holy Symbol of Erastil. While wearing it you can cast Sacred Flame (DC 13). Once per dawn, as a Magic action, bless a weapon you hold for 1 minute: its next Critical Hit deals an extra 1d12 Radiant (2d12 against Undead), not doubled.

magic-item:ichthyosis-mutagen.description: For 1 minute after drinking, your AC can't be less than 11 + your Dexterity modifier and you regain 2 Hit Points at the start of each turn, but you have Disadvantage on Dexterity saves and creatures have Advantage on Survival checks to track you.

magic-item:lantern-of-empty-light.description: A lantern burning pale blue light. As a Bonus Action you shape its light like a Hooded Lantern or a Bullseye Lantern. Empty Light of Reverie (once per dawn): as a Magic action, a creature within 60 feet that sees the light makes a DC 15 Wisdom save or is Charmed and Incapacitated while you concentrate and it sees the lantern, ending on damage or when shaken. Empty Light of Death (once per dawn): as a Magic action, an incorporeal Undead within 60 feet makes a DC 15 Dexterity save, taking 5d8 Radiant, half on success.

magic-item:ochre-fulcrum-lens.description: A dusty brownish-orange lens. While attuned lassitude grips you, but you have Resistance to Psychic damage and Advantage on saves against Enchantment spells and to avoid or end Charmed or Frightened. Overwhelming Listlessness (once per dusk): as a Magic action, cast Sleep (level 5). Infuse Nhimbaloth's Despair: as a Magic action, make a +6 melee attack against a creature within 5 feet; on a hit the essence possesses it, you lose Attunement and it becomes attuned (without these two properties). The target can't end Attunement, but any effect that ends possession (such as Dispel Evil and Good) ends it, and Protection from Evil and Good blocks it. The lens has no properties while the possession lasts.

magic-item:the-whispering-reeds.description: A cursed tome of Nhimbaloth lore with 7 charges, regained at dusk; its powers can't be used while you are cursed unless you follow Nhimbaloth. Research: Advantage on Arcana or Religion checks about Nhimbaloth and her servitors (repeat uses before dusk expose you to the curse). Hand of the Empty Death (2 charges): an incorporeal Undead within 60 feet makes a DC 15 Charisma save, 7d4 Force, half on success (repeat uses expose you). Mists of Despair (once per dusk, always exposes you): chosen creatures in a 20-foot Emanation make a DC 15 Wisdom save, 4d6 Psychic and Disadvantage on saves against Frightened for 1 minute, half damage only on success. Spells (DC 15, always exposes you): Confusion (4), Fear (3), Phantasmal Killer (4), Sleep at level 3 (3). Curse of Empty Death: copying or destroying the book also exposes you; on a failed DC 15 Wisdom save your Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma become 1 and you can't cast spells, use Magic actions or communicate until a Long Rest or Greater Restoration, Heal or Wish. Dying meanwhile, you rise as a Ghost, consumed by Nhimbaloth on a d20 roll of 1 every 10 days.

magic-item:thresholds-of-truth.description: Zarmavdian's heavily annotated, nonmagical spellbook on resisting eldritch manipulation. It contains: 1st level: Alarm, Charm Person, Color Spray, Comprehend Languages, Detect Magic, Mage Armor, Magic Missile, Shield, Unseen Servant. 2nd: False Life, Hold Person, Locate Object, Web. 3rd: Clairvoyance, Dispel Magic, Haste, Lightning Bolt, Slow. 4th: Daydreamer's Curse, Locate Creature, Resilient Sphere.

magic-item:antlered-headband-of-chernobo.description: Blood-tipped antlers on an ichor-stained headband. You see normally in Dim Light and Darkness, magical or not, within 120 feet. You can attack with the antlers (Strength-based, 1d10 Piercing plus Strength modifier) and use their Push mastery even without Weapon Mastery; if you have Weapon Mastery, Push moves targets 15 feet. Moving 15+ feet straight before hitting forces a DC 15 Charisma save or Frightened for 1 minute (save at end of each turn). 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn: as a Magic action cast Darkness (1) or Dominate Monster (3), which can affect Undead even if normally immune.

magic-item:arm-ring-of-self-sacrifice.description: A mildly painful arm ring with 5 charges, regaining 1d4 + 1 at dawn. Aggressive Strike: when you hit, spend 2 charges to deal maximum damage, taking unmitigable Force damage equal to the attack's minimum damage. Redirection: when a visible creature attacks an ally within 5 feet of you, use your Reaction and 1 charge to become the target instead.

magic-item:arrow-of-ice-trapping.description: Deals an extra 1d6 Cold on a hit. A creature damaged by it makes a DC 15 Strength save or is Restrained in ice, taking 1d6 Cold at the start of each of its turns; it repeats the save at the end of each turn, and it or a creature within reach can take an action to free it with a DC 15 Strength (Athletics) check.

magic-item:ashbraid.description: A fire-blackened battleaxe or greataxe wrapped in unbreakable golden hair. +1 to attack and damage rolls and an extra 1d6 Fire on a hit. A creature you hit has Vulnerability to Fire until the start of your next turn; if it has Fire Resistance, it instead loses that Resistance for the same time. No effect on Fire-immune creatures.

magic-item:bell-ringing-greatclub.description: A greatclub made from the clapper of a giant's bell, with the Push mastery property. On a Critical Hit you can Stun the target until the start of your next turn instead of dealing the extra critical damage.

magic-item:belt-of-the-berserker.description: A wolf-hide belt. When you Rage you can choose Foolhardy Rage: while Raging you gain an extra Bonus Action each turn, usable only to extend your Rage or Dash (but not Dash twice in a turn), and +1 to your Rage Damage, but you must use Reckless Attack each turn or the Rage ends.

magic-item:berserker-s-mead.description: For 1 minute after you drink it, you are immune to the first 40 points of damage you take.

magic-item:blade-of-insults.description: A dagger, handaxe, seax, sickle, snaerispear or spear for witty bards. When you deal damage with it on your turn, you can use your Bonus Action to cast Vicious Mockery on the same creature, optionally expending a Bardic Inspiration use as part of that Bonus Action.

magic-item:bygul-s-paw-boots.description: Fluffy boots with crampon spikes. Snow or ice Difficult Terrain costs no extra movement, you automatically pass Acrobatics checks to avoid falling Prone, and you have Advantage on Athletics checks to climb. Your footprints look like a large cat's.

magic-item:cloak-of-wide-ranging.description: A wolf-skin cloak granting Advantage on Constitution saves to avoid Exhaustion from traveling more than 8 hours in a day.

magic-item:defender-honey.description: Light, sweet honey. For 10 minutes after eating it, you can use your Reaction when an attack would hit an ally within 5 feet to become the target, using the same attack roll.

magic-item:einherjar-s-drinking-horn.description: A carved horn with 6 charges, regaining 1d6 at dawn. As a Magic action, spend 1 charge to drink mead that nourishes you for a day, or spend 6 charges to also remove 1 level of Exhaustion (not more than two days in a row).

magic-item:feather-token-raven.description: A black token. As a Magic action, throw it into the air to become a raven you can see and hear through for 1 hour, or until it gets more than 1 mile away.

magic-item:feather-token-snowy-owl.description: A white and grey feather. As a Magic action, wave it across a creature's face; for 1 hour it can Hide against snowy terrain without needing to be Obscured or behind Cover.

magic-item:glacierpress-boots.description: Fur boots matted with unmelting ice and gravel, with 3 charges regaining 1d3 at dawn. As a Magic action spend 1 charge to activate them for 1 hour: you can move in a straight line through the spaces of creatures smaller than Huge without provoking Opportunity Attacks, and the first time you enter a creature's space on a move it makes a DC 15 Strength save or is pushed ahead of you for the rest of that move.

magic-item:goggles-of-snowsight.description: Blue crystal goggles. You don't have Disadvantage on Perception checks to see through areas Lightly Obscured by blowing snow, sand or other debris.

magic-item:goggles-of-tracking.description: Swiveling multi-lens goggles with 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn. As a Magic action spend 1 charge: for 1 hour you see tracks from the last week obscured by rain, snow or sand, and have Advantage on checks to track creatures.

magic-item:hel-s-coin.description: A blackened silver coin. If you fail a Death Saving Throw while carrying it, it counts as a success and the coin crumbles. Carrying more than one curses you instead: a successful Death Saving Throw counts as a failure and one coin crumbles, until only one remains. Extra coins can be discarded freely.

magic-item:hjartarydi-s-belt.description: A comforting blood-red leather belt granting Advantage on saves against being Charmed or Frightened.

magic-item:hollow-eye.description: A wooden eyeball talisman with a void for a pupil. As a Magic action, spend 1 Hit Die to drip blood into it and cast Arcane Eye or Divination. Once used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

magic-item:honey-of-robust-health.description: Deep red, warming honey. Eaten during a Short Rest, it lets you reroll any 1 or 2 on Hit Dice spent to heal during that rest, using the new roll.

magic-item:honey-of-the-hearth-fire.description: Eating this honey ends the Blinded, Deafened, Frightened and Poisoned conditions on you.

magic-item:honey-of-the-hive-warden.description: Eating it grants Poison Resistance for 1 hour, and once during that time you can cast Insect Plague (DC 15) as a swarm of bees dealing Poison instead of Piercing damage.

magic-item:honey-of-the-norn-blessed.description: Eating it grants Advantage on Dexterity saves for 1 hour, and once during that time you can cast Augury.

magic-item:honey-of-the-sacred-bear.description: Eating it grants Advantage on Strength checks for 1 hour, and once during that time you can cast Heroism on yourself without Concentration.

magic-item:honey-of-the-skald-s-tongue.description: Eating it grants Advantage on Performance and Persuasion checks for 1 hour, and once during that time you can cast Suggestion (DC 15).

magic-item:horn-of-battle-s-call.description: An iron-banded leather horn. Blow it as an action: up to five allies within 120 feet who hear it gain Advantage on melee weapon attacks until the start of your next turn and 10 Temporary Hit Points, and stop being Frightened. Usable once per dawn.

magic-item:horn-of-the-hrimthursar.description: An ivory horn carved from an arctic monster's bone. Sounding it blasts a 60-foot Cone: creatures take 4d6 Cold and are Incapacitated until the start of your next turn; a DC 15 Constitution save halves the damage and negates the Incapacitation. Usable once per dawn.

magic-item:horn-of-the-wild-hunt.description: A black horn that glitters like a starlit sky in darkness, with 4 charges regaining 1d4 at sunset. Blow it to spend 1 charge to cast Conjure Animals or 3 charges to cast Conjure Fey as a spectral hunter.

magic-item:icebreaker-axe.description: A dark grey battleaxe or greataxe with blue-white runes, dealing an extra 3d8 Thunder to ice objects it hits. 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn: as a Magic action strike an icy surface to send a 60-foot Line of thunder; creatures make a DC 15 Strength save or fall Prone, and ice objects take 3d8 Thunder.

magic-item:iced-steel-armor.attunementNote: Any medium or heavy metal armor
magic-item:iced-steel-armor.description: Medium or heavy metal armor of ever-cold iced steel from Niflheim. While wearing it, you automatically succeed on saves against Extreme Heat and have Advantage on saves against fire and heat spells.

magic-item:iced-steel-weapon.description: A melee weapon or ammunition of ever-cold iced steel. Its damage can be treated as Cold instead of its normal type when that would benefit you.

magic-item:incendiary-coal.description: A warm lump of coal. As a Magic action breathe on it and throw it up to 30 feet, where it becomes a 5-foot Sphere of fire. A creature ending its turn in or next to it makes a DC 15 Dexterity save, taking 1d6 Fire (half on success), and unattended flammables ignite. At the end of each of your turns it grows by 5 feet and 1d6, to 30 feet and 6d6, then shrinks by the same each turn to nothing. Usable once per dawn.

magic-item:iron-traitor-s-arm-ring.description: A hammered-iron arm ring. As a Utilize action, make a melee attack (Strength or Dexterity plus Proficiency Bonus) against a Huge or smaller creature within 5 feet; on a hit it coils around the target's arm and its magic items stop functioning until you release it as a Bonus Action. A creature touching it can take an action for a DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check to remove it (failure blocks that creature for 24 hours); severing the limb or destroying the ring also frees it. Usable once per dawn.

magic-item:kempdomr-axe.attunementNote: Battleaxe, bearded axe, breidox, or greataxe
magic-item:kempdomr-axe.description: A jotun-powered axe with +1 to attack and damage rolls and 5 charges, regaining 1d4 + 1 at dawn. On a melee hit, spend 1 charge for an extra 3d8 Force and push the target 10 feet per size category below Gargantuan. Giant's Boon: while you are also attuned to a Belt of Giant Strength or Gauntlets of Ogre Power, it regains all charges at dawn, the bonus becomes +2 and the extra damage 4d8.

magic-item:laekning-shield.description: A round shield granting +1 AC on top of its normal bonus. It magically repairs itself and isn't destroyed by being struck.

magic-item:mug-of-friendship.description: As a Magic action, enchant a drink in this flagon. A creature that drinks it becomes Friendly to you, and you have Advantage on Persuasion checks against it for 1 hour; it stays Friendly afterward unless your behavior changes that. Usable once per dawn.

magic-item:nine-escape-knot.description: A foot-long rope of woven fox tails. While you carry it, you have Advantage on checks and saves to avoid or end Grappled or Restrained. As a Magic action, untie one of its nine knots to cast (with Charisma) one of Calm Emotions, Charm Person, Confusion, Disguise Self, Enthrall, Feign Death, Greater Invisibility, Mirror Image or Misty Step, each once only. It loses its magic when the last knot is untied.

magic-item:northlander-s-boots.description: As a Bonus Action, these furred boots turn into snowshoes, ice skates or skis, and back.

magic-item:ottaveggr-talharpa.description: A lyre strung with braided jotun hair. As a Magic action, play it to give allies within 60 feet who hear it Advantage on saves against Frightened and on Athletics checks for 1 hour. Usable once per dawn.

magic-item:potion-of-near-death-portent.description: Cloudy grey fluid with a golden thread. Within 1 hour after drinking, the next time you would drop to 0 Hit Points you can use your Reaction to roll 1d20: on 10 or higher you take no damage, otherwise you drop to 1 Hit Point instead.

magic-item:prismatic-ammunition.description: Bifrost-infused prismatic steel ammunition. A creature hit with it while outside its home plane is banished to that plane for 1 round.

magic-item:prismatic-steel-armor.attunementNote: Any medium or heavy metal armor
magic-item:prismatic-steel-armor.description: Medium or heavy armor of Bifrost-infused prismatic steel. While wearing it, you automatically succeed on saves against being pushed, pulled, teleported or otherwise moved against your will. As a Magic action, teleport it onto or off your body (off places it in an adjacent space), even across planes; once per dawn.

magic-item:prismatic-steel-weapon.description: A Bifrost-infused melee weapon. A creature you hit while it is outside its home plane is banished there for 1 round; on a Critical Hit it is banished indefinitely, though it may return of its own accord. As a Bonus Action, summon it to your empty hand, even across planes.

magic-item:rage-hammer.description: When you enter a Rage, you can make a melee attack with this maul or warhammer as part of that Bonus Action. Once used, not again until you finish a Short Rest.

magic-item:ravenflight-axe.description: A handaxe with the Vex mastery property that deals an extra 1d6 Slashing when an ally is within 5 feet of your target. Swarm Attack: as an action, release it to become a 60-foot Cone of ravens and make a ranged weapon attack against each chosen creature in the Cone; it then returns to your hand. Once per dawn.

magic-item:reaver-s-lodestone.description: A rune-etched stone on a leather thong with 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn. As a Magic action, spend 1 charge, whisper person or gold, and it pulls you for 1 minute toward settlements (1 mile per 100 people, 10 miles per 1,000, 100 miles per 10,000) or valuables (10 feet per 100 GP, 100 feet per 1,000 GP, 1,000 feet per 10,000 GP), pulling harder for nearer or larger targets.

magic-item:ring-of-hospitality.description: A ring showing clasped hands. You have Advantage on Persuasion checks when using the Influence action to request shelter from a creature that understands you.

magic-item:ring-of-ice-shielding.description: 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn. When targeted by an attack or forced to make a Dexterity save, use your Reaction and 1 charge to raise a 5-foot-square, 1-foot-thick wall of ice giving Three-Quarters Cover. If the attack misses or you succeed, the wall explodes, dealing 1d6 Piercing and 1d6 Cold to adjacent enemies.

magic-item:ring-of-surtr.description: A warm ring of coal-black iron. When you deal Fire damage to an object while wearing it, you deal an extra 1d8 Fire.

magic-item:ring-of-the-diving-bird.description: While wearing it, you have a Swim Speed equal to any Fly Speed you have.

magic-item:rod-of-frostbite.description: A desiccated forearm and hand with 5 charges, regaining 1d4 + 1 at dawn. Withering Cold: as a Magic action spend 1 charge; a visible creature within 60 feet makes a DC 15 Constitution save or for 1 minute takes an extra 2d6 Necrotic whenever it takes Cold damage (save at end of each turn). You can also cast Ray of Frost from it with your spell attack modifier.

magic-item:rostungr-armor.description: Light or hide armor granting +1 AC. As a Bonus Action, once per dawn, you grow flippers and blubber for 1 minute: your Speed is halved, you gain a 30-foot Swim Speed and Resistance to Bludgeoning damage.

magic-item:rumbling-hammer.description: Right after you score a Critical Hit with this maul or warhammer, it casts Thunderclap scaled to your level; your allies are immune to that damage.

magic-item:sail-of-favorable-winds.description: Cloud-embroidered sails. A ship flying them treats any wind as a tailwind and keeps maximum speed without tacking, but they do nothing when the ship is becalmed.

magic-item:salt-of-thawing.description: As a Magic action, spread it on a 5-foot square within 10 feet to instantly melt ice up to 1 foot thick there.

magic-item:sealskin-armor.description: Light armor that gives you a Swim Speed equal to your Speed and Advantage on checks and saves to avoid or end Grappled.

magic-item:seidr-rune-necklace.description: Glowing runes strung on giant's hair. As a Magic action, once per dawn, name an individual you know and a situation type (battle, diplomacy, trade, trickery or other); the GM says whether they will likely face it today. For the rest of the day you know when they are in that situation and can use your Reaction to add or subtract 1d10 from a roll they just made.

magic-item:serpent-fin-oars.description: A set of silvery oars for one ship. While they are rowed, the pilot has Advantage on checks to control the ship. Adjacent to another rowed ship, the ship can take an action to slash and destroy its oars. While one oar remains aboard, another regrows each dawn until the set is complete.

magic-item:shadow-blade.description: A weapon casting a shadowy double image, with 3 charges regaining 1d3 at sunset. Elusive Strike: when you miss with it, spend 1 charge to reroll the attack. Phantasmal Parry: spend 1 charge to cast Shield.

magic-item:shield-of-the-world-serpent.description: A shield shaped from a scale of Jormungandr. While wielding it, you can't be pushed or pulled against your will, and at the start of each of your turns you can end Grappled and Restrained on yourself.

magic-item:skinchanger-arm-ring.description: A fabled copper arm ring that grows with its wearer; its base trait needs no attunement. You can understand and speak with Beast ravens, wolves and bears and use Influence options on them. Level 5: once per dawn, as a Magic action, grow wings for 1 hour (Fly Speed 50 feet, one size smaller, Disadvantage on Strength checks and saves, weapon and Unarmed Strike damage 1d4 lower, minimum 1). Level 9: Advantage on melee attacks against a creature with an able ally within 5 feet of it. Level 13: once per dawn, as a Magic action, gain Temporary Hit Points equal to twice your level and Cold Resistance while they last. Level 17: 3 charges (1d3 at dawn); spend 1 to Polymorph yourself into a raven, wolf, dire wolf or black, brown or polar bear, keeping your mental scores.

magic-item:slip-bane-bracelet.description: A corded bracelet hung with 1d4 + 2 tiny claws. Use your Reaction to halve falling damage; one claw crumbles, and the bracelet crumbles when none remain.

magic-item:snowbirds.description: Three interlocking crystal tern figures that can be buried separately in snow, sand or soil. As a Magic action, call a buried bird within 100 feet: it bursts up, filling a 10-foot-tall, 5-foot-radius Cylinder with snow that is Heavily Obscured until the start of your next turn. Several can be triggered at once.

magic-item:songsteel-armor.description: Armor that rings like a bell when struck. As a Bonus Action, call to Volund: until the end of your next turn, you take 5 less damage from each attack that hits you. Once per Long Rest.

magic-item:songsteel-shield.description: A ringing songsteel shield. As a Bonus Action, call to Volund for +5 AC until the end of your next turn. Once per Long Rest.

magic-item:songsteel-weapon.description: A ringing songsteel weapon. As a Bonus Action, call to Volund for +5 to its damage rolls until the end of your next turn. Once per Long Rest.

magic-item:stormbinder-s-cloak.description: While wearing it, you have Resistance to Cold, Lightning and Thunder, ignore obscurement from clouds, fog and mist, and cast level 1+ spells dealing Cold, Lightning or Thunder as if using a slot one level higher.

magic-item:stormhook.description: A dart, javelin or spear that returns to your hand after a ranged attack. A creature hit by a ranged attack with it is pulled 10 feet toward you, and its Fly Speed drops to 0 until the start of its next turn.

magic-item:stormhorn.description: A horn of lightning-struck yew with 6 charges, regaining 1d6 at dawn. Blow it as a Magic action to cast Fog Cloud (1), Gust of Wind (2) or Sleet Storm (3) with your spell save DC.

magic-item:storrbani.description: A fabled longsword holding the spirit of the giant-slayer Thogar. It weighs 1 pound, has the Finesse property and deals an extra 1d4 Fire on a hit. Level 5: once per Short Rest, as a Bonus Action, cast Shield of Faith without Concentration on another visible creature within 60 feet; Thogar awakens as a sentient Lawful Neutral weapon (Int 8, Wis 13, Cha 10; telepathy; Common and Giant) who demands battle with evil giants and trolls and suppresses the sword's magic until dawn if you shy away. Level 9: +1 to attack and damage, Fire becomes 2d6, and as a Bonus Action you can lend the Fire damage to a visible ally's weapon within 60 feet until the end of your next turn. Level 13: +2, and as a Bonus Action you score critical hits on 19-20 until the end of your next turn, with an extra 1d8 on critical hits against Giants. Level 17: +3, and once per dawn as a Bonus Action gain Immunity to all damage until the end of your next turn.

magic-item:sustaining-belt.description: A wide fur-lined belt. You can go additional days equal to your Constitution modifier before suffering starvation or dehydration.

magic-item:the-grave-blade.description: A fabled bone-hilted longsword whose pommel hums audibly within 5 feet when Undead are within 60 feet. Level 5: once per dawn, when dropped to 0 Hit Points but not killed, drop to 1 instead, with Advantage on attacks against the creature responsible for 1 minute. Level 9: +1 to attack and damage and an extra 1d6 Necrotic. Level 13: +2, and a living creature it damages makes a DC 15 Charisma save or is Frightened until the end of its next turn. Level 17: +3, and once per dawn a creature with 50 or fewer Hit Points you hit can be compelled to die.

magic-item:tireless-armor.description: 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn. Spend 1 to negate a level of Exhaustion you would gain. While it has a charge, your Speed can't be reduced.

magic-item:tireless-rower.description: A copper clockwork statue of a seated dwarf. On command it duplicates itself to crew a ship's oars, replacing a longship's rowers for 8 hours, then needs 8 hours to recharge.

magic-item:titancall-dagger.description: A dagger with the Nick mastery property and +2 to attack and damage rolls. When you hit with it, you can use a Bonus Action to summon a frost giant within 120 feet that believes a target you name has wronged it; it is Friendly to you and your allies and stays for 1 hour or until reduced to 0 Hit Points. Once per dawn.

magic-item:tordalfr-s-rebuttal.description: A fabled lightning-forged snaerispear. A ranged hit can push the target up to 10 feet away. Level 5: it returns to your hand after each throw. Level 9: +1 to attack and damage and an extra 1d6 Lightning when thrown. Level 13: +2, and once per Short Rest as a Bonus Action charge your next hit this turn: the target makes a Constitution save (DC 8 + Dexterity modifier + Proficiency Bonus) or is Stunned until the start of your next turn. Level 17: +3, and once per dawn a hit calls down a bolt dealing 8d8 Lightning to the target and creatures within 15 feet, pushing them 15 feet away.

magic-item:trollkin-unguent.description: A rainbow-sheened oil; one vial covers a Medium or smaller creature (one more per size above Medium) over 10 minutes. It grants Fire Resistance for 1 hour. If the creature takes Fire damage, it is wreathed in green flames (Dim Light, 15 feet) and its melee weapon attacks deal an extra 1d6 Necrotic for 10 minutes, after which the oil is spent.

magic-item:tyr-s-crushing-might.description: An iron bowsprit of the one-handed god Tyr. A ship bearing it deals double damage with the Ram action and takes no damage from ramming.

magic-item:valhallan-armor.description: While wearing this medium or heavy armor, you aren't Unconscious at 0 Hit Points, though you still make Death Saving Throws and can't stabilize yourself with Medicine.

magic-item:warhammer-of-giant-felling.description: A rune-carved warhammer with the Push mastery property and +1 to attack and damage rolls. A larger creature you hit makes a DC 15 Strength save or takes 3d6 Thunder and falls Prone. A creature your size or smaller makes the save or takes 2d6 Thunder and is Prone and Restrained, driven into the ground, until it or a creature within reach succeeds on a DC 15 Strength (Athletics) check as an action.

magic-item:warrior-honey.description: Bubbly, tingling honey. Within the next hour, you have Advantage on your first Initiative roll and your first melee attack roll.

magic-item:winged-helm-of-wisdom.description: A silver helm with black wings and a smooth plate over the right eye. As a Magic action, once per dawn, gain a 60-foot Fly Speed for 1 hour (descending 30 feet per round if still aloft at the end); while active you can Concentrate on two spells at once.

magic-item:birdcage-of-innocuousness.description: A giant-sized silver birdcage. A creature with a Fly Speed that enters makes a DC 14 Wisdom save or becomes docile until it leaves; on a success it can open the cage from inside. A creature outside can open or close it as a Bonus Action, and as an action speak a command word to disguise the occupant as a harmless songbird illusion or reveal its true form; leaving the cage ends the illusion.

magic-item:glamsyni-shield.description: A round metal shield bearing the glamsyni rune. Once per dawn, as a Reaction, teleport up to 10 feet to a visible unoccupied space.

magic-item:mother-s-comb.description: A plain bone weaving comb radiating overwhelming Divination magic. Holding it, a creature can ask the Norns' indestructible Loom of Fables in Loki's Hall one question; over 1d4 hours the loom weaves a virtually infallible answer in words, symbols and pictures. Each creature can ask only one question in its lifetime.

magic-item:uror-s-shears.description: Crude, impossibly sharp iron shears of the Norn Uror. As an action, cut 5 feet through any single object per round, continuing on later turns. Against a living creature they are a +1 magic weapon dealing 1 Force; a damaged creature makes a DC 18 Constitution save or its fate thread is cut and it vanishes forever, taking 10d10 Force on a success. They vanish after hitting a creature or cutting one object (or 5-foot squares equal to your Proficiency Bonus).

magic-item:adder-stone.description: A glassy holed stone found where a marra died. The first time you would gain the Paralyzed condition while carrying it, the stone shatters and the condition is removed.

magic-item:aether-blood.description: Glowing purple liquid. For 1 minute your spell save DCs rise by 1 and upcastable spells count as one level higher. You can use it safely a number of times equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum 1); beyond that you become addicted: Disadvantage on Strength and Constitution checks and saves and attacks against you have Advantage. Another dose suppresses this until a Long Rest but forces a DC 10 Charisma save or your Speed drops by 20 feet for 1 minute. Greater Restoration or 30 days without it ends the addiction.

magic-item:amulet-of-curse-suppression.description: An ivory and silver amulet. While attuned, curses on you are nullified as if by Remove Curse, but they return in full when it is removed or attunement ends.

magic-item:angelskin-armor.description: Leather armor of flayed angel flesh. While attuned, you have Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing damage. Celestials that see it become Hostile, and Fiends covet it.

magic-item:armor-of-zombie-flesh.description: Tanned zombie-flesh hide armor setting your AC to 14 + Dexterity modifier. While attuned, you can use a Reaction to halve Necrotic damage you take.

magic-item:banshee-box.description: An ivory music box with gruesome silver scenes. After holding it 1 minute, use a Magic action to set it to loop any sound or phrase up to 1 minute long, audible in a 5-, 30- or 120-foot Emanation, while the lid is open; it closes if its creator goes more than 300 feet away.

magic-item:blessed-reliquary.description: A small box holding a saint's relic. While carried, you have Advantage on saves against Undead, gain one extra use of each Channel Divinity feature, and once per Long Rest can give targets of your Turn Undead Disadvantage on their saves.

magic-item:bliss.description: A white pellet drug. A Humanoid that takes it gains, for 1d4 hours, immunity to Frightened and 3d10 Temporary Hit Points, but its Speed drops by 15 feet, it has Disadvantage on D20 Tests, and creatures have Advantage on saves it forces. Afterward it makes a DC 15 Constitution save or gains 1 Exhaustion level.

magic-item:blood-capsule.description: A rune-etched flask that keeps Humanoid blood fresh for a year, holding enough to sustain a vampire for a day.

magic-item:cap-of-bravery.description: Woven from a snarite. You and allies in a 30-foot Emanation have Advantage on saves to avoid or end Frightened.

magic-item:caustic-rapier.description: A rapier made from a hivewolf mandible with +2 to attack and damage. On a roll of 19 or 20 it deals an extra 7 (2d6) Acid, and you are immune to Acid damage while wielding it.

magic-item:cloak-of-the-listener.description: A pulsing cloak of ears. Each once per dawn, as a Magic action: Ooze, a 10-foot square of wax within 30 feet for 1 minute where creatures entering or starting there make a DC 15 Dexterity save or are Grappled (escape DC 15); or Hide, covering your head to become Blinded but gain Blindsight 120 feet and hear all speech within 120 feet for 1 minute.

magic-item:cloak-of-the-mausgeist.description: A silk-lined mausgeist fur cloak granting Advantage on hearing-based Perception checks and on saves against spells and magical effects. Once per dawn, cast Charm Person (DC 13) as a Magic action.

magic-item:cloak-of-therianthropy.description: A spotted styrkvisnar-hide cloak granting Advantage on Athletics checks. Once per dawn, as a Magic action, become a wolf, eagle or seal for up to 1 hour as Polymorph, reverting as a Bonus Action.

magic-item:coin-of-war-and-fear.description: A heretical coin showing Empyreus and Beleth. As a Magic action flip it (d6). Even, Boon of Empyreus: +2 AC and +1d4 to your first attack roll each turn for 1 minute. Odd, Boon of Beleth: for 1 minute, enemies ending their turn in a 10-foot Emanation make a DC 14 Wisdom save or are Frightened until the end of their next turn, and your weapon hits on Frightened creatures deal an extra 1d6 Psychic. Receiving the same boon again before dawn instead deals you 3d6 Radiant or Necrotic.

magic-item:coldrazor.description: The lich Runa Banasar's rune-carved ice handaxe, with +3 to attack and damage and an extra 14 (4d6) Cold on hits. If one attack deals more than 20 Cold damage, the target makes a DC 15 Constitution save or is Stunned until the end of its next turn. It returns to your hand after a ranged attack.

magic-item:collar-of-the-undead.description: As a Magic action, collar a Large or smaller Humanoid dead within 10 days: it returns at 1 Hit Point as an Undead that needn't eat, sleep or breathe, obeying your mental Bonus Action commands within 60 feet (Dodging if uncommanded). Its Hit Point maximum drops by 1d4 each dawn; at 0 maximum or 0 Hit Points, or if the collar is removed, it crumbles to dust.

magic-item:corrupted-tusk-dagger.description: A dagger of dragonborn vampire fangs. Its Critical Hits deal 4d4 weapon damage instead of 2d4, and the target makes a DC 15 Constitution save or is Stunned until the end of its next turn.

magic-item:crimson-mist.description: A bottle of prey pheromones. As a Magic action, spray a target within 5 feet; for 1 minute, Beasts and creatures compelled to attack the nearest creature target it instead if it is within 60 feet.

magic-item:crown-of-the-keppmir-king.description: A platinum crown of black gems and shells granting Cold Resistance, water breathing and Constitution 20 (unless already higher). Curse: attuning curses you until Remove Curse; it can't be removed, and you become a keppmir after 2d10 days.

magic-item:damglesvir.description: A shadow-blackened imperial longsword attuned in tiers. Aspirant: +2 to attack and damage and an extra 1d6 Force with any weapon you wield, but you are pallid with Disadvantage on Constitution saves. Adept: creatures it damages can't regain Hit Points until your next turn, and a number of times per Long Rest equal to your Proficiency Bonus one attack becomes a sweep against each chosen creature in reach; but each hit lowers your Hit Point maximum by 1 until a Long Rest. Master: once per Long Rest a hit can slay a creature with 100 or fewer Hit Points (DC 20 Constitution save); but after you hit, healing you receive until your next turn becomes Temporary Hit Points.

magic-item:dreams-leaves.description: A hallucinogenic leaf. You can fall into a blissful Unconscious trance for 1 hour (ended by damage); completing it lets you reroll one D20 Test as a Reaction before your next Long Rest. Using that reroll causes addiction: Disadvantage on saves, suppressed by another dose until a Long Rest, ended by Greater Restoration or 30 days abstinent.

magic-item:ectoplasmic-whip.description: A phasing whip of silver spirit energy with +1 to attack and damage; attacks with it against non-Undead creatures have Advantage.

magic-item:elixir-of-elemental-spittle.description: Made from an elemental troll's saliva. For 1 minute, as a Bonus Action, spit at a creature within 5 feet: DC 12 Dexterity save or 2d6 damage of the troll's element. If the target rolls a natural 20, the potion explodes inside you for 6d6 of that type and ends.

magic-item:elixir-of-life-protection.description: A chalky mixture; for 10 minutes after drinking it your Hit Point maximum can't be reduced.

magic-item:enchanted-feather.description: A feather from a rabenhex. As a Magic action, cast Remove Curse from it, after which it becomes nonmagical.

magic-item:faerie-crown.description: A flower crown that gains 1d6 + 3 butterflies when first donned after attunement. When hit by a melee attack, use a Reaction to release one; the attack misses and destroys it. The crown crumbles when none remain.

magic-item:fin-symbiote.description: An aberrant fin stitched into a Humanoid's skin to attune. It grants Advantage on Constitution saves and lets you use a Reaction to reduce forced movement by 10 feet; at Stage 1+ of the Aberrant Horror Transformation, your boon save DCs rise by 2. You can't end attunement voluntarily, and if removed it regrows in 1d4 hours unless Remove Curse is cast first.

magic-item:full-moon-extract.description: Powdered werewolf organs. For 1 hour your Strength becomes 19 (unless higher) and you have Advantage on Strength checks and saves. You can use it safely a number of times equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum 1); further use causes addiction: Disadvantage on Dexterity checks and saves and attacks against you have Advantage. Another dose suppresses it until a Long Rest but forces a DC 10 Charisma save or you rage at the nearest creature for 1 minute without Bonus Actions or Reactions. Greater Restoration or 30 days abstinent ends it.

magic-item:funeral-mask.description: A thin copper mask. Once per dawn, as a Magic action, alter your appearance for 8 hours (same size and basic shape); a creature within 5 feet can Study with a DC 20 Investigation check to see through it. At Stage 1+ of the Lich Transformation, you gain +2 AC while disguised.

magic-item:gold-boar-ring.description: Made from gold mane boar bristles, it sheds Bright Light 20 feet and Dim Light 20 more, even where magic fails or magical light is suppressed.

magic-item:grenade-of-remorse.description: Distilled tears of a remorseful storm. As a Magic action, hurl it up to 30 feet to burst in a 20-foot-radius Sphere: Aberrations, Fiends and Undead make a DC 17 Constitution save, taking 8d6 Psychic, half on success.

magic-item:gristaline.description: Ground mouruge bones, rotten meat and mud. For 1 hour your Strength becomes 19 (unless higher), but you have Disadvantage on Intelligence checks and saves.

magic-item:hearthfire-breastplate.description: A corrupted, writhing black breastplate attuned in tiers. Aspirant: +2 AC and saves and cast Shield a number of times per Long Rest equal to your Proficiency Bonus, but Disadvantage on Dexterity saves. Adept: that many times per Long Rest, as a Magic action, give up to six visible creatures within 30 feet 1d4 + 5 Temporary Hit Points (others gain +2 AC while they last), but you take unavoidable Psychic damage equal to half of those Temporary Hit Points lost by allies within 60 feet. Master: once per Long Rest, as a Reaction, make a damaged creature within 30 feet immune to all damage until your next turn, but you are Frightened for 1 minute when an ally drops to 0 (Paralyzed if it dies; DC 16 Wisdom save at end of each turn).

magic-item:heaven-s-herald.description: An untarnishable golden trumpet heard 600 feet away. Once per dawn, as a Magic action, embolden up to 12 willing creatures within 600 feet for 8 hours: immunity to Frightened, Advantage on Wisdom saves, and Hit Point maximum and current Hit Points raised by 2d10. A Fiend or Undead who blows it takes 8d6 Radiant.

magic-item:hogs-wash.description: Foul tea of powdered doom boar tusk. Drinking it grants the effect of Remove Curse, and it can serve as a component in removing a Shadowsteel curse.

magic-item:humble-frock.description: While wearing it without armor, Opportunity Attacks against you have Disadvantage. At Stage 2+ of the Seraph Transformation, you have Advantage on saves to avoid revealing your true nature.

magic-item:hunter-s-zeal.description: A glowing green tonic. For 1 hour you are immune to Poison damage and Poisoned and have Advantage on saves against being cursed; when it ends you gain 1 Exhaustion level.

magic-item:indorius-s-crown.description: An emperor's crown attuned in tiers. Aspirant: Advantage on Charisma checks and saves, and 12 charges (regains 2d4 + 4 at dawn) for Compulsion (4), Dominate Person (5), Hellish Rebuke (1), Hold Person (2) or Suggestion (2), DC 18; but Disadvantage on Insight checks and Wisdom saves. Adept: a number of times per Long Rest equal to your Proficiency Bonus, as a Bonus Action a Friendly creature uses its Reaction to attack or cast a level 2 or lower action spell, and conscious, you give Friendly creatures within 10 feet +1d4 to attacks and saves; but allies within 10 feet who miss or fail a check are Frightened of you until their next turn ends. Master: treat any Charisma check roll as 14 if you wish, and cast Dominate Monster or Power Word Stun (DC 18) once per Long Rest; but with no Friendly creature within 10 feet you have Disadvantage on attacks and can't concentrate.

magic-item:inquisitor-s-draught.description: A silver syrup. For 1 hour after drinking it you can't attune to magic items and can take an action to sever all attunements, even cursed ones; if you are attuned to any item when the hour ends, you die.

magic-item:iridescent-armor.description: A giant dragonfly carapace breastplate with a gossamer cape, granting +1 AC. Once per dawn, as a Magic action, the cape becomes wings giving a 30-foot Fly Speed for 1 hour (60 feet for 2 hours at Stage 1+ of the Fey Transformation).

magic-item:iron-fangs.description: Rune-inscribed iron tooth caps. Your Bite attacks gain +2 to attack and damage and deal your choice of Force or Piercing damage.

magic-item:living-net.description: A suture golem net of wire and thread that writhes once it restrains a target. Escaping needs a DC 15 Athletics check; it has AC 15 and 15 Hit Points and repairs itself 1 minute after being destroyed.

magic-item:lodestone-armor.description: Plate lined with planar lodestone. As a Bonus Action, magnetize it for 1 minute, drawing debris for +1 AC and -5 feet of Speed; repeating while active stacks up to +4 AC and -20 feet, after which it can't be reactivated until it ends.

magic-item:magebane-bomb.description: Distilled magebane ooze. Make a ranged weapon attack against a weapon, armor or spellcaster; on a hit it deals 3 (1d6) Acid and a weapon takes -1 to attack and damage or armor -1 AC until its owner's next Long Rest, while a spellcaster takes -1 to spell attacks and spell save DCs for 1 minute.

magic-item:magical-prosthetics.description: A prosthetic limb (see the Grim Hollow Player's Guide) enchanted to replicate a wondrous item or ring suited to that body part, such as a leg acting as Boots of Elvenkind or a hand as a Ring of Protection. It has the same rarity as the mimicked item and occupies that item's slot.

magic-item:malleus-macabre.description: A jagged greatclub, the object form of a kokela, granting +4 to damage and critical hits on 19-20 (17-20 if you already have an expanded critical range). On a Critical Hit, after damage, there is a 25% chance it casts Cloudkill at level 9 centered on you. Curse: attuning curses you until you spend a year at least a mile from it; you keep it within reach and have Disadvantage with other weapons unless no foe is within 60 feet.

magic-item:mask-of-the-maestro.description: A yew beast-face mask with 3 charges; spend 1 to cast Polymorph on yourself for up to 1 minute. Curse: wearing it curses you so you can't remove it until Remove Curse or similar magic.

magic-item:morose-monocle.description: An opaque grey monocle through which you see only grief eaters and creatures in significant pain, sorrow or guilt, as glowing outlines within 60 feet. You have Advantage on Insight checks to gauge emotions.
