magic-item:mortal-coil.description: A ring of woven rose gold wire. If you die while wearing it, your soul enters the ring and your body stays Stable at 0 Hit Points; when you regain Hit Points your soul returns and the ring becomes a lump of lead.

magic-item:muscle-graft.description: Bugbear vampire muscle grafted to your flesh. Your Strength increases by 2 (maximum 30); on attuning, make a DC 15 Constitution save or lose 2 Constitution. Curse: for 1 year or until Remove Curse you can't end attunement and crave raw meat and blood; each week make a DC 10 Constitution save or become a progenitor-less Vampire Spawn.

magic-item:net-of-maiden-s-hair.description: A sweet-smelling hair net of maiden's hair. While worn, you have Advantage on Persuasion checks and on checks to escape Grappled, which you can attempt as a Bonus Action.

magic-item:nightmare-staff.description: A twisted marra-remains staff with 3 charges (regained at dusk). When a visible creature within 60 feet damages you, use your Reaction and 1 charge: it makes a DC 13 Intelligence save or is Frightened until the end of its next turn, taking 2d6 Psychic if already Frightened.

magic-item:paragon-s-plate.description: Fully enclosing ancient plate. You are immune to Unconscious and can act at 0 Hit Points while making Death Saving Throws; if you die, you keep moving and acting for up to 1 minute, unable to speak or cast spells. Curse: it can't be removed while attuned, and you automatically fail Death Saving Throws.

magic-item:paralyzing-bolt.description: A serpent-tooth crossbow bolt. A creature it damages makes a DC 15 Constitution save or is Paralyzed until the end of your next turn; it then becomes nonmagical.

magic-item:pharazorthok-sprout.description: A tentacled, eye-studded sapling. As a Magic action plant it in your space; while it is planted within 30 feet it whispers to you and grants Truesight 30 feet. A creature in its space can uproot it as a Magic action; if left planted 1 minute, it becomes a Roper hostile to you.

magic-item:pigskin-armor.description: Supple ogre swine hide armor that counts as Light armor. When you suffer a Critical Hit, roll a d20; on 17-20 it becomes a normal hit. While wearing it you snore loudly and eat twice as much.

magic-item:potion-of-glacial-resistance.description: Salty, warming brew of keppmir horn. For 1 hour you can breathe underwater and have Cold Resistance.

magic-item:potion-of-harm.description: A failed Potion of Heal, indistinguishable without level 3+ divination. Drinking it sets your Hit Points to 1d4; given to a creature at 0 Hit Points, it inflicts a Death Saving Throw failure and ends Stability.

magic-item:potion-of-heal.description: Ebon liquid from a downcast vampire's remains. Drinking it restores all your Hit Points.

magic-item:potion-of-life-sharing.description: A color-shifting draught of wolfentroika acid glands. For 1 minute, as a Bonus Action, a creature within 30 feet you can see or hear regains 4d6 Hit Points and you take that much unpreventable Necrotic damage. When it ends you gain 1 Exhaustion level.

magic-item:potion-of-malice.description: Gripper spore sacs. For 1 minute you release spores; enemies within 10 feet make a DC 10 Wisdom save or must target you with their attacks, and their weapon attacks have Disadvantage.

magic-item:potion-of-relentlessness.description: Viscous quoxxarie blood. For 1 minute, when reduced to 0 Hit Points you can spend a Hit Point Die to drop to 1 instead; afterward make a DC 15 Constitution save or gain 1 Exhaustion level per Hit Die spent.

magic-item:profane-charm.description: A fallen angel's charred feather wrapped in silver wire. While worn, you register as a Humanoid to Detect Evil and Good and similar effects.

magic-item:quakescale-armor.description: Quake drake scale mail that rumbles during storms, granting Thunder Resistance.

magic-item:queen-s-token.description: A humble acorn from a Faerie queen. While holding it you can cast Wish, after which it returns to her. A wish she perceives as a threat to her or her realm fails and turns the wisher into an oak tree, reversible only by a Wish made with a Queen's Token.

magic-item:resuscitation-bomb.description: Reeking stinking sludge remains. As a Magic action throw it up to 10 feet to fill a 30-foot-radius Sphere: creatures there end Incapacitated, Stunned and Unconscious, dying creatures gain Advantage on their next Death Saving Throw, and all others make a DC 15 Constitution save or are Poisoned for 1 minute.

magic-item:ring-of-hidden-desires.description: A rose gold band with an obsidian heart. Once per midnight, as a Magic action, a visible creature with Intelligence 4 or higher makes a DC 13 Wisdom save or you learn its greatest desire; on a success it becomes immune to the ring.

magic-item:ring-of-nightmares.description: Made with restless lumberer brain. 3 charges (regains 1d3 at dawn): as a Bonus Action, spend 1 to make your next spell this turn deal Psychic damage. While attuned you are immune to magic that disturbs your sleep or causes nightmares.

magic-item:ring-of-radiation.description: A braided copper ring. Your spells and abilities that deal Cold, Fire or Lightning damage have their range doubled.

magic-item:ring-of-veracity.description: A gold band stamped with smiling faces. While attuned you have Advantage on Search actions using Insight, and once per dawn you can cast Zone of Truth (DC 15) as a Magic action.

magic-item:rod-of-ruin.description: Stacked smoke-filled crystal spheres with 3 charges (regained at dusk). When a visible creature within 60 feet damages you, use your Reaction and 1 charge: it makes a DC 15 Constitution save or gains 1 Exhaustion level. With the Lich Transformation, it has Disadvantage and you gain 2d10 Temporary Hit Points when it fails.

magic-item:rod-of-the-pack-master.description: Wolf-and-bear carved driftwood. Once per dawn, as a Magic action, Polymorph any number of willing visible Humanoids within 30 feet into Black Bears or Wolves for 24 hours without Concentration, keeping their mental scores; end it early as a Magic action. At Stage 1+ of the Lycanthrope Transformation you can use it held in your teeth.

magic-item:sangromancer-s-vial.description: A red glass vial filled with your blood during attunement: roll up to 10 of your Hit Point Dice and reduce your Hit Point maximum by the total, creating a pool of those dice to spend instead of your own on Sangromancy spells. Each Long Rest restores half the dice rolled; ending attunement restores your maximum after a Long Rest.

magic-item:second-skin.description: A harness of lycanthrope hides that melds into your flesh, setting your AC to 14 + Dexterity modifier. Use a Reaction to halve Bludgeoning, Piercing or Slashing damage from a non-silver source. You have Disadvantage on Charisma checks with lycanthropes.

magic-item:shadowsteel-blades.description: Lightless slashing weapons said to be forged from torn souls. You have Advantage on attacks against targets in Medium or Heavy Armor, and a creature hit makes a DC 14 Constitution save or is Stunned until the end of its next turn. A natural 1 on your first attack of a turn forces the same save on you.

magic-item:sizzling-serum.description: Volatile potbelly ichor. As a Magic action, hurl it at a visible Construct or object within 30 feet: it makes a DC 15 Constitution save, taking 10d6 Fire, half on success.

magic-item:soulbond-stone.description: A weighty stone with a dusk-colored gem. Pressed to a creature dead less than 1 minute, it captures a soul fragment; spend its 3 charges to cast Speak with Dead as if targeting that corpse. It shatters when the last charge is spent.

magic-item:staff-of-briars.description: A staff of braerog claws with 10 charges (regains 1d6 + 4 at dawn; on spending the last, a d20 roll of 1 turns it to petals). As a Magic action, spend 1 to grow mundane thorny rose vines over a 20-foot square within 5 feet, making it Difficult Terrain.

magic-item:staff-of-the-sorcerer-king.description: A scarab-carved ebony staff wielded as a +2 Spear (you are proficient while attuned). While holding it you have +2 to spell attacks, Humanoids take -2 on saves against your spells, and you have Advantage on saves against spells targeting only you. Curse: until Remove Curse you keep it within reach and have Disadvantage with other weapons; each midnight make a DC 17 Constitution save or lose 10 Hit Point maximum (unless Undead), restorable only by Wish, dying and rising as a Wight at 0.

magic-item:stalk-symbiote.description: An aberrant eyestalk stitched into a Humanoid's scalp to attune. It grants Advantage on Perception checks and no Disadvantage on Initiative when surprised; at Stage 1+ of the Aberrant Horror Transformation you gain Blindsight 10 feet. You can't end attunement voluntarily, and if removed it regrows in 1d4 hours unless Remove Curse is cast first.

magic-item:star-metal-ring.description: A steel ring set with star metal that crusts your limbs; your Unarmed Strikes are magical and deal Force damage.

magic-item:straitjacket.description: A strap-laden jacket taking 10 minutes to don or doff. Without armor or shield, add your Intelligence modifier to AC, and you can cast spells without Somatic or costless Material components, but you have Disadvantage on weapon and Unarmed Strike attacks. At Stage 1+ of the Aberrant Horror Transformation, roll twice on the Unstable Form table and choose.

magic-item:suit-of-the-lamb.description: Comfortable poffer-wool clothes granting Lightning Resistance and protection from extreme cold weather.

magic-item:sun-shades.description: Black leather goggles with cloudy lenses. While worn, you ignore Light Sensitivity and similar Bright Light penalties but can't see in Darkness even with Darkvision. Donning or removing them is a Utilize action.

magic-item:talisman-of-tormach.description: A gore elemental's skull. When you kill a creature with a melee weapon or Unarmed Strike, you gain 10 Temporary Hit Points for 1 minute; while you have them, those attacks deal an extra 1d6 Necrotic.

magic-item:thought-talker-orbs.description: A marble-sized Emitter Orb and fist-sized Receiver Orb. Touch them together as a Magic action to activate for 7 days: a creature entering or starting its turn within 5 feet of the emitter makes a DC 13 Wisdom save or the receiver's holder learns its surface thoughts for 1 minute (immune for 24 hours on a success).

magic-item:thricecall-mirror.description: An iron hand mirror of grasping hands. As a Magic action, speak an extraplanar being's true name into it three times to summon it within 5 feet; it keeps its free will, can't leave the plane for 1 minute, then returns home unless it can travel planes itself.

magic-item:toadstool-toddy.description: A fizzy fuchsia faerie draught tasting of autumn rain. A Humanoid who drinks it is immune to Fire and Cold damage for 1 hour.

magic-item:tormach-s-blessed-weapon.description: A melee weapon blessed by the Lord of Blood Oaths. On a hit, the target makes a DC 15 Strength save or falls Prone; after one creature fails, not again until dawn. Each dawn roll a d20; on a 1 or 2 the blessing fades.

magic-item:ulmyr-s-eye.description: A smoke-filled crystal ball attuned in tiers. Aspirant: you know Guidance, and 12 charges (regains 2d4 + 4 at dawn) cast Augury (2), Clairvoyance (3), Detect Thoughts (2), Divination (4) or Scrying (5), DC 18; but Disadvantage on Perception and Investigation checks. Adept: a number of times per Long Rest equal to your Proficiency Bonus, as a Reaction, force a visible creature within 60 feet to reroll a D20 Test with Advantage or Disadvantage, and spend charges equal to spell level to cast your prepared spells; but after a Long Rest make a DC 14 Wisdom save or gain only a Short Rest. Master: cast Foresight (1 hour) once per Long Rest; but when you roll Initiative it casts Phantasmal Killer on you (DC 14).

magic-item:vilesmog-bomb.description: A smoky vial. As a Magic action, throw it up to 30 feet to fill a 15-foot-radius Sphere for 2 rounds; creatures entering or starting there lose Poison Resistance or Immunity and gain Poison Vulnerability for 1 minute.

magic-item:wand-of-the-poltergeist.description: A swirled wand topped with a screaming skull, with 7 charges (regains 1d6 + 1 at dusk; on spending the last, a d20 roll of 20 destroys it): Animate Objects (4), Major Image (3) or Shatter (2), using your spell save DC.

magic-item:wraps-of-aphaeleon.description: Cloth fist wraps blessed by the Arch Seraph of temperance. On your turn, spend 3 Focus Points (no action) to end Incapacitated, Paralyzed or Stunned on yourself.

magic-item:armor-of-the-vampire-lily-dra.description: Medium or heavy armor reinforced with vampire lily dragon spines, granting +1 AC. A creature that grapples you or hits you in melee within 5 feet makes a DC 15 Dexterity save or takes 2d6 Poison and is Poisoned until the end of its next turn.

magic-item:cherry-blossom-token.description: A pressed cherry blossom dragon flower. While carrying it you have Advantage on Performance checks to tell stories, and once per dusk you can reroll a failed attack roll, ability check or save, using the new roll.

magic-item:clematis-tainted-weapon.description: A sword, arrow or dart coated in clematis dragon toxin. A creature you hit makes a DC 16 Constitution save, taking 1d8 Poison (half on success); on a failure it is also Paralyzed until the end of its next turn unless immune to Poisoned, then immune to the paralysis for 24 hours.

magic-item:dandelion-hourglass.description: An hourglass of drifting dandelion dragon seeds. While attuned you have Advantage on Initiative, and once per dawn, as a Reaction when a visible creature within 120 feet rolls Initiative, it makes a DC 15 Intelligence save (it can choose to fail) or must reroll and use the new result.

magic-item:floral-dragon-grooming-rake.description: Spend 10 minutes grooming a willing floral dragon to gain Advantage on Animal Handling checks with it for 24 hours, and it has Advantage on Dexterity and Constitution saves for 24 hours.

magic-item:great-harvest-apple.description: An apple tree dragon's enormous apple that feeds up to ten creatures for a day. A creature that spends 10 minutes eating some regains 2d8 Hit Points, gains Temporary Hit Points equal to the number of others sharing the meal and gains Acid Resistance for 24 hours; once per 24 hours.

magic-item:hydrangea-dragon-antidote.description: A viscous blue-pink brew of living hydrangea dragon blooms. Drinking it ends Poisoned, restores 2d12 Hit Points and removes 3 Exhaustion levels.

magic-item:ornithogalum-dragon-elixir.description: A shimmering green distillate of ornithogalum dragon flowers. Drinking it removes 1 Exhaustion level and lets you spend Hit Dice as if taking a Short Rest.

magic-item:ornithogalum-dragon-honey.description: Sweet herbal honey. One hour after eating it, make a DC 19 Constitution save or gain 1 Exhaustion level.

magic-item:peony-dragon-essence.description: A fragrant vial with 1d4 + 2 doses. Add a dose as a material component when casting an abjuration spell to choose one: no Concentration needed for 1 minute, +1 to its spell attack or save DC, one extra target, or doubled duration.

magic-item:succulent-water-of-life.description: A light green liquid that turns dark red when shaken. Drinking it restores 1d10 Hit Points, then 1d10 more at the start of each of your turns for 1 minute while you have at least 1 Hit Point.

magic-item:wisteria-dragon-perfume.description: A glass orb of wisteria perfume. As an action, throw it up to 60 feet to release a 20-foot-radius invisible cloud lasting 1d4 rounds; creatures starting or entering it make a DC 19 Constitution save (floral dragons other than wisteria with Disadvantage) or fall Unconscious for 1 minute, ending if damaged.

magic-item:book-of-dzyan.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a DC 20 Intelligence (Arcana) check
magic-item:book-of-dzyan.description: A Celestial tome from a drowned civilization. Attunement requires a DC 20 Intelligence (Arcana) check and ends only when a demon or devil casts remove curse on you. Benefits: see invisible within 30 feet; read and write Abyssal and Infernal; spellcasters always have guidance, detect magic, locate object, fly, divination, contact deity, and call deity prepared; touch reveals secret doors within 5 feet; advantage on Insight checks, learning a creature's secret on a 20 or higher (once per creature); +1 spell save DC. Drawback: when you meet a new kind of creature, roll a d20 each turn and on a 10 or higher spend your action studying it. Dreadful Insight: Insatiable Curiosity (+15). Lore: auto-succeed DC 25 or lower checks about planar creatures.

magic-item:necronomicon.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a DC 20 Intelligence (Arcana) check
magic-item:necronomicon.description: The most infamous Mythos tome, written in Infernal. Attunement requires a DC 20 Intelligence (Arcana) check and ends only by defeating a Mythos deity. Benefits: double proficiency on Intelligence checks; read and write Abyssal, Celestial, Draconic, and Primordial; spellcasters always have evil eye, dread curse of Azathoth, dust of Suleiman, and Voorish sign prepared; ghouls and ghasts won't attack you unprovoked; skeletons and zombies obey your commands; Mythos deities target you only as a last resort and you have advantage on Charisma checks to sway them; one extra spell slot of each level you can use; +2 spell save DC. Drawback: each midnight roll a d20, gaining a Doom point on 10 or higher; at 20 points you vanish. Dreadful Insight: Compulsion to Annihilation (+20). Lore: auto-succeed checks about undead and DC 20 or lower checks about the Mythos.

magic-item:pnakotic-manuscripts.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a DC 15 Intelligence (Religion) check
magic-item:pnakotic-manuscripts.description: A Primordial text from a pre-human species that teaches movement between time's beats. Attunement requires a DC 15 Intelligence (Religion) check and ends with remove curse. Benefits: double your Initiative bonus, +10 Speed, advantage on Dexterity saves, +1 AC, and once per turn while moving you can teleport back to a spot you occupied during that move. Drawback: accelerated aging that compounds weekly and persists across re-attunement. Dreadful Insight: No Time to Tarry (+15). Lore: auto-succeed checks about time.

magic-item:seven-cryptical-books-of-hsan.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a DC 20 Intelligence (Religion) check
magic-item:seven-cryptical-books-of-hsan.description: Seven Celestial scrolls on gods, the world, and the planes. Attunement requires a DC 20 Intelligence (Religion) check and ends after visiting all seven realms they open. Benefits: prepare one extra cleric spell per spell level, +1 DC for cleric-list spells, advantage on Wisdom saves, one extra spell slot of your highest level, and cast gate once per day (Wisdom) to the next of seven realms described in the books. Drawback: each week without using the gate gives a level of exhaustion that remains until you do. Dreadful Insight: Enemy of the Dark (+20). Lore: auto-succeed checks about dead gods.

magic-item:the-king-in-yellow.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a DC 15 Charisma (Performance) check
magic-item:the-king-in-yellow.description: A thin volume holding a dreamlike play. Inspecting it compels a DC 15 Charisma (Performance) check; success attunes you, and attunement ends only by meeting Hastur. Benefits: advantage on Performance checks and on Deception checks built on the play; cast contact deity (always Hastur) once per long rest; after each long rest roll a d20, and on a 1 you can cast call deity to summon Hastur, gaining unremovable exhaustion if you don't. Drawback: disadvantage on Perception, Insight, and Investigation checks. Dreadful Insight: Lost Carcosa (+20). Lore: auto-succeed checks about Hastur.

magic-item:adamant-scale.description: When you cast Mage Armor, you can consume this item: the base AC becomes 15 plus the target's Dexterity modifier, and Critical Hits against the target become normal hits for the duration.

magic-item:distorted-hourglass.description: When you cast Haste or Slow, you can consume this item: you cast both spells but concentrate on only one; losing Concentration ends both.

magic-item:dragon-s-wingscale.description: When you cast Dragon's Breath, you can consume this item: the target also gains a 30-foot Fly Speed for the duration.

magic-item:gilded-pate.description: A gilded skull usable as a Memento Mori. When you use it as a Spellcasting Focus, you can change a spell's damage to Necrotic or Radiant, or with a level 1+ spell force one target to succeed on a Wisdom save against your spell save DC or be Frightened until the end of its next turn.

magic-item:grimoire-of-stolen-secrets.description: A blank tome. A Spell Scroll left tucked inside for 8 hours is consumed and its spell inscribed. You always have its spells prepared and on your class spell lists; it holds up to 5 spells of level 5 or lower and blanks when attunement ends.

magic-item:iron-feather.description: When you cast Forced Hesitation, you can consume this item: a target that fails its save also reduces its Initiative by the two highest damage dice combined.

magic-item:jade-toadstool.description: When you cast Revivify, you can consume this item: in place of the diamond, and the target revives with full Hit Points.

magic-item:leaden-mirror.description: When you cast Counterspell, you can consume this item: if the target fails its save, it also loses the spell slot and takes 1d6 Force damage per spell level.

magic-item:magic-magnifier.description: When you cast Ensorcelled Strike, you can consume this item: if the attack hits, the target takes an extra 3d6 Force damage the first time a spell damages it before the end of your next turn.

magic-item:magiceramic-mask.description: When you cast Arcanist's Magic Aura, you can consume this item: you can target an unwilling creature, which must succeed on a Charisma save against your spell save DC or suffer the spell's Mask effect for the duration.

magic-item:miniature-multiverse-model.description: A mithril model of the cosmos usable as an Astrolabe. As a Spellcasting Focus it grants +1 to spell attack rolls and spell save DCs. As a Reaction, when a creature you can see within 60 feet makes a D20 Test, you can give it Advantage or Disadvantage.

magic-item:necklace-of-fangs.description: Vampire and werebeast teeth usable as a Memento Mori. It has 6 charges, regaining 1d6 at dawn (on the last charge, roll 1d20; on a 1 it melts, leaving permanent bite marks). As a Magic action expend 1: a creature within 30 feet makes a DC 13 Dexterity save, taking 6d6 Piercing damage or half on a success, and you regain Hit Points equal to the damage.

magic-item:pickled-pixie-heart.description: A preserved fairy heart in a vial, usable as a Memento Mori. It has 5 charges, regaining 1d4 + 1 at dawn (on the last charge, roll 1d10; on a 1 it dissolves). Expend 1 to cast Misty Step; chosen creatures within 5 feet of where you left make a DC 14 Constitution save or are Poisoned for 1 minute (save ends at end of each turn).

magic-item:polychromatic-prism.description: When you cast Chromatic Orb, you can consume this item: you can choose Necrotic, Psychic, or Radiant damage, and it deals an extra 2d8 damage.

magic-item:restless-cremains.description: A trembling vial of ashes usable as a Memento Mori. It has 9 charges, regaining 1d6 + 3 at dawn (on the last charge, roll 1d20; on a 1 it crumbles). When you cast a spell using it as a focus, expend charges up to the spell's level to summon that many friendly Dust Mephits within 60 feet, acting after you for 10 minutes or until reduced to 0 Hit Points.

magic-item:ruby-toadstool.description: When you cast Enlarge/Reduce, you can consume this item: the target's size changes by two categories and its 1d4 rolls become 1d8.

magic-item:scythe-of-grim-harvest.description: A two-handed scythe usable as a Memento Mori. You have Advantage on attacks against Bloodied creatures. As a Reaction when a creature within 30 feet drops to 0 Hit Points, you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to its CR or level and make one weapon attack. As an action, chosen creatures within 10 feet make a DC 13 Dexterity save, taking Slashing damage equal to 3d6 plus your level, or half on a success.

magic-item:starfall-spotter.description: A gold and silver star model usable as an Astrolabe. It has 12 charges, regaining 2d6 at dawn (on the last charge, roll 1d20; on a 1 it vanishes). Expend 1 to cast Magic Missile or 4 to cast Fireball (DC 15), dealing Radiant damage.

magic-item:tiny-mithril-hammer.description: When you cast Magic Weapon, you can consume this item: its duration becomes 8 hours.

magic-item:witchwood-jaw.description: When you cast Animate Dead, you can consume this item: the Skeletons and Zombies can speak and understand your languages.

magic-item:animated-inks.description: Drinking it gives you a tattoo of a creature type you imagine, up to CR 1 (uncommon), 3 (rare), or 7 (very rare). As a Magic action the tattoo steps off you within 60 feet as that creature for 10 minutes, friendly and obeying you on your Initiative, returning at the end or at 0 Hit Points; usable once per 3 days. Ending attunement removes it.

magic-item:bonebreakers.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a Pugilist; brass knuckles
magic-item:bonebreakers.description: Battered brass knuckles. You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Once per dawn on a hit, the target makes a DC 19 Constitution save or is maimed until Greater Restoration: Broken Arm (Disadvantage on weapon and Unarmed Strike attacks), Broken Leg (half Speed), Broken Ribs (Disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity checks and saves), or Broken Skull (Disadvantage on Intelligence and Wisdom checks and saves).

magic-item:bottle-of-brew-tasting.description: A bottle with a blank label; a liquid poured in has its contents and effects written on the label in Common until the bottle is emptied.

magic-item:bottomless-box-of-treats.description: It has 5 charges, regaining 1d4 at dawn. Expend 1 to pull out a treat; a Beast that eats it regains 3d4 + 3 Hit Points and removes one Exhaustion level or ends Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, or Paralyzed.

magic-item:club-of-unconsciousness.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. On a Critical Hit, the target makes a DC 15 Constitution save or forgets the past minute and is Unconscious for 1 minute, ending if it takes damage or is shaken awake.

magic-item:coin-of-easy-living.description: A gold piece that always lands on the side you call while it's in the air; you can summon it to your palm as a Bonus Action.

magic-item:everfull-stein.description: While its lid is closed and it's empty, name a nonmagical ale, beer, or mead as a Bonus Action and it fills with it.

magic-item:ferguson-s-talons.description: Hand claws from a fabled feline. You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. While holding them you have 60-foot Darkvision and can cast Polymorph on yourself to become only a Cat. They have 9 charges: when you fail a Death Saving Throw, expend 1 to succeed instead; this property is lost at 0 charges.

magic-item:last-rites-rum.description: Drinking it deals 2d4 Necrotic damage to you; for 1 hour you have Resistance to Radiant damage and your Unarmed Strikes can deal Necrotic damage.

magic-item:leather-jerkin.description: While you wear no armor, this garment grants +1 (rare), +2 (very rare), or +3 (legendary) AC; you can use a Shield and keep the benefit.

magic-item:loaded-dice.description: Ordinary-looking dice. They have 6 charges, regaining 1d6 at dawn: when you fail a D20 Test and aren't Incapacitated, expend 1 to reroll and use the new roll. You have Advantage on checks to win dice games played with them.

magic-item:mage-mashers.description: Heavy black-ore brass knuckles. You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Hits deal an extra 1d6 Force damage to creatures that can cast spells, and creatures you damage have Disadvantage on Concentration saves.

magic-item:medallion-of-mettle.description: Whenever you gain Temporary Hit Points, you gain an extra 1d6 Temporary Hit Points.

magic-item:mugfist-knuckles.description: Brass knuckles in obvious fake gold. You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. On a Critical Hit, you gain gold pieces equal to the target's Challenge Rating (or level); below CR 1 counts as 0.

magic-item:penitent-pummelers.description: Gold knuckles etched with holy symbols. You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Hits deal an extra 1d12 Radiant damage to Fiends and Undead.

magic-item:poundwise-porter.description: For 1 minute after drinking it, you gain +3 to attack and damage rolls with Unarmed Strikes.

magic-item:punchdrunk-punters.attunementNote: Brass knuckles, hand claws, or punch knife
magic-item:punchdrunk-punters.description: Cask-soaked brawling weapons. You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Each time you damage a creature it gains a Toxin Point for 1 hour (maximum 10). As a Magic action, a creature you can see takes 1d8 Poison damage per Toxin Point and loses them all.

magic-item:ramuh-s-katar.description: A violet-metal punch knife. You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Critical Hits deal an extra 2d6 Lightning damage. While attuned, you have Advantage on Initiative and can cast Jump on yourself.

magic-item:ratbite.description: Fur-clumped rat-tooth hand claws. You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. While attuned you are immune to magical contagions. A creature it damages makes a DC 11 Constitution save or contracts Sewer Plague; on a Critical Hit it takes an extra 2d4 Necrotic damage and has Disadvantage on saves against magical contagions for seven days.

magic-item:salamander-sauce.description: Drinking it deals 2d4 Fire damage to you; for 1 hour you have Resistance to Cold damage and your Unarmed Strikes can deal Fire damage.

magic-item:spiked-collar.description: A spiked collar that gives a Beast wearing it a bonus to attack and damage rolls determined by the collar's rarity.

magic-item:studded-collar.description: A crystal-studded collar that gives a Beast wearing it a bonus to AC and saving throws determined by the collar's rarity.

magic-item:yggdrasil-s-tap.description: An ironhard dark-wood punch knife. You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. On a hit you can roll and expend a Hit Point Die: the target takes that much extra Piercing damage and you regain that many Hit Points.

magic-item:bard-in-a-box.description: As a Bonus Action, it plays one of up to five known songs (no lyrics) at adjustable volume. Feeding it properly labeled sheet music teaches a song, replacing the oldest if it already knows five.

magic-item:barge-helm.description: If you move at least 20 feet straight toward a target immediately before shoving it successfully, it takes 1d6 Bludgeoning damage.

magic-item:barricade-shield.description: Once per dawn as a Magic action, plant it to expand up to 15 feet in each direction, conforming to enclosed spaces, as a nonmagical object (AC 14, 40 Hit Points) for up to 1 minute. While holding it expanded your Speed is 0 and you have Disadvantage on Dexterity checks and saves; it reverts if reduced to 0 Hit Points or moved, or as your Bonus Action.

magic-item:basco-s-handy-bangle.description: Ten runes for alchemist's supplies, calligrapher's supplies, carpenter's tools, cook's utensils, leatherworker's tools, smith's tools, tinker's tools, musical instruments (drum, flute, lute, lyre), navigator's tools, and thieves' tools. As a Magic action, touch a rune and speak the command words to gain proficiency (or Expertise if already proficient) with that tool for 24 hours; that rune recharges after 1d4 days.

magic-item:basilisk-dagger.description: It deals an extra 1d4 Poison damage on a hit. On a natural 20 against a Large or smaller creature, the target makes a DC 15 Constitution save or is Restrained until the end of your next turn.

magic-item:bath-potion.description: Drinking it magically cleans your body, breath, hair, and nails, leaving you polished and lightly scented for 24 hours (with the occasional escaping bubble).

magic-item:baton-of-many-sizes.description: As a Magic action with a command word, this 1-foot rod extends up to 50 feet in either direction, stopping and bracing against what it touches. Beyond 10 feet you must succeed on a Strength (Athletics) check at the start of each turn (DC 8 + 1 per 5 feet beyond 10) to keep hold. Dropping it or attacking with it while over 10 feet retracts it, as does repeating the command word as a Magic action.

magic-item:battle-tax.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. On a natural 20 against a Small or larger enemy, you gain gold pieces equal to the damage, appearing in your purse or bursting from the target; once per 12 hours.

magic-item:battlebrew-maul.description: Its keg head holds up to 4 gallons of battlebrew, making 1 gallon at dawn and 1 each time you roll Initiative while holding it. You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. On a natural 20, the target takes an extra 2d6 Acid damage, and the next Fire damage it takes within 1 minute deals an extra 2d6 Fire damage.

magic-item:battlechef-buckler.description: While wielding it, you have Advantage on saves against effects that deal Fire damage. Placed face down over a vessel of up to 2 gallons of water-based liquid, it brings the liquid to a boil in 10 minutes.

magic-item:battlechef-s-splendid-saucepa.description: Boiling up to 1 pound of organic nonmagical material in it for 10 minutes makes a stew feeding four creatures for a day. It functions as a mace with a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls and an extra 1d4 Thunder damage against targets wearing metal armor or made of metal or stone. If you aren't in Heavy armor, a Utilize action dons or doffs it as a helmet for +1 AC.

magic-item:battlement-bow.description: When you hit a creature with a ranged attack, a barrier stands between you and it until the start of your next turn, giving you Half Cover against its ranged attacks and effects; hitting another creature moves the barrier.

magic-item:belt-of-the-raid-leader.description: Once per dawn as a Magic action, let loose a war cry: you and up to five allies within 60 feet that hear you have Advantage on attack rolls until the start of your next turn, and you can make one weapon or Unarmed Strike attack as a Bonus Action.

magic-item:bird-of-a-feather.description: As a Magic action while holding this stuffed roc, gain a 20-foot Fly Speed for 1 minute (Concentration), carrying up to 200 pounds; taking damage ends it and you fall. A common toy then becomes nonmagical; an uncommon one recharges after 1d4 hours.

magic-item:blizzard-sphere.description: As a Magic action, throw it at a creature or object within 30 feet to release a 20-foot Emanation blizzard for 1d4 rounds (or until Dispel Magic as a level 5 spell). A creature entering for the first time on a turn or starting its turn there makes a DC 15 Constitution save, taking 4d8 Cold damage and half Speed until its next turn, or half damage on a success. The area is Heavily Obscured, icy Difficult Terrain.

magic-item:blood-pact-pendants.description: Two pendants bound by a 1-minute ritual in which both wearers permanently sacrifice an agreed number of Hit Point maximum (minimum 1). While both wear them on the same plane and one is conscious, a bound creature that dies is revived with 2d10 Hit Points plus twice its sacrifice, and the other drops to 0 Hit Points and Unconscious regardless of other effects. The pact then ends, both maximums are restored, and the pendants crack and become nonmagical.

magic-item:bloodmage-dagger.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a spellcaster; dagger
magic-item:bloodmage-dagger.description: An obsidian dagger usable as a Spellcasting Focus. You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It has 5 charges, regaining 1d3 + 2 at dusk. As a Magic action, expend 1 for a melee spell attack within 5 feet dealing Necrotic damage equal to 3d6 + your spellcasting modifier, regaining that many Hit Points (not from Constructs, Plants, or Undead). Or when you cast a level 1-3 spell targeting yourself or one creature, expend charges to raise its slot level by one each (maximum 5), spending and rolling that many Hit Dice as Necrotic damage that ignores Resistance and Immunity; dropping to 0 makes the spell fail.

magic-item:bloodscryer-oculus.description: While attuned, visual obscurement doesn't hinder you, you see normally in Dim Light and magical or nonmagical Darkness within 60 feet (or add 60 feet to existing Darkvision), and you have Advantage on sight-based Perception checks. Each once per dawn, cast Hunter's Mark (level 3 version), Locate Creature, or Scrying without Concentration, targeting only creatures whose blood you can see.

magic-item:bolt.description: A metal heavy crossbow that loads bolts of lightning. You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon; it deals 1d12 Lightning instead of 1d10 Piercing, with Advantage against metal targets or creatures in metal armor. When another creature within 10 feet takes Lightning damage while you hold it, you take 1d6 Lightning damage per 10 it took.

magic-item:boots-of-dendallen.description: While wearing them, you have a Fly Speed equal to your Speed and can hover up to 20 feet up, and Dash grants 10 extra feet. They have 4 charges, regaining 1d3 + 1 at dusk; as a Bonus Action expend 1 to cast Expeditious Retreat or Misty Step. Curse: on first donning make a DC 16 Wisdom save; on a failure you take 4d8 Necrotic damage, can't remove them without Remove Curse, have Disadvantage on Acrobatics checks and Dexterity saves, spend 10 extra feet to stand from Prone, and take another 4d8 Necrotic damage when they're removed.

magic-item:boots-of-the-cloud-jumper.description: Once before touching solid ground again, you can make a standing jump in midair within your remaining movement; jumping while falling reduces falling damage by up to 20 feet.

magic-item:borboss-joyous-wand-of-color.description: While holding it, you draw illusory strokes of color in the air or on surfaces it touches; they shed Dim Light 5 feet and fade after 1 hour. Drawing on an object an unwilling creature wears or carries requires it to fail a DC 10 Dexterity save.

magic-item:boreal-pendant.description: While attuned you have Resistance to Cold damage. It has 8 charges, regaining 1d6 + 2 at dawn; expend charges to cast Charm Person (1), Color Spray (1), Hypnotic Pattern (3), or Ice Storm (4), save DC 15. On the last charge, roll 1d20; on a 1 it melts, reforming after 1 year.

magic-item:bottled-abyss.description: A black poison. A creature that drinks it takes 4d6 Psychic damage and makes a DC 18 Constitution save; on a failure it is Blinded and can't benefit from a Long Rest, suffering nightmares, repeating the save every 24 hours until it succeeds or is cured by Greater Restoration, Heal, or Wish.

magic-item:bounty-hunter-enforcer.description: A spear dealing Bludgeoning damage with a spring-loaded Net in its head. After a melee hit, as a Bonus Action deploy the Net to Restrain a Large or smaller target, or prime it as a Bonus Action to deploy on the next hit (thrown or swung). While deployed its attacks have Disadvantage, and it can't attack while restraining something; a Utilize action resets it. The Net follows normal Net rules and is destroyed if detached; replacing it takes 1 minute.

magic-item:bow-of-mind-thievery.description: Its arrows deal an extra 1d4 Psychic damage. Once per dawn, when an arrow hits a Humanoid, it makes a DC 15 Wisdom save or is affected by Dominate Person for up to 1 minute without Concentration, and you can use a Bonus Action to see and hear through it until the start of your next turn.

magic-item:braided-quarterstaff.description: A quarterstaff of braided rope. As a Bonus Action with a command word it becomes a 50-foot rope, and back; a creature Restrained by the rope when it tightens needs an action and a DC 15 Athletics check (by it or a creature within 5 feet) to escape. It can carry a small tied object when reforming and breaks only to magic, becoming nonmagical.

magic-item:brambleheart-quiver.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a druid or ranger
magic-item:brambleheart-quiver.description: Grows 4 thorned magic arrows, regrowing 1d3 + 1 at dawn; picked arrows stay magical for 1 minute and grant a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls while you're attuned. When one hits, as a Bonus Action with a command word the target takes 2d4 Piercing damage and a Spike Growth effect appears centered within 5 feet of it until the start of your next turn, no Concentration.

magic-item:breastplate-of-the-morning-li.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a cleric or paladin; breastplate
magic-item:breastplate-of-the-morning-li.description: While wearing it you gain a +1 bonus to AC. Once per dawn as a Magic action, it flashes: other creatures within 30 feet make a DC 15 Constitution save or are Blinded until the end of their next turn; Undead save with Disadvantage and take 2d8 Radiant damage, or half on a success.

magic-item:brooch-of-many-sizes.description: Once per dawn, cast Enlarge/Reduce on yourself. While it lasts, as a Bonus Action overload it to change one more size (no larger than Huge or smaller than Tiny), stacking the damage and weight effects as a second casting. When you return to normal size you are Incapacitated with Speed 0 until the end of your next turn, and the brooch can't be used for 7 days.

magic-item:bug-smashers.description: Centipede-shell gloves. Your Unarmed Strikes with them deal Bludgeoning or Piercing damage. On a natural 20 with an Unarmed Strike, the target takes 2d6 Poison damage and makes a DC 13 Constitution save or is Poisoned until the start of your next turn.

magic-item:cactus-mace.description: The first target it hits on each of your turns takes an extra 1d4 Piercing damage.

magic-item:candle-of-anti-light.description: While lit (up to 1 hour total; lit or snuffed as a Bonus Action) it sheds magical Darkness in a 10-foot radius that Darkvision can't penetrate and nonmagical light can't illuminate; covering it blocks the effect.

magic-item:catnip-amulet.description: While wearing it, you have Advantage on checks to find or call Tiny domestic cats and on Animal Handling checks with them.

magic-item:celestial-circlet.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a good-aligned cleric
magic-item:celestial-circlet.description: A halo sheds Bright Light 20 feet and Dim Light 20 more. You are always under Protection from Evil and Good against one creature type (not Celestials) chosen at dawn. It has 7 charges, regaining 1d4 + 3 at dawn: cast Cure Wounds (1 charge per level, up to 4) or Spirit Guardians (3) with your DC and modifier, and immediately before or after, fly 10 feet as a Bonus Action without provoking Opportunity Attacks. On the last charge, roll 1d20; on a 1 it becomes nonmagical.

magic-item:ceratopper.description: An adamantine triceratops helm granting +1 AC. If you move 20 feet straight toward a target before an Unarmed Strike with it, the hit deals Piercing damage equal to 3d4 + your Strength modifier, and a target no more than one size larger makes a DC 13 Strength save or falls Prone. Once per 2 days, cast Polymorph on yourself to become a Triceratops.

magic-item:charlatan-s-wardrobe.description: Always-clean clothes whose appearance you change as a Magic action with a twirl and command word. The change is an illusion revealed by touch or a Study action with a DC 13 Investigation check, and they only ever look like clothing.

magic-item:chillspike.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon, it deals an extra 1d10 Cold damage, and its effects ignore Cold Resistance. When it reduces a Large or smaller creature to 0 Hit Points, you can encase it in ice for 1 minute (AC 12, 20 Hit Points, Immunity to Poison and Psychic, Vulnerability to Fire); it can't fall Prone or make Death Saving Throws, and healing or breaking the ice frees it. As a Magic action, plant it to raise spikes under up to three targets within 20 feet, each making a DC 16 Dexterity save or taking 2d8 Cold damage.

magic-item:chromacloth.description: A cloth you can set to red (Fire), yellow (Lightning), green (Poison), or blue (Cold) as a Magic action. Worn as a headband, once per dawn it grants Resistance to the first damage of its color's type. Used as a sling, its ammunition deals its color's damage type instead of Bludgeoning.

magic-item:cinnabar-rapier.description: It has 10 charges, regaining 1d8 + 2 at dawn. On a hit, expend any number of charges to deal an extra 1d4 Poison damage per charge.

magic-item:circlet-of-the-huntsman-s-thi.description: While wearing it you have Advantage on Survival checks. It has 5 charges, all regained at dusk: as a Bonus Action expend 1 to cast Hunter's Mark (Advantage on Concentration saves for it), and spend 1 more (or 1 alone as a Bonus Action) to gain 120-foot Truesight for 1 minute. Curse: attuning curses you until Remove Curse; whenever you roll a 1 on an attack roll or ability check, you take 1d6 Psychic damage.

magic-item:cloak-of-the-boundless-spirit.description: It has 3 charges, all regained at dawn. As a Reaction when an ally you can see within 15 feet takes damage, expend 1 to reduce it by 2d6. An ally within 15 feet who rolls 19 or 20 on a Death Saving Throw regains 1 Hit Point (a 19 only once per Long Rest), and you can expend 1 charge as a Reaction to give it 2d6 Temporary Hit Points.

magic-item:clockwork-faefly.description: Tap it twice as a Bonus Action and it hovers 5 feet up, following within 60 feet of you; as a Bonus Action with a command word it moves 20 feet. Within 60 feet, as a Magic action it emits light as the Light spell, or once per dawn casts Faerie Fire (DC 13) in a 20-foot Cube without Concentration. It is an object with AC 10, 10 Hit Points, Immunity to Poison and Psychic, and Resistance to other damage; Mending restores 2d6, and at 0 it is inert for 2 days.

magic-item:clockwork-healerbee.description: A tiny flying device that stays in your space without provoking Opportunity Attacks. It has 8 charges, regaining 1d6 + 2 at dawn; as a Bonus Action with a command word, expend up to 3 to send it to a creature you can see within 20 feet, which regains 1d6 Hit Points per charge. It is an object with AC 15, 10 Hit Points, Immunity to Poison and Psychic, and Resistance to other damage; Mending restores 2d6, and at 0 it is unusable for 24 hours.

magic-item:clockwork-inkbeetle.description: Placed on parchment you carry, it stamps a compass rose and traces a to-scale map of your travels (20 feet, 200 feet, 2 miles, or 20 miles per inch, changed as a Magic action), even inside a book, and is immune to direction-altering magic. It clicks when it runs out of room. Attached to one of the Bands of the Found and Lost while you wear the other, it tracks you remotely on the same plane.

magic-item:coil-crook.description: A rigid staff of silken rope; as a Bonus Action with a command word it becomes a 10-foot rope, and back, usable as a Spellcasting Focus in either form. Once per dawn, cast Rope Trick using it as the rope.

magic-item:coldsnap.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It deals an extra 1d4 Cold damage. It has 3 charges, all regained at dawn: on a hit against a creature without Cold Immunity, expend 1 to force a DC 15 Constitution save; its Speed becomes 0 until the start of your next turn on a failure, or is halved on a success.

magic-item:companion-s-band.description: As a Magic action, summon a spectral Small or smaller Beast companion within 5 feet that sheds Dim Light 5 feet, stays within 30 feet, is friendly, and understands intent but not language; it lasts until dismissed or you remove the band. After it's present at least once a day for 7 consecutive days, it bonds to you permanently: no attunement is needed (others can't attune while you live), you summon it as a Bonus Action, and it becomes solid enough to pet and hold.

magic-item:container-of-heat-and-frost.description: Holds 1 gallon. As a Magic action press a glyph to boil the liquid, chill it to just above freezing, or hold its current temperature; boiling or chilling takes 1 minute and is then maintained.

magic-item:coralshield-golem.description: A coral crab golem worn on your back. As a Bonus Action command it to don itself as your shield, or return to your back; if you have no free hand it returns.

magic-item:couatl-herald-s-fang.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a good-aligned creature; any sword or dagger
magic-item:couatl-herald-s-fang.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. On a natural 20, the target takes an extra 2d6 Poison damage and makes a DC 15 Constitution save or is Incapacitated with Speed 0 until it takes damage or is shaken awake. Flight of the Couatls: while attuned to three items with this property, you gain a 30-foot Fly Speed (or +30 feet to an existing one).

magic-item:couatl-herald-s-guard.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a good-aligned creature; shield
magic-item:couatl-herald-s-guard.description: Once per Short or Long Rest, as a Reaction when a creature you can see within 10 feet takes damage, you take it instead as Force damage. Flight of the Couatls: while attuned to three items with this property, you gain a 30-foot Fly Speed (or +30 feet to an existing one).

magic-item:couatl-herald-s-lash.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a good-aligned creature; whip
magic-item:couatl-herald-s-lash.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It has the Light property. Once per turn when you Attack, forgo one attack to bind a Medium or smaller creature in reach: DC 15 Dexterity save or it is Grappled and takes 1d4 Bludgeoning damage, becoming Restrained if already Grappled by it. It escapes with an action and a DC 15 Athletics or Acrobatics check, or if you move more than 10 feet away or drop the whip. Flight of the Couatls: while attuned to three items with this property, you gain a 30-foot Fly Speed (or +30 feet to an existing one).

magic-item:couatl-herald-s-mantle.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a good-aligned creature
magic-item:couatl-herald-s-mantle.description: While wearing it, you have Advantage on saves to avoid or end Poisoned and magical contagions, and you are immune to effects that sense emotions. Flight of the Couatls: while attuned to three items with this property, you gain a 30-foot Fly Speed (or +30 feet to an existing one).

magic-item:couatl-herald-s-radiance.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a good-aligned creature
magic-item:couatl-herald-s-radiance.description: It has 5 charges, regaining 1d3 + 2 at dawn; expend 1 to cast Create Food and Water, Cure Wounds (level 2 version), Lesser Restoration, Protection from Poison, Sanctuary, or Shield with your spellcasting modifier and DC. On the last charge, roll 1d20; on a 1 it vanishes. Flight of the Couatls: while attuned to three items with this property, you gain a 30-foot Fly Speed (or +30 feet to an existing one).

magic-item:couatl-herald-s-reach.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a good-aligned creature; any bow
magic-item:couatl-herald-s-reach.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It has 4 charges, regaining 1d3 + 1 at dawn. When you make a ranged attack against a Large or smaller creature, expend 1 and choose a limb: on a hit it deals Radiant damage, and the target makes a DC 15 Dexterity save or the limb is pinned for up to 1 minute (Prone, unable to move, or Disadvantage on attacks, GM's choice); an action and a DC 15 Athletics check by it or an adjacent creature frees it. Flight of the Couatls: while attuned to three items with this property, you gain a 30-foot Fly Speed (or +30 feet to an existing one).

magic-item:couatl-herald-s-scales.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a good-aligned creature; scale mail
magic-item:couatl-herald-s-scales.description: While wearing it you gain a +1 bonus to AC and have no Stealth Disadvantage. Once per dawn, as a Reaction when a creature within 10 feet damages you, a spectral couatl strikes it: DC 15 Dexterity save, 4d10 Radiant damage, or half on a success. Flight of the Couatls: while attuned to three items with this property, you gain a 30-foot Fly Speed (or +30 feet to an existing one).

magic-item:cratering-quarterstaff.description: Requires Strength 17 to wield well. You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It has 5 charges, regaining 1d4 + 1 at dawn. Once per turn right after an attack roll with it, expend 1 to create a 10-foot Cone of tremors and flame toward the target; each creature in it makes a DC 16 Dexterity save (the target with Disadvantage), taking 1d8 Bludgeoning and 1d8 Fire damage, or half on a success.

magic-item:crosier-of-divine-power.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a cleric or paladin
magic-item:crosier-of-divine-power.description: It functions as a magic quarterstaff with a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls. When you roll Initiative against an enemy it creates 2 radiant motes, and at the start of each of your turns in combat a roll of 6 on 1d6 adds another. When you hit with it or heal with a spell or magical effect while holding it, expend a mote to add 2d6 (Radiant if damage). Motes last 1 minute.

magic-item:crown-of-deep-winter.description: While wearing it you have Resistance to Cold damage, and once per dawn you can cast Fire Shield (chill shield) from it. Once per Short or Long Rest, as a Reaction when a creature within 5 feet hits you with an attack roll, all other creatures within 5 feet make a DC 16 Dexterity save, taking 2d8 Cold damage, or half on a success.

magic-item:crypt-keeper-glaive.description: You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. When it reduces a hostile Small or larger creature to 0 Hit Points, you gain 1d10 Temporary Hit Points and your next melee hit with it deals extra Necrotic damage equal to that amount (lost after 1 minute). Undead it kills can't be raised again. The first time each turn you hit a Prone target with it, it deals maximum damage.

magic-item:dagger-of-the-ogre-mage.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Its hollow hilt holds up to three Spell Scrolls; a cantrip scroll left inside for 1 minute lets you cast that cantrip at will with your DC and attack modifier, using the sword as focus and for Somatic components, without consuming the scroll. Casting a damaging cantrip this way changes the sword's damage type to match for 1 minute.

magic-item:dark-fathom-armor.description: While wearing it you gain a +1 bonus to AC and can breathe underwater. Once per dusk, cast Black Tentacles (DC 15) in a stationary 15-foot square centered on you, without Concentration; you are immune to it.

magic-item:dead-ringer.description: When you drop to 0 Hit Points or fail a Death Saving Throw while wearing it, the three nearest enemies within 30 feet make a DC 15 Wisdom save or take 2d12 Necrotic damage (automatic success if unhurt or Deafened). If you're healed or stabilized after dropping to 0, it can't be used again until dusk.

magic-item:death-knell.description: You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Once per turn when it reduces a Small or larger creature to 0 Hit Points, each wounded enemy within 15 feet of it makes a DC 15 Wisdom save, taking 1d8 Psychic damage, or half on a success.

magic-item:devil-s-detail-eyepatch.description: Worn over an eye, you see through it as a working eye. Once per dawn, as a Bonus Action with a command word, gain 60-foot Darkvision (or +60 feet) for 1 hour and see through magical Darkness as nonmagical.

magic-item:direstone-dwarven-pick.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a dwarf; war pick
magic-item:direstone-dwarven-pick.description: You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Stone creatures and objects it hits take an extra 1d8 Piercing damage. It has 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn; expend 1 to cast Meld into Stone or Stone Shape.

magic-item:discordant-thunderstave.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It has the Finesse property. When you roll its damage die's maximum, roll the die again and add it as Thunder damage.

magic-item:doodle-ring.description: Your ringed finger draws on solid surfaces like charcoal, ink, or paint in any color; marks wipe away easily, cover at most 5 square feet (new marks erase old), and vanish after 24 hours.

magic-item:doomsday-cookie.description: A black cookie holding a paper that vaguely predicts how the eater will die (roll 1d20 on its table); later cookies always repeat that creature's prediction. If the creature dies as foretold (GM's call), the paper becomes a Spell Scroll of Revivify usable only on that creature within 1 minute.

magic-item:dragon-edge-weapon.description: Forged from a dragon's claw or tooth. The first time each turn you hit with an attack roll that had Advantage, it deals an extra 1d6 damage of the dragon's breath type. Young dragon: uncommon; adult: rare, +1 to attack and damage rolls; ancient: very rare, +2.

magic-item:dragon-tamer-lance.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. While attuned you know Draconic. It has 8 charges, regaining 1d4 + 4 at dawn: on a hit expend 1 for an extra 3d6 Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison damage (a Dragon also makes a DC 17 Wisdom save or is Frightened until the start of your next turn), and a second charge adds 1d6 more and denies it Reactions until your next turn. Once per dawn, cast Find Steed, and expend charges equal to its CR (maximum 2) to summon a dragon wyrmling instead.

magic-item:dragon-turtle-shield.description: Once per dawn (or after 1 hour submerged in salt water), as a Reaction when you take Fire damage, halve it and release a 45-foot-diameter Emanation of steam that is Heavily Obscured for 1 minute or until a strong wind disperses it.

magic-item:dragon-kindled-edge.description: You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It deals an extra 2d6 damage to Dragons, and while attuned you know Draconic. Once per dawn, as a Reaction to a hostile dragon's breath weapon, split it so you and creatures in a 30-foot Cone behind you are unaffected; the blade then hazes for 1 minute (Bright Light 10 feet, Dim 10 more), and the first target you hit takes an extra 6d6 damage of the breath's type, ignoring Resistance and Immunity. Once per dawn, if you fail a save by 4 or less, you can succeed instead.

magic-item:dragon-s-call.description: While wearing this ear cuff you know Draconic and gain +1 to Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma checks involving dragon lore.

magic-item:dragonkin-weapon.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a dragonborn; any melee weapon
magic-item:dragonkin-weapon.description: It grants a bonus to attack and damage rolls and to your Breath Weapon's save DC, both set by its rarity, and deals an extra 1d6 damage of your Breath Weapon's type on a hit. Its metal takes on your colors when you attune.

magic-item:dream-mantle.description: Creatures more than 30 feet away have Disadvantage on sight-based Perception checks to perceive you and on ranged attacks against you (suppressed while you're Incapacitated, Restrained, or can't move). Once per 7 days, cast Dream (DC 16) over 1 minute with yourself as the messenger.

magic-item:druidic-throwing-club.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a druid or ranger; club
magic-item:druidic-throwing-club.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It has the Thrown property (range 20/60) and returns to your hand after a ranged attack. While attuned you know Shillelagh, which doesn't end when the club is thrown.

magic-item:dryadleaf.description: A plant holding up to four leaves (found with 1d4 mature). Eating a mature leaf as a Magic action lets you speak with Beasts, Plants, and nonmagical plants for 1 minute; picked leaves keep this for 7 days. Potting it takes 1 minute and a DC 15 Nature or Survival check or it dies. Watered and given some sun, it regrows 1d4 leaves every 7 days, even in an extradimensional space.

magic-item:eaglereign.description: Once per dawn, cast Find Familiar as a Magic action, the familiar taking Eagle form. By focusing for 1 hour, summon an allied Giant Eagle within 30 feet for up to 12 hours (once per 2 days) that acts after you and obeys your commands, carries 480 pounds, flies 8 miles per hour, must rest 1 hour per 3 flown, and flies at most 9 hours.

magic-item:ear-cuff-of-the-vampire-bat.description: When you fail a hearing-based Perception check, it can bite you for 1d4 + 1 Necrotic damage (ignoring Resistance and Immunity), adding that amount to the check.

magic-item:edible-book-of-recipes.description: Writing a simple recipe on a page over 1 minute makes it an edible meal (eaten as a Magic action). A complex recipe written over 10 minutes feeds a creature for a day, raises its Hit Point maximum and current Hit Points by 1d10 + its Proficiency Bonus until a Long Rest, and grants a new save against Poisoned or a magical contagion (once per 24 hours). It can serve as a focus for Create Food and Water, flavoring the result. It holds 50 pages; removing the last page or rebinding it risks a 1 in 20 chance it burns and becomes a Heroes' Feast.

magic-item:eldritch-scarf.description: Its folds hold an extradimensional space of 60 pounds or 6 cubic feet; it weighs 1 pound. Items go in freely but come out only by its frayed hands as a Bonus Action (up to 10 pounds each). As a Magic action its hands perform a simple task within 5 feet (no attacks or magic items). Ironing it spills the contents; destroying it loses them; putting it in another extradimensional space destroys both and pulls creatures within 10 feet into the Astral Plane.

magic-item:enchantment-breaker.description: When a spell restores your Hit Points, you can use a Reaction to repeat a save against an Enchantment spell affecting you. When you fail a save against an Enchantment spell, as a Reaction you and allies within 10 feet targeted by it reroll the save; once per 1d4 days.

magic-item:essence-of-rage.description: Drinking it grants a Barbarian level 1 Rage for 1 minute or until Incapacitated, usable in Heavy armor. If you end a turn without attacking an enemy, forcing an enemy save, or using a Bonus Action to extend it, you take 1d4 Psychic damage and the rage continues.

magic-item:ether-spear.description: You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It deals Force damage. When you take the Attack action, choose a space within 20 feet: its tip appears there, letting you attack targets within 5 feet of that space this turn, ignoring Half Cover and treating Three-Quarters Cover as Half. Once per dawn, as a Bonus Action see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane (or out of it) for 1 minute.

magic-item:everice-box.description: A 25-pound chest keeping up to 24 Rations at 40 degrees Fahrenheit. While closed and latched, as a Magic action with a command word it shrinks to 1 foot long with half weight; opening it restores its size. Living creatures can't be shrunk, and a trapped creature escapes with a DC 10 Athletics check.

magic-item:everlasting-sugarbomb.description: A layered candy that sustains a creature for a day after 1 minute in the mouth, lasting 30 uses. Biting through it takes a DC 25 Strength or Constitution check, followed by a DC 16 Constitution save or you're Poisoned for 1 minute.

magic-item:eye-of-dendallen.description: Cast See Invisibility at will. Curse: on attuning, a DC 20 Wisdom save lets you refuse; otherwise you tear out an eye (4d10 Necrotic damage unless one is missing) and it takes the socket until Remove Curse. You see through it and gain 60-foot Darkvision (or +30 feet); once per dusk as a Bonus Action you see through magical Darkness for 1 minute. As a Magic action it can crawl out as a familiar (Undead Spider, 5 Hit Points). If attunement ends it flees, and slaying it unattuned destroys it.

magic-item:eye-of-the-bookwurm.description: As a Bonus Action, speak a word or phrase; while you hold it, you see that text highlighted wherever you look. You can change the phrase freely for 1 hour; once per dawn.

magic-item:fable-s-end.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. On a natural 20 against a Large or smaller creature, it makes a DC 15 Charisma save or is banished to a harmless demiplane until the end of its next turn. Against Fey, it crits and triggers the save on 19-20, and Fey save with Disadvantage.

magic-item:fanfare-ammunition.description: On a hit it deals no damage and is destroyed, producing an illusory sound of your choice at any volume from whisper to scream; a DC 10 Investigation check reveals it as an illusion.

magic-item:ferryman-s-take.description: Two coins placed over the eyes of a dead, willing, or Unconscious Humanoid as a Magic action (both must match). Heads: an Unconscious creature is Stable, and a conscious one enters a deathlike state with Psychic Immunity for 1 hour (once per 24 hours). Tails: a dead creature is under Gentle Repose, its body can't be magically detected, and its soul can't be contacted.

magic-item:festerwood-buckler.description: While held it sheds Bright Light 5 feet and Dim Light 5 more. As a Reaction when a creature you can see within 5 feet misses you with an attack roll, it makes a DC 13 Dexterity save or takes 1d4 + 1 Acid damage.

magic-item:festerwood-claymore.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. On a natural 20, beetles latch onto the target for 1d4 turns: it takes 1d6 Piercing damage at the start of each turn and has half Speed until it or an adjacent creature swats them away as an action. Against plants, Plant creatures, or wooden objects the damage is maximized and lasts 4 turns.

magic-item:festerwood-fungal-stave.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a cleric, druid, or sorcerer
magic-item:festerwood-fungal-stave.description: It has 25 charges, regaining 1d10 + 15 at dusk. As a Magic action, expend charges to grow noxious mushrooms in that many spaces on the ground within 60 feet for 1 minute: Difficult Terrain dealing 2d4 Poison damage per 5 feet moved through. As a Bonus Action, expend charges to cast Fog Cloud (1), Stinking Cloud (3), Cloudkill (5), or Insect Plague (5) with your DC, centered next to your mushrooms, without Concentration, ending at the end of your next turn. On the last charge, roll 1d20; on a 1 it becomes a hostile Violet Fungus.

magic-item:festerwood-logger.description: Hits deal an extra 1d4 Acid damage, maximized against plants, Plant creatures, and wooden objects.

magic-item:festerwood-masher.description: You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It has 3 charges, all regained at dusk. On a hit, expend 1 to give a Large or smaller target a cumulative -1 AC penalty for 1 minute (Huge needs two applications and Gargantuan three); later hits deal an extra 1d4 Acid damage per point of penalty.

magic-item:festerwood-vizard.description: While wearing it you have 10-foot Blindsight. Once per dusk as a Magic action, release a Swarm of Insects (flying) that moves and attacks when summoned and then as your Bonus Action each turn, dodging if you're Incapacitated; it disperses at 0 Hit Points or after 10 minutes without attacking.

magic-item:festerwood-s-light.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. While attuned you have Advantage on checks to find places in the Festerwood and are immune to magical contagions; held, it sheds Bright Light 10 feet and Dim 10 more. Once per dusk as a Magic action, spores wash over creatures within 30 feet: allies can use a Reaction to attack or move half Speed without provoking, and enemies make a DC 17 Constitution save or are Incapacitated until the end of your next turn. It has 5 charges, regaining 1d3 + 2 at dusk: expend 1 to cast Charm Person (level 4 version), Compulsion, Confusion, Contagion, Faerie Fire, Locate Animals or Plants, or Moonbeam (level 4 version) at DC 17, +9, or to remove a Spore Counter from a willing creature you touch. You can cast Dancing Lights at will.

magic-item:fife-of-dragonsong.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a bard; blowgun
magic-item:fife-of-dragonsong.description: Usable as instrument and blowgun with proficiency. You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It deals an extra 1d6 Thunder damage. As a Magic action, spend a Bardic Inspiration to play a note audible to 100 feet: enemies in a 15-foot Cone make a DC 15 Constitution save, taking 2d6 Thunder damage and being pushed 10 feet, or half damage only on a success; allies in the Cone gain 2d6 Temporary Hit Points and +10 Speed until the end of their next turn.

magic-item:fire-dervish-cloak.description: It has 5 charges, all regained at dawn. Once per turn, expend 1-3 charges and lose 10 feet of Speed per charge this turn to spin: creatures within 5 feet make a DC 15 Dexterity save or take 1d8 Fire damage per charge and can't make Opportunity Attacks against you this turn.

magic-item:fire-fire.description: A kobold-made crossbow with 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn. While it has a charge it sheds Bright Light 20 feet and Dim 20 more, and nonmagical bolts deal an extra 1d6 Fire damage. As a Magic action, expend 1 for a 30-foot Cone of fire: DC 15 Dexterity save, 4d6 Fire damage, or half on a success, igniting unattended flammables. On the last charge, roll 1d20; on a 1 it becomes nonmagical.

magic-item:fire-wand-of-the-unbroken-cir.description: It has 7 charges, regaining 1d6 + 1 at dawn: cast Flame Blade (2 charges, blade above the wand) or Produce Flame (free, or 1 charge at level 5) with a +5 attack bonus. While holding it, expend 1 as a Reaction to succeed on a failed Concentration save for that Flame Blade. On the last charge, roll 1d20; on a 1 it crumbles.

magic-item:firecracker-crystals.description: A bag of 1d4 + 8 crystals. As a Magic action, throw one against a surface within 20 feet for a harmless sensory display until the end of your turn: flame, light flash, sparks, colored smoke, bubbles, music, glitter, or a random one (roll 1d8 for each crystal).

magic-item:fireweaver-gloves.description: Cast Produce Flame (+5 to hit, 1 hour duration) from them, and set its flame down harmlessly for up to 1 minute. You can hold and sculpt small nonmagical flames like clay (shapes last 1 minute; carried flames burn 1 hour). As a Reaction with a free hand, reduce Fire damage you take by 1d8 + 2.

magic-item:flesh-of-dendallen.description: A stitched-flesh shirt with 6 charges, regaining 1d4 + 2 at dusk; as a Bonus Action expend 1 to cast False Life. While Bloodied you regain 1d4 + your Constitution modifier (minimum 1) Hit Points at the start of each turn unless Unconscious or you took Fire or Radiant damage since your last turn. Curse: on first wearing make a DC 20 Strength save or it fuses to you until Remove Curse, giving you the Undead type and Radiant Vulnerability; removing it deals 4d10 Necrotic damage.

magic-item:force-gauntlet.description: It has 5 charges, regaining 1d4 + 1 at dawn. On a melee hit with a weapon in that hand or an Unarmed Strike, expend 1 for an extra 2d6 Force damage; the target makes a DC 15 Strength save or is pushed 10 feet, or you are pushed 10 feet on a success (targets two sizes larger succeed).

magic-item:forgemaster-s-might.description: Requires Strength 17. You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. As a Bonus Action it lights (Bright Light 20 feet, Dim 20 more), dealing an extra 1d8 Fire damage that ignores Fire Resistance until quenched as a Bonus Action. Each once per dawn, cast Creation (level 6 version) or Fabricate as a Magic action, using Creation's materials for Fabricate. While attuned you know Mending (repairing metal breaks up to 5 feet) and have Advantage on Smith's Tools checks using it as an anvil. It deals an extra 2d8 Bludgeoning damage to Constructs and structures.

magic-item:fortune-s-fivepence.description: An electrum coin you summon to hand or pocket from 30 feet as a Bonus Action. It has 2 charges; once per 24 hours flip a coin to regain both on heads. When your D20 Test total is 10 or lower, expend 1 and flip: add 1d10 on heads, subtract 1d10 on tails; it loses this property if that drops the total to 0 or lower.

magic-item:fourarm-bracers.description: As a Magic action, summon a second pair of spectral arms for 1 minute that handle simple object tasks (10 pounds each). The gems have 5 charges, regaining 1d4 + 1 at dawn: as a Bonus Action expend 1 for two Unarmed Strikes with the arms (+3 Strength plus your Proficiency Bonus, 1d4 Force each), or expend 1 when summoning to double their carrying capacity and extend them to 5 minutes.

magic-item:fragment-of-elder-starlight.description: A crystal shedding adjustable sunlight up to Bright 20 feet and Dim 20 more (Bonus Action to adjust). Once per dawn as a Magic action, it releases a 60-foot Emanation: Undead and Fiends make a DC 16 Constitution save, taking 8d6 Radiant damage and Blinded until the end of your next turn, or half damage only; chosen living allies regain 4d6 Hit Points. It then sheds at most 10 feet of Bright Light until dawn.

magic-item:frefil-s-jolly-oozebean-sugar.description: A pack of 4 oozebeans (roll 1d8 each for color), eaten as a Bonus Action for 1 minute: white, breathe underwater; black, Acid Resistance and can eat inedible nonpoisonous organics; blue, grappling partners take 1d8 Acid damage; gray, Advantage on saves against Charmed and Frightened; gold, Climb Speed equal to Speed; red, 1d8 + 4 Temporary Hit Points; green, Poison Resistance and Advantage on checks to escape Grappled and Restrained; yellow, Lightning Resistance and immunity to Magic Missile. Upset Stomach: only one such sugarbomb works at a time; eating another replaces it and forces a DC 13 Constitution save or you're Poisoned for 1 minute.

magic-item:frefil-s-tiny-tasty-tongue-tw.description: A bag of 12 gumballs. Chewing one (Magic action) for 5 minutes lets you understand the literal meaning of any spoken or signed language, and your accent matches whoever you're listening to. Upset Stomach: only one such sugarbomb works at a time; eating another replaces it and forces a DC 13 Constitution save or you're Poisoned for 1 minute.

magic-item:frost-giant-fork.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Right after a melee hit with it, you can bite the same target as a Bonus Action (Strength plus Proficiency Bonus, 1d6 Piercing). Curse: while attuned you must eat twice as much food or gain an Exhaustion level for each day you don't.

magic-item:frostbitten-buckler.description: It has 3 charges, all regained at dawn. As a Reaction when a creature you can see hits you with a melee attack roll, expend 1 to deal 2d4 Cold damage to it and gain that many Temporary Hit Points.

magic-item:frozen-dagger.description: It deals Cold damage instead of Piercing. On a natural 20, the target makes a DC 12 Constitution save or is Paralyzed until the end of its next turn, or has half Speed until then on a success.

magic-item:funeral-marchers.description: When reduced to 0 Hit Points you can stay standing rather than fall Prone, and while Unconscious and standing you can walk up to 10 feet after each Death Saving Throw.

magic-item:galea-of-the-soulfire-phoenix.description: While wearing it you have Fire Resistance, it flares harmlessly in combat (Bright Light 20 feet, Dim 20 more), and you and allies in its Bright Light have Advantage on saves against Charmed and Frightened and regain 1 Hit Point on a 19-20 Death Saving Throw. Once per dawn as a Bonus Action cast Fire Shield (warm) and gain flaming wings with a 30-foot Fly Speed for its duration. It has 7 charges, regaining 1d4 + 3 at dawn: Healing Word (level 2 version, 1), Death Ward (3), Flame Strike (4), DC 18, +5 modifier. Once per 2 days, when reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed, as a Reaction drop to 1 instead, regain 14 Hit Points, deal 4d10 Fire damage to creatures within 10 feet (DC 18 Dexterity for half), and fly 60 feet without provoking. It has 1 major beneficial, 2 minor detrimental, and 1 major detrimental random property, returns to the Plane of Fire if you die, and is destroyed only by feeding it to an ancient phoenix.

magic-item:galepierce-weapons.attunementNote: Any piercing weapon with the Thrown property
magic-item:galepierce-weapons.description: Their Thrown ranges are doubled, and their ranged attacks ignore air-based hindrances such as fog and high winds.

magic-item:galvanic-steelsnare.description: A heavy steel Net. A creature Restrained by it can make only one attack per turn. Once per turn as a Bonus Action with a command word, a restrained creature within 30 feet takes 1d6 Lightning damage (2d6 if metal or in metal armor). Escape takes an action and a DC 15 Athletics check (Small or smaller with Disadvantage), or destroying the net (AC 12, 15 Hit Points, Slashing Resistance, Immunity to other damage), which repairs itself in 1d6 + 1 days.

magic-item:gibberbox.description: Opening it as a Magic action reveals a babbling mouth (touching it deals 1d6 Piercing damage). For 1 minute or until closed as a Magic action, each creature starting its turn within 20 feet that hears it makes a DC 10 Wisdom save or can't make Opportunity Attacks and rolls a d8: 1-4 does nothing, 5-6 moves randomly, 7-8 attacks a random creature in reach. Usable once per 24 hours.

magic-item:give-and-take.description: Chained scimitars; you add your ability modifier to the Light extra attack's damage. They share 10 charges, regaining 1d6 + 4 at midday. On a hit with Give, expend 1: you and other creatures within 5 feet of the target gain 2d6 Temporary Hit Points. On a hit with Take, expend 1: the target takes 2d6 Necrotic damage and you and others within 5 feet of it take half.

magic-item:glove-of-the-aegis.description: It has 5 charges, regaining 1d3 + 2 at dawn. As a Reaction when hit by an attack roll from a target you can see, expend any number for +2 AC per charge against that attack. It doesn't work while you wield a Shield.

magic-item:glove-of-the-grim-fandango.description: On your dominant hand it grants proficiency with all Musical Instruments. After playing for 1 minute, illusory musicians accompany you, granting Advantage on Performance checks and +2 to your spell save DC for Enchantment spells against targets that hear the performance.
